items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, bij s t f <-> inj s t f /\ ((forall x :e s, f x :e t) /\ forall y :e t, exists x :e s, f x = y)
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f :e B :^: A, forall s :e 2 :^: A, forall t :e 2 :^: B, hl_BIJ A B f s t = 1 <-> hl_INJ A B f s t = 1 /\ hl_SURJ A B f s t = 1

items.name: BIJECTIONS_CARD_EQ
items.source: !s:A->bool. !t:B->bool. !f:A->B. !g:B->A. (FINITE s \/ FINITE t) /\ (!x:A. x IN s ==> f x IN t /\ g (f x) = x) /\ (!y:B. y IN t ==> g y IN s /\ f (g y) = y) ==> CARD s = CARD t
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e A) -> (finite s \/ finite t) /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e t /\ g (f x) = x) /\ (forall y :e B, y :e t -> g y :e s /\ f (g y) = y)) -> finite_cardinality s = finite_cardinality t
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s :e 2 :^: A, forall t :e 2 :^: B, forall f :e B :^: A, forall g :e A :^: B, (hl_FINITE A s = 1 \/ hl_FINITE B t = 1) /\ ((forall x :e A, hl_IN A x s = 1 -> hl_IN B (f x) t = 1 /\ g (f x) = x) /\ (forall y :e B, hl_IN B y t = 1 -> hl_IN A (g y) s = 1 /\ f (g y) = y)) -> hl_CARD A s = hl_CARD B t

items.name: BIJECTIONS_HAS_SIZE
items.source: !s:A->bool. !t:B->bool. !f:A->B. !g:B->A. (!x:A. x IN s ==> f x IN t /\ g (f x) = x) /\ (!y:B. y IN t ==> g y IN s /\ f (g y) = y) /\ HAS_SIZE s n ==> HAS_SIZE t n
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall n :e omega, forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e A) -> (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e t /\ g (f x) = x) /\ ((forall y :e B, y :e t -> g y :e s /\ f (g y) = y) /\ equip s n) -> equip t n
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall n :e omega, forall s :e 2 :^: A, forall t :e 2 :^: B, forall f :e B :^: A, forall g :e A :^: B, (forall x :e A, hl_IN A x s = 1 -> hl_IN B (f x) t = 1 /\ g (f x) = x) /\ ((forall y :e B, hl_IN B y t = 1 -> hl_IN A (g y) s = 1 /\ f (g y) = y) /\ hl_HAS_SIZE A s n = 1) -> hl_HAS_SIZE B t n = 1

items.name: BIJECTIONS_HAS_SIZE_EQ
items.source: !s:A->bool. !t:B->bool. !f:A->B. !g:B->A. (!x:A. x IN s ==> f x IN t /\ g (f x) = x) /\ (!y:B. y IN t ==> g y IN s /\ f (g y) = y) ==> (!n:num. HAS_SIZE s n <=> HAS_SIZE t n)
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e A) -> (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e t /\ g (f x) = x) /\ (forall y :e B, y :e t -> g y :e s /\ f (g y) = y) -> forall n :e omega, equip s n <-> equip t n
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s :e 2 :^: A, forall t :e 2 :^: B, forall f :e B :^: A, forall g :e A :^: B, (forall x :e A, hl_IN A x s = 1 -> hl_IN B (f x) t = 1 /\ g (f x) = x) /\ (forall y :e B, hl_IN B y t = 1 -> hl_IN A (g y) s = 1 /\ f (g y) = y) -> forall n :e omega, hl_HAS_SIZE A s n = 1 <-> hl_HAS_SIZE B t n = 1

items.name: BIJECTIVE_LEFT_RIGHT_INVERSE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> ((forall x y :e A, f x = f y -> x = y) /\ (forall y :e B, exists x :e A, f x = y) <-> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e A) /\ ((forall y :e B, f (g y) = y) /\ forall x :e A, g (f x) = x))
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f :e B :^: A, (forall x y :e A, f x = f y -> x = y) /\ (forall y :e B, exists x :e A, f x = y) <-> exists g :e A :^: B, (forall y :e B, f (g y) = y) /\ forall x :e A, g (f x) = x

items.name: BIJECTIVE_ON_LEFT_RIGHT_INVERSE
items.source: !f:A->B. !s:A->bool. !t:B->bool. (!x:A. x IN s ==> f x IN t) ==> ((!x:A. !y:A. x IN s /\ y IN s /\ f x = f y ==> x = y) /\ (!y:B. y IN t ==> (?x:A. x IN s /\ f x = y)) <=> (?g:B->A. (!y:B. y IN t ==> g y IN s) /\ (!y:B. y IN t ==> f (g y) = y) /\ (!x:A. x IN s ==> g (f x) = x)))
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e t) -> ((forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) /\ (forall y :e B, y :e t -> exists x :e A, x :e s /\ f x = y) <-> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e A) /\ ((forall y :e B, y :e t -> g y :e s) /\ ((forall y :e B, y :e t -> f (g y) = y) /\ forall x :e A, x :e s -> g (f x) = x)))
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f :e B :^: A, forall s :e 2 :^: A, forall t :e 2 :^: B, (forall x :e A, hl_IN A x s = 1 -> hl_IN B (f x) t = 1) -> ((forall x y :e A, hl_IN A x s = 1 /\ (hl_IN A y s = 1 /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) /\ (forall y :e B, hl_IN B y t = 1 -> exists x :e A, hl_IN A x s = 1 /\ f x = y) <-> exists g :e A :^: B, (forall y :e B, hl_IN B y t = 1 -> hl_IN A (g y) s = 1) /\ ((forall y :e B, hl_IN B y t = 1 -> f (g y) = y) /\ forall x :e A, hl_IN A x s = 1 -> g (f x) = x))

items.name: BINARY_INDUCT
items.source: !P:num->bool. P 0 /\ (!n:num. P n ==> P (2 * n) /\ P (2 * n + 1)) ==> (!n:num. P n)
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, P 0 /\ (forall n :e omega, P n -> P (2 * n) /\ P (2 * n + 1)) -> forall n :e omega, P n
items.literal: forall P :e 2 :^: omega, P (hl_NUMERAL hl_zero) = 1 /\ (forall n :e omega, P n = 1 -> P (hl_mul (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT0 (hl_BIT1 hl_zero))) n) = 1 /\ P (hl_add (hl_mul (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT0 (hl_BIT1 hl_zero))) n) (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT1 hl_zero))) = 1) -> forall n :e omega, P n = 1

items.name: BIT0
items.source: !n:num. BIT0 n = n + n
items.statement: forall n :e omega, 2 * n = n + n
items.literal: forall n :e omega, hl_BIT0 n = hl_add n n

items.name: BIT0_0
items.source: BIT0 0 = 0
items.literal: hl_BIT0 (hl_NUMERAL hl_zero) = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero

items.name: BIT0_DEF
items.source: BIT0 0 = 0 /\ (!n:num. BIT0 (SUC n) = SUC (SUC (BIT0 n)))
items.statement: 0 = 0 /\ forall n :e omega, 2 * ordsucc n = ordsucc (ordsucc (2 * n))
items.literal: hl_BIT0 (hl_NUMERAL hl_zero) = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero /\ forall n :e omega, hl_BIT0 (hl_SUC n) = hl_SUC (hl_SUC (hl_BIT0 n))

items.name: BIT0_THM
items.source: !n:num. NUMERAL (BIT0 n) = NUMERAL n + NUMERAL n
items.statement: forall n :e omega, 2 * n = n + n
items.literal: forall n :e omega, hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT0 n) = hl_add (hl_NUMERAL n) (hl_NUMERAL n)

items.name: BIT1
items.source: !n:num. BIT1 n = SUC (n + n)
items.statement: forall n :e omega, 2 * n + 1 = ordsucc (n + n)
items.literal: forall n :e omega, hl_BIT1 n = hl_SUC (hl_add n n)

items.name: BIT1_0
items.source: BIT1 0 = 1
items.literal: hl_BIT1 (hl_NUMERAL hl_zero) = hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT1 hl_zero)

items.name: BIT1_DEF
items.source: !n:num. BIT1 n = SUC (BIT0 n)
items.statement: forall n :e omega, 2 * n + 1 = ordsucc (2 * n)
items.literal: forall n :e omega, hl_BIT1 n = hl_SUC (hl_BIT0 n)

items.name: BIT1_THM
items.source: !n:num. NUMERAL (BIT1 n) = SUC (NUMERAL n + NUMERAL n)
items.statement: forall n :e omega, 2 * n + 1 = ordsucc (n + n)
items.literal: forall n :e omega, hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT1 n) = hl_SUC (hl_add (hl_NUMERAL n) (hl_NUMERAL n))

items.statement: forall t:prop, (t <-> True) \/ (t <-> False)
items.literal: forall t :e 2, (t = 1 <-> True) \/ (t = 1 <-> False)

items.name: BOUNDS_DIVIDED
items.source: !P:num->num. (?B:num. !n:num. P n <= B) <=> (?A:num. ?B:num. !n:num. n * P n <= A * n + B)
items.statement: forall P:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, P x :e omega) -> ((exists B :e omega, forall n :e omega, P n <= B) <-> exists A B :e omega, forall n :e omega, n * P n <= A * n + B)
items.literal: forall P :e omega :^: omega, (exists B :e omega, forall n :e omega, hl_le (P n) B = 1) <-> exists A B :e omega, forall n :e omega, hl_le (hl_mul n (P n)) (hl_add (hl_mul A n) B) = 1

items.name: BOUNDS_IGNORE
items.source: !P:num->num. !Q:num->num. (?B:num. !i:num. P i <= Q i + B) <=> (?B:num. ?N:num. !i:num. N <= i ==> P i <= Q i + B)
items.statement: forall P:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, P x :e omega) -> forall Q:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, Q x :e omega) -> ((exists B :e omega, forall i :e omega, P i <= Q i + B) <-> exists B N :e omega, forall i :e omega, N <= i -> P i <= Q i + B)
items.literal: forall P Q :e omega :^: omega, (exists B :e omega, forall i :e omega, hl_le (P i) (hl_add (Q i) B) = 1) <-> exists B N :e omega, forall i :e omega, hl_le N i = 1 -> hl_le (P i) (hl_add (Q i) B) = 1

items.name: BOUNDS_LINEAR
items.source: !A:num. !B:num. !C:num. (!n:num. A * n <= B * n + C) <=> A <= B
items.statement: forall A B C :e omega, (forall n :e omega, A * n <= B * n + C) <-> A <= B
items.literal: forall A B C :e omega, (forall n :e omega, hl_le (hl_mul A n) (hl_add (hl_mul B n) C) = 1) <-> hl_le A B = 1

items.name: BOUNDS_LINEAR_0
items.source: !A:num. !B:num. (!n:num. A * n <= B) <=> A = 0
items.statement: forall A B :e omega, (forall n :e omega, A * n <= B) <-> A = 0
items.literal: forall A B :e omega, (forall n :e omega, hl_le (hl_mul A n) B = 1) <-> A = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero

items.name: BOUNDS_NOTZERO
items.source: !P:num->num->num. !A:num. !B:num. P 0 0 = 0 /\ (!m:num. !n:num. P m n <= A * (m + n) + B) ==> (?B1:num. !m:num. !n:num. P m n <= B1 * (m + n))
items.statement: forall P:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e omega, P x y :e omega) -> forall A B :e omega, P 0 0 = 0 /\ (forall m n :e omega, P m n <= A * (m + n) + B) -> exists B0 :e omega, forall m n :e omega, P m n <= B0 * (m + n)
items.literal: forall P :e omega :^: omega :^: omega, forall A B :e omega, P (hl_NUMERAL hl_zero) (hl_NUMERAL hl_zero) = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero /\ (forall m n :e omega, hl_le (P m n) (hl_add (hl_mul A (hl_add m n)) B) = 1) -> exists B1 :e omega, forall m n :e omega, hl_le (P m n) (hl_mul B1 (hl_add m n)) = 1

items.name: BUTLAST
items.source: BUTLAST NIL = NIL /\ BUTLAST (h CONS t) = (if t = NIL then NIL else h CONS BUTLAST t)
items.statement: forall A:set, forall h :e A, forall t :e finseq A, seq_butlast seq_nil = seq_nil /\ seq_butlast (seq_cons h t) = if t = seq_nil then seq_nil else seq_cons h (seq_butlast t)
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall h :e A, forall t :e finseq A, hl_BUTLAST A (hl_NIL A) = hl_NIL A /\ hl_BUTLAST A (hl_CONS A h t) = hl_COND (finseq A) (if t = hl_NIL A then 1 else 0) (hl_NIL A) (hl_CONS A h (hl_BUTLAST A t))

items.name: BUTLAST_APPEND
items.source: !l:A list. !m:A list. BUTLAST (l APPEND m) = (if m = NIL then BUTLAST l else l APPEND BUTLAST m)
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l m :e finseq A, seq_butlast (seq_append l m) = if m = seq_nil then seq_butlast l else seq_append l (seq_butlast m)
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l m :e finseq A, hl_BUTLAST A (hl_APPEND A l m) = hl_COND (finseq A) (if m = hl_NIL A then 1 else 0) (hl_BUTLAST A l) (hl_APPEND A l (hl_BUTLAST A m))

items.name: BUTLAST_CLAUSES
items.source: BUTLAST NIL = NIL /\ (!a:A. BUTLAST (a CONS NIL) = NIL) /\ (!a:A. !h:A. !t:A list. BUTLAST (a CONS h CONS t) = a CONS BUTLAST (h CONS t))
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> seq_butlast seq_nil = seq_nil /\ ((forall a :e A, seq_butlast (seq_cons a seq_nil) = seq_nil) /\ forall a h :e A, forall t :e finseq A, seq_butlast (seq_cons a (seq_cons h t)) = seq_cons a (seq_butlast (seq_cons h t)))
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> hl_BUTLAST A (hl_NIL A) = hl_NIL A /\ ((forall a :e A, hl_BUTLAST A (hl_CONS A a (hl_NIL A)) = hl_NIL A) /\ forall a h :e A, forall t :e finseq A, hl_BUTLAST A (hl_CONS A a (hl_CONS A h t)) = hl_CONS A a (hl_BUTLAST A (hl_CONS A h t)))

items.name: CARD
items.source: !s:A->bool. CARD s = ITSET (\x:A. \n:num. SUC n) s 0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, finite_cardinality s = set_foldr (fun x:set => fun n:set => ordsucc n) s 0
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s :e 2 :^: A, hl_CARD A s = hl_ITSET A omega (fun x :e A => fun n :e omega => hl_SUC n) s (hl_NUMERAL hl_zero)

items.name: CARD_BOOL
items.source: CARD UNIV = 2
items.statement: finite_cardinality 2 = 2
items.literal: hl_CARD 2 (hl_UNIV 2) = hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT0 (hl_BIT1 hl_zero))

items.name: CARD_CART_UNIV
items.source: FINITE UNIV ==> CARD UNIV = CARD UNIV EXP dimindex UNIV
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> finite A -> finite_cardinality (A :^: idx N) = finite_cardinality A ^ dimindex N
items.literal: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> hl_FINITE A (hl_UNIV A) = 1 -> hl_CARD (hl_ty_cart A N) (hl_UNIV (hl_ty_cart A N)) = hl_EXP (hl_CARD A (hl_UNIV A)) (hl_dimindex N (hl_UNIV N))

items.name: CARD_CLAUSES
items.source: CARD EMPTY = 0 /\ (!x:A. !s:A->bool. FINITE s ==> CARD (x INSERT s) = (if x IN s then CARD s else SUC (CARD s)))
items.statement: forall A:set, finite_cardinality Empty = 0 /\ forall x :e A, forall s c= A, finite s -> finite_cardinality (SetAdjoin s x) = if x :e s then finite_cardinality s else ordsucc (finite_cardinality s)
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> hl_CARD A (hl_EMPTY A) = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero /\ forall x :e A, forall s :e 2 :^: A, hl_FINITE A s = 1 -> hl_CARD A (hl_INSERT A x s) = hl_COND omega (hl_IN A x s) (hl_CARD A s) (hl_SUC (hl_CARD A s))

items.name: CARD_CROSS
items.source: !s:A->bool. !t:B->bool. FINITE s /\ FINITE t ==> CARD (CROSS s t) = CARD s * CARD t
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ finite t -> finite_cardinality (s :*: t) = finite_cardinality s * finite_cardinality t
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s :e 2 :^: A, forall t :e 2 :^: B, hl_FINITE A s = 1 /\ hl_FINITE B t = 1 -> hl_CARD (A :*: B) (hl_CROSS A B s t) = hl_mul (hl_CARD A s) (hl_CARD B t)

items.name: CARD_DELETE
items.source: !x:A. !s:A->bool. FINITE s ==> CARD (s DELETE x) = (if x IN s then CARD s - 1 else CARD s)
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall s c= A, finite s -> finite_cardinality (s :\: {x}) = if x :e s then minus_nat (finite_cardinality s) 1 else finite_cardinality s
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e A, forall s :e 2 :^: A, hl_FINITE A s = 1 -> hl_CARD A (hl_DELETE A s x) = hl_COND omega (hl_IN A x s) (hl_sub (hl_CARD A s) (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT1 hl_zero))) (hl_CARD A s)

items.name: CARD_DIFF
items.source: !s:A->bool. !t:A->bool. FINITE s /\ t SUBSET s ==> CARD (s DIFF t) = CARD s - CARD t
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, finite s /\ t c= s -> finite_cardinality (s :\: t) = minus_nat (finite_cardinality s) (finite_cardinality t)
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t :e 2 :^: A, hl_FINITE A s = 1 /\ hl_SUBSET A t s = 1 -> hl_CARD A (hl_DIFF A s t) = hl_sub (hl_CARD A s) (hl_CARD A t)

items.name: CARD_EQ_0
items.source: !s:A->bool. FINITE s ==> (CARD s = 0 <=> s = EMPTY)
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, finite s -> (finite_cardinality s = 0 <-> s = Empty)
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s :e 2 :^: A, hl_FINITE A s = 1 -> (hl_CARD A s = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero <-> s = hl_EMPTY A)

items.name: CARD_EQ_BIJECTION
items.source: !s:A->bool. !t:B->bool. FINITE s /\ FINITE t /\ CARD s = CARD t ==> (?f:A->B. (!x:A. x IN s ==> f x IN t) /\ (!y:B. y IN t ==> (?x:A. x IN s /\ f x = y)) /\ (!x:A. !y:A. x IN s /\ y IN s /\ f x = f y ==> x = y))
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ (finite t /\ finite_cardinality s = finite_cardinality t) -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e t) /\ ((forall y :e B, y :e t -> exists x :e A, x :e s /\ f x = y) /\ forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y))
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s :e 2 :^: A, forall t :e 2 :^: B, hl_FINITE A s = 1 /\ (hl_FINITE B t = 1 /\ hl_CARD A s = hl_CARD B t) -> exists f :e B :^: A, (forall x :e A, hl_IN A x s = 1 -> hl_IN B (f x) t = 1) /\ ((forall y :e B, hl_IN B y t = 1 -> exists x :e A, hl_IN A x s = 1 /\ f x = y) /\ forall x y :e A, hl_IN A x s = 1 /\ (hl_IN A y s = 1 /\ f x = f y) -> x = y)

items.name: CARD_EQ_BIJECTIONS
items.source: !s:A->bool. !t:B->bool. FINITE s /\ FINITE t /\ CARD s = CARD t ==> (?f:A->B. ?g:B->A. (!x:A. x IN s ==> f x IN t /\ g (f x) = x) /\ (!y:B. y IN t ==> g y IN s /\ f (g y) = y))
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ (finite t /\ finite_cardinality s = finite_cardinality t) -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) /\ exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e A) /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e t /\ g (f x) = x) /\ forall y :e B, y :e t -> g y :e s /\ f (g y) = y)

items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, (s :\: t) :\: t = s :\: t
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t :e 2 :^: A, hl_DIFF A (hl_DIFF A s t) t = hl_DIFF A s t

items.name: DIFF_EMPTY
items.source: !s:A->bool. s DIFF EMPTY = s
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, s :\: Empty = s
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s :e 2 :^: A, hl_DIFF A s (hl_EMPTY A) = s

items.name: DIFF_EQ_EMPTY
items.source: !s:A->bool. s DIFF s = EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, s :\: s = Empty
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s :e 2 :^: A, hl_DIFF A s s = hl_EMPTY A

items.name: DIFF_INSERT
items.source: !s:A->bool. !t:A->bool. !x:A. s DIFF x INSERT t = s DELETE x DIFF t
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, forall x :e A, s :\: SetAdjoin t x = (s :\: {x}) :\: t
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t :e 2 :^: A, forall x :e A, hl_DIFF A s (hl_INSERT A x t) = hl_DIFF A (hl_DELETE A s x) t

items.name: DIFF_INTERS
items.source: !u:A->bool. !s:(A->bool)->bool. u DIFF INTERS s = UNIONS (GSPEC (\GEN%PVAR%64:A->bool. ?t:A->bool. SETSPEC GEN%PVAR%64 (t IN s) (u DIFF t)))
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u c= A, forall s c= Power A, u :\: {x :e A | forall Y :e s, x :e Y} = Union {u :\: t | t :e Power A, t :e s}
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u :e 2 :^: A, forall s :e 2 :^: (2 :^: A), hl_DIFF A u (hl_INTERS A s) = hl_UNIONS A (hl_GSPEC (2 :^: A) (fun GEN_PVAR_64 :e 2 :^: A => if exists t :e 2 :^: A, hl_SETSPEC (2 :^: A) GEN_PVAR_64 (hl_IN (2 :^: A) t s) (hl_DIFF A u t) = 1 then 1 else 0))

items.name: DIFF_RESTRICT
items.source: !P:A->bool. !s:A->bool. !t:A->bool. GSPEC (\GEN%PVAR%40:A. ?x:A. SETSPEC GEN%PVAR%40 (x IN s DIFF t /\ P x) x) = GSPEC (\GEN%PVAR%41:A. ?x:A. SETSPEC GEN%PVAR%41 (x IN s /\ P x) x) DIFF GSPEC (\GEN%PVAR%42:A. ?x:A. SETSPEC GEN%PVAR%42 (x IN t /\ P x) x)
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall s t c= A, {x :e A | x :e s :\: t /\ P x} = {x :e A | x :e s /\ P x} :\: {x :e A | x :e t /\ P x}
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P s t :e 2 :^: A, hl_GSPEC A (fun GEN_PVAR_40 :e A => if exists x :e A, hl_SETSPEC A GEN_PVAR_40 (if hl_IN A x (hl_DIFF A s t) = 1 /\ P x = 1 then 1 else 0) x = 1 then 1 else 0) = hl_DIFF A (hl_GSPEC A (fun GEN_PVAR_41 :e A => if exists x :e A, hl_SETSPEC A GEN_PVAR_41 (if hl_IN A x s = 1 /\ P x = 1 then 1 else 0) x = 1 then 1 else 0)) (hl_GSPEC A (fun GEN_PVAR_42 :e A => if exists x :e A, hl_SETSPEC A GEN_PVAR_42 (if hl_IN A x t = 1 /\ P x = 1 then 1 else 0) x = 1 then 1 else 0))

items.name: DIFF_UNIONS
items.source: !u:A->bool. !s:(A->bool)->bool. u DIFF UNIONS s = u INTER INTERS (GSPEC (\GEN%PVAR%68:A->bool. ?t:A->bool. SETSPEC GEN%PVAR%68 (t IN s) (u DIFF t)))
items.statement: forall A:set, forall u c= A, forall s c= Power A, u :\: Union s = u :/\: {x :e A | forall Y :e {u :\: t | t :e Power A, t :e s}, x :e Y}
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u :e 2 :^: A, forall s :e 2 :^: (2 :^: A), hl_DIFF A u (hl_UNIONS A s) = hl_INTER A u (hl_INTERS A (hl_GSPEC (2 :^: A) (fun GEN_PVAR_68 :e 2 :^: A => if exists t :e 2 :^: A, hl_SETSPEC (2 :^: A) GEN_PVAR_68 (hl_IN (2 :^: A) t s) (hl_DIFF A u t) = 1 then 1 else 0)))

items.name: DIFF_UNIONS_NONEMPTY
items.source: !u:A->bool. !s:(A->bool)->bool. ~(s = EMPTY) ==> u DIFF UNIONS s = INTERS (GSPEC (\GEN%PVAR%69:A->bool. ?t:A->bool. SETSPEC GEN%PVAR%69 (t IN s) (u DIFF t)))
items.statement: forall A:set, forall u c= A, forall s c= Power A, ~ s = Empty -> u :\: Union s = {x :e A | forall Y :e {u :\: t | t :e Power A, t :e s}, x :e Y}
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u :e 2 :^: A, forall s :e 2 :^: (2 :^: A), ~ s = hl_EMPTY (2 :^: A) -> hl_DIFF A u (hl_UNIONS A s) = hl_INTERS A (hl_GSPEC (2 :^: A) (fun GEN_PVAR_69 :e 2 :^: A => if exists t :e 2 :^: A, hl_SETSPEC (2 :^: A) GEN_PVAR_69 (hl_IN (2 :^: A) t s) (hl_DIFF A u t) = 1 then 1 else 0))

items.name: DIFF_UNIONS_PAIRWISE_DISJOINT
items.source: !s:(A->bool)->bool. !t:(A->bool)->bool. pairwise DISJOINT s /\ t SUBSET s ==> UNIONS s DIFF UNIONS t = UNIONS (s DIFF t)
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= Power A, (forall x y :e s, x <> y -> x :/\: y = Empty) /\ t c= s -> Union s :\: Union t = Union (s :\: t)
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t :e 2 :^: (2 :^: A), hl_pairwise (2 :^: A) (hl_DISJOINT A) s = 1 /\ hl_SUBSET (2 :^: A) t s = 1 -> hl_DIFF A (hl_UNIONS A s) (hl_UNIONS A t) = hl_UNIONS A (hl_DIFF (2 :^: A) s t)

items.name: DIFF_UNIV
items.source: !s:A->bool. s DIFF UNIV = EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, s :\: A = Empty
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s :e 2 :^: A, hl_DIFF A s (hl_UNIV A) = hl_EMPTY A

items.name: DIMINDEX_1
items.source: dimindex UNIV = 1
items.literal: hl_dimindex 1 (hl_UNIV 1) = hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT1 hl_zero)

items.name: DIMINDEX_2
items.source: dimindex UNIV = 2
items.literal: hl_dimindex (idx_n (2 * dimindex 1)) (hl_UNIV (idx_n (2 * dimindex 1))) = hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT0 (hl_BIT1 hl_zero))

items.name: DIMINDEX_3
items.source: dimindex UNIV = 3
items.literal: hl_dimindex (idx_n (2 * dimindex 1 + 1)) (hl_UNIV (idx_n (2 * dimindex 1 + 1))) = hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT1 (hl_BIT1 hl_zero))

items.name: DIMINDEX_4
items.source: dimindex UNIV = 4
items.literal: hl_dimindex (idx_n (2 * dimindex (idx_n (2 * dimindex 1)))) (hl_UNIV (idx_n (2 * dimindex (idx_n (2 * dimindex 1))))) = hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT0 (hl_BIT0 (hl_BIT1 hl_zero)))

items.name: DIMINDEX_CLAUSES
items.source: dimindex UNIV = 1 /\ dimindex UNIV = 2 * dimindex UNIV /\ dimindex UNIV = 2 * dimindex UNIV + 1
items.statement: forall A:set, 1 = 1 /\ (2 * dimindex A = 2 * dimindex A /\ 2 * dimindex A + 1 = 2 * dimindex A + 1)
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> hl_dimindex 1 (hl_UNIV 1) = hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT1 hl_zero) /\ (hl_dimindex (idx_n (2 * dimindex A)) (hl_UNIV (idx_n (2 * dimindex A))) = hl_mul (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT0 (hl_BIT1 hl_zero))) (hl_dimindex A (hl_UNIV A)) /\ hl_dimindex (idx_n (2 * dimindex A + 1)) (hl_UNIV (idx_n (2 * dimindex A + 1))) = hl_add (hl_mul (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT0 (hl_BIT1 hl_zero))) (hl_dimindex A (hl_UNIV A))) (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT1 hl_zero)))

items.name: DIMINDEX_FINITE_DIFF
items.source: dimindex UNIV = (if dimindex UNIV < dimindex UNIV then dimindex UNIV - dimindex UNIV else 1)
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> dimindex (idx_n (if dimindex N < dimindex M then minus_nat (dimindex M) (dimindex N) else 1)) = if dimindex N < dimindex M then minus_nat (dimindex M) (dimindex N) else 1
items.literal: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> hl_dimindex (hl_ty_finite_diff M N) (hl_UNIV (hl_ty_finite_diff M N)) = hl_COND omega (hl_lt (hl_dimindex N (hl_UNIV N)) (hl_dimindex M (hl_UNIV M))) (hl_sub (hl_dimindex M (hl_UNIV M)) (hl_dimindex N (hl_UNIV N))) (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT1 hl_zero))

items.name: DIMINDEX_FINITE_IMAGE
items.source: !s:A finite_image->bool. !t:A->bool. dimindex s = dimindex t
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> dimindex (idx A) = dimindex A
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s :e 2 :^: hl_ty_finite_image A, forall t :e 2 :^: A, hl_dimindex (hl_ty_finite_image A) s = hl_dimindex A t

items.name: DIMINDEX_FINITE_PROD
items.source: dimindex UNIV = dimindex UNIV * dimindex UNIV
items.statement: forall M N:set, dimindex M * dimindex N = dimindex M * dimindex N
items.literal: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> hl_dimindex (hl_ty_finite_prod M N) (hl_UNIV (hl_ty_finite_prod M N)) = hl_mul (hl_dimindex M (hl_UNIV M)) (hl_dimindex N (hl_UNIV N))

items.name: DIMINDEX_FINITE_SUM
items.source: dimindex UNIV = dimindex UNIV + dimindex UNIV
items.statement: forall M N:set, dimindex M + dimindex N = dimindex M + dimindex N
items.literal: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> hl_dimindex (hl_ty_finite_sum M N) (hl_UNIV (hl_ty_finite_sum M N)) = hl_add (hl_dimindex M (hl_UNIV M)) (hl_dimindex N (hl_UNIV N))

items.name: DIMINDEX_GE_1
items.source: !s:A->bool. 1 <= dimindex s
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> 1 <= dimindex A
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s :e 2 :^: A, hl_le (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT1 hl_zero)) (hl_dimindex A s) = 1

items.name: DIMINDEX_HAS_SIZE_FINITE_DIFF
items.source: HAS_SIZE UNIV (if dimindex UNIV < dimindex UNIV then dimindex UNIV - dimindex UNIV else 1)
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> equip (idx_n (if dimindex N < dimindex M then minus_nat (dimindex M) (dimindex N) else 1)) (if dimindex N < dimindex M then minus_nat (dimindex M) (dimindex N) else 1)
items.literal: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> hl_HAS_SIZE (hl_ty_finite_diff M N) (hl_UNIV (hl_ty_finite_diff M N)) (hl_COND omega (hl_lt (hl_dimindex N (hl_UNIV N)) (hl_dimindex M (hl_UNIV M))) (hl_sub (hl_dimindex M (hl_UNIV M)) (hl_dimindex N (hl_UNIV N))) (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT1 hl_zero))) = 1

items.name: DIMINDEX_HAS_SIZE_FINITE_PROD
items.source: HAS_SIZE UNIV (dimindex UNIV * dimindex UNIV)
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> equip (idx_n (dimindex M * dimindex N)) (dimindex M * dimindex N)
items.literal: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> hl_HAS_SIZE (hl_ty_finite_prod M N) (hl_UNIV (hl_ty_finite_prod M N)) (hl_mul (hl_dimindex M (hl_UNIV M)) (hl_dimindex N (hl_UNIV N))) = 1

items.name: DIMINDEX_HAS_SIZE_FINITE_SUM
items.source: HAS_SIZE UNIV (dimindex UNIV + dimindex UNIV)
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> equip (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (dimindex M + dimindex N)
items.literal: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> hl_HAS_SIZE (hl_ty_finite_sum M N) (hl_UNIV (hl_ty_finite_sum M N)) (hl_add (hl_dimindex M (hl_UNIV M)) (hl_dimindex N (hl_UNIV N))) = 1

items.name: DIMINDEX_NONZERO
items.source: !s:A->bool. ~(dimindex s = 0)
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> ~ dimindex A = 0
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s :e 2 :^: A, ~ hl_dimindex A s = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero

items.name: DIMINDEX_TYBIT0
items.source: dimindex UNIV = 2 * dimindex UNIV
items.statement: forall A:set, 2 * dimindex A = 2 * dimindex A
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> hl_dimindex (idx_n (2 * dimindex A)) (hl_UNIV (idx_n (2 * dimindex A))) = hl_mul (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT0 (hl_BIT1 hl_zero))) (hl_dimindex A (hl_UNIV A))

items.name: DIMINDEX_TYBIT1
items.source: dimindex UNIV = 2 * dimindex UNIV + 1
items.statement: forall A:set, 2 * dimindex A + 1 = 2 * dimindex A + 1
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> hl_dimindex (idx_n (2 * dimindex A + 1)) (hl_UNIV (idx_n (2 * dimindex A + 1))) = hl_add (hl_mul (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT0 (hl_BIT1 hl_zero))) (hl_dimindex A (hl_UNIV A))) (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT1 hl_zero))

items.name: DIMINDEX_UNIQUE
items.source: HAS_SIZE UNIV n ==> dimindex UNIV = n
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall n :e omega, equip A n -> dimindex A = n
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall n :e omega, hl_HAS_SIZE A (hl_UNIV A) n = 1 -> hl_dimindex A (hl_UNIV A) = n

items.name: DIMINDEX_UNIV
items.source: !s:A->bool. dimindex s = dimindex UNIV
items.statement: forall A:set, dimindex A = dimindex A
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s :e 2 :^: A, hl_dimindex A s = hl_dimindex A (hl_UNIV A)

items.name: DISJOINT
items.source: !s:A->bool. !t:A->bool. DISJOINT s t <=> s INTER t = EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, s :/\: t = Empty <-> s :/\: t = Empty
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t :e 2 :^: A, hl_DISJOINT A s t = 1 <-> hl_INTER A s t = hl_EMPTY A

items.name: DISJOINT_CROSS
items.source: !s:A->bool. !t:B->bool. !s':A->bool. !t':B->bool. DISJOINT (CROSS s t) (CROSS s' t') <=> DISJOINT s s' \/ DISJOINT t t'
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall s' c= A, forall t' c= B, (s :*: t) :/\: (s' :*: t') = Empty <-> s :/\: s' = Empty \/ t :/\: t' = Empty
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s :e 2 :^: A, forall t :e 2 :^: B, forall s' :e 2 :^: A, forall t' :e 2 :^: B, hl_DISJOINT (A :*: B) (hl_CROSS A B s t) (hl_CROSS A B s' t') = 1 <-> hl_DISJOINT A s s' = 1 \/ hl_DISJOINT B t t' = 1

items.name: DISJOINT_DELETE_SYM
items.source: !s:A->bool. !t:A->bool. !x:A. DISJOINT (s DELETE x) t <=> DISJOINT (t DELETE x) s
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, forall x :e A, (s :\: {x}) :/\: t = Empty <-> (t :\: {x}) :/\: s = Empty
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t :e 2 :^: A, forall x :e A, hl_DISJOINT A (hl_DELETE A s x) t = 1 <-> hl_DISJOINT A (hl_DELETE A t x) s = 1

items.name: DISJOINT_DISJOINT_UNION
items.source: !k:K->bool. !s:K->A->bool. !t:K->A->bool. DISJOINT (disjoint_union k s) (disjoint_union k t) <=> (!i:K. i IN k ==> DISJOINT (s i) (t i))
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall s t :e Power A :^: K, {p :e K :*: A | p 0 :e k /\ p 1 :e s (p 0)} :/\: {p :e K :*: A | p 0 :e k /\ p 1 :e t (p 0)} = Empty <-> forall i :e K, i :e k -> s i :/\: t i = Empty
items.literal: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k :e 2 :^: K, forall s t :e 2 :^: A :^: K, hl_DISJOINT (K :*: A) (hl_disjoint_union K A k s) (hl_disjoint_union K A k t) = 1 <-> forall i :e K, hl_IN K i k = 1 -> hl_DISJOINT A (s i) (t i) = 1

items.name: DISJOINT_EMPTY
items.source: !s:A->bool. DISJOINT EMPTY s /\ DISJOINT s EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, Empty :/\: s = Empty /\ s :/\: Empty = Empty
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s :e 2 :^: A, hl_DISJOINT A (hl_EMPTY A) s = 1 /\ hl_DISJOINT A s (hl_EMPTY A) = 1

items.name: DISJOINT_EMPTY_REFL
items.source: !s:A->bool. s = EMPTY <=> DISJOINT s s
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, s = Empty <-> s :/\: s = Empty
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s :e 2 :^: A, s = hl_EMPTY A <-> hl_DISJOINT A s s = 1

items.name: DISJOINT_INSERT
items.source: !x:A. !s:A->bool. !t:A->bool. DISJOINT (x INSERT s) t <=> DISJOINT s t /\ ~(x IN t)
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall s t c= A, SetAdjoin s x :/\: t = Empty <-> s :/\: t = Empty /\ ~ x :e t
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e A, forall s t :e 2 :^: A, hl_DISJOINT A (hl_INSERT A x s) t = 1 <-> hl_DISJOINT A s t = 1 /\ ~ hl_IN A x t = 1

items.name: DISJOINT_NUMSEG
items.source: !m:num. !n:num. !p:num. !q:num. DISJOINT (.. m n) (.. p q) <=> n < p \/ q < m \/ n < m \/ q < p
items.statement: forall m n p q :e omega, {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} :/\: {i :e omega | p <= i /\ i <= q} = Empty <-> n < p \/ (q < m \/ (n < m \/ q < p))
items.literal: forall m n p q :e omega, hl_DISJOINT omega (hl_numseg m n) (hl_numseg p q) = 1 <-> hl_lt n p = 1 \/ (hl_lt q m = 1 \/ (hl_lt n m = 1 \/ hl_lt q p = 1))

items.name: DISJOINT_PCROSS
items.source: !s:(A,M)cart->bool. !t:(A,N)cart->bool. !s':(A,M)cart->bool. !t':(A,N)cart->bool. DISJOINT (PCROSS s t) (PCROSS s' t') <=> DISJOINT s s' \/ DISJOINT t t'
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= A :^: idx M, forall t c= A :^: idx N, forall s' c= A :^: idx M, forall t' c= A :^: idx N, (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) :/\: (\/_ x :e s', {pastecart M N x y | y :e t'}) = Empty <-> s :/\: s' = Empty \/ t :/\: t' = Empty
items.literal: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s :e 2 :^: hl_ty_cart A M, forall t :e 2 :^: hl_ty_cart A N, forall s' :e 2 :^: hl_ty_cart A M, forall t' :e 2 :^: hl_ty_cart A N, hl_DISJOINT (hl_ty_cart A (hl_ty_finite_sum M N)) (hl_PCROSS A M N s t) (hl_PCROSS A M N s' t') = 1 <-> hl_DISJOINT (hl_ty_cart A M) s s' = 1 \/ hl_DISJOINT (hl_ty_cart A N) t t' = 1

items.name: DISJOINT_SING
items.source: (!s:A->bool. !a:A. DISJOINT s (a INSERT EMPTY) <=> ~(a IN s)) /\ (!s:A->bool. !a:A. DISJOINT (a INSERT EMPTY) s <=> ~(a IN s))
items.statement: forall A:set, (forall s c= A, forall a :e A, s :/\: {a} = Empty <-> ~ a :e s) /\ forall s c= A, forall a :e A, {a} :/\: s = Empty <-> ~ a :e s
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> (forall s :e 2 :^: A, forall a :e A, hl_DISJOINT A s (hl_INSERT A a (hl_EMPTY A)) = 1 <-> ~ hl_IN A a s = 1) /\ forall s :e 2 :^: A, forall a :e A, hl_DISJOINT A (hl_INSERT A a (hl_EMPTY A)) s = 1 <-> ~ hl_IN A a s = 1

items.name: DISJOINT_SYM
items.source: !s:A->bool. !t:A->bool. DISJOINT s t <=> DISJOINT t s
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, s :/\: t = Empty <-> t :/\: s = Empty
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t :e 2 :^: A, hl_DISJOINT A s t = 1 <-> hl_DISJOINT A t s = 1

items.name: DISJOINT_UNION
items.source: !s:A->bool. !t:A->bool. !u:A->bool. DISJOINT (s UNION t) u <=> DISJOINT s u /\ DISJOINT t u
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t u c= A, (s :\/: t) :/\: u = Empty <-> s :/\: u = Empty /\ t :/\: u = Empty
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t u :e 2 :^: A, hl_DISJOINT A (hl_UNION A s t) u = 1 <-> hl_DISJOINT A s u = 1 /\ hl_DISJOINT A t u = 1

items.name: DISJOINT_UNION_EQ
items.source: !k:K->bool. !s:K->A->bool. !t:K->A->bool. disjoint_union k s = disjoint_union k t <=> (!i:K. i IN k ==> s i = t i)
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall s t :e Power A :^: K, {p :e K :*: A | p 0 :e k /\ p 1 :e s (p 0)} = {p :e K :*: A | p 0 :e k /\ p 1 :e t (p 0)} <-> forall i :e K, i :e k -> s i = t i
items.literal: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k :e 2 :^: K, forall s t :e 2 :^: A :^: K, hl_disjoint_union K A k s = hl_disjoint_union K A k t <-> forall i :e K, hl_IN K i k = 1 -> s i = t i

items.name: DISJOINT_UNION_EQ_EMPTY
items.source: !k:K->bool. !s:K->A->bool. disjoint_union k s = EMPTY <=> (!i:K. i IN k ==> s i = EMPTY)
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall s :e Power A :^: K, {p :e K :*: A | p 0 :e k /\ p 1 :e s (p 0)} = Empty <-> forall i :e K, i :e k -> s i = Empty
items.literal: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k :e 2 :^: K, forall s :e 2 :^: A :^: K, hl_disjoint_union K A k s = hl_EMPTY (K :*: A) <-> forall i :e K, hl_IN K i k = 1 -> s i = hl_EMPTY A

items.name: DISJ_ASSOC

items.name: DIST_ADD2

items.name: DIST_ADDBOUND

items.name: DIST_ELIM_THM
items.source: P (dist (x , y)) <=> (!d:num. (x = y + d ==> P d) /\ (y = x + d ==> P d))
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, forall x y :e omega, P (abs_SNo (x + - y)) <-> forall d :e omega, (x = y + d -> P d) /\ (y = x + d -> P d)

items.name: DIST_EQ_0

items.name: DIST_LE_CASES

items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, abs_SNo (m + - n) <= p <-> m <= n + p /\ n <= m + p
items.literal: forall m n p :e omega, hl_le (hl_dist (hl_pair omega omega m n)) p = 1 <-> hl_le m (hl_add n p) = 1 /\ hl_le n (hl_add m p) = 1

items.name: DIST_LMUL

items.name: DIST_RMUL
items.source: !m:num. !n:num. !p:num. dist (m , n) * p = dist (m * p , n * p)
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, abs_SNo (m + - n) * p = abs_SNo (m * p + - n * p)
items.literal: forall m n p :e omega, hl_mul (hl_dist (hl_pair omega omega m n)) p = hl_dist (hl_pair omega omega (hl_mul m p) (hl_mul n p))

items.source: !n:num. dist (n , 0) = n

items.name: DIST_TRIANGLE
items.source: !m:num. !n:num. !p:num. dist (m , p) <= dist (m , n) + dist (n , p)
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, abs_SNo (m + - p) <= abs_SNo (m + - n) + abs_SNo (n + - p)
items.literal: forall m n p :e omega, hl_le (hl_dist (hl_pair omega omega m p)) (hl_add (hl_dist (hl_pair omega omega m n)) (hl_dist (hl_pair omega omega n p))) = 1

items.name: DIST_TRIANGLES_LE
items.source: !m:num. !n:num. !p:num. !q:num. !r:num. !s:num. dist (m , n) <= r /\ dist (p , q) <= s ==> dist (m , p) <= dist (n , q) + r + s
items.statement: forall m n p q r s :e omega, abs_SNo (m + - n) <= r /\ abs_SNo (p + - q) <= s -> abs_SNo (m + - p) <= abs_SNo (n + - q) + r + s
items.literal: forall m n p q r s :e omega, hl_le (hl_dist (hl_pair omega omega m n)) r = 1 /\ hl_le (hl_dist (hl_pair omega omega p q)) s = 1 -> hl_le (hl_dist (hl_pair omega omega m p)) (hl_add (hl_dist (hl_pair omega omega n q)) (hl_add r s)) = 1

items.name: DIST_TRIANGLE_LE
items.source: !m:num. !n:num. !p:num. !q:num. dist (m , n) + dist (n , p) <= q ==> dist (m , p) <= q
items.statement: forall m n p q :e omega, abs_SNo (m + - n) + abs_SNo (n + - p) <= q -> abs_SNo (m + - p) <= q
items.literal: forall m n p q :e omega, hl_le (hl_add (hl_dist (hl_pair omega omega m n)) (hl_dist (hl_pair omega omega n p))) q = 1 -> hl_le (hl_dist (hl_pair omega omega m p)) q = 1

items.name: DIVIDES_ANTISYM
items.source: !m:num. !n:num. num_divides m n /\ num_divides n m <=> m = n
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, divides_nat m n /\ divides_nat n m <-> m = n
items.literal: forall m n :e omega, hl_num_divides m n = 1 /\ hl_num_divides n m = 1 <-> m = n

items.name: DIVIDES_DIVIDES_DIV
items.source: !n:num. !d:num. !e:num. num_divides d n ==> (num_divides e (n DIV d) <=> num_divides (d * e) n)
items.statement: forall n d e0 :e omega, divides_nat d n -> (divides_nat e0 (div_nat n d) <-> divides_nat (d * e0) n)
items.literal: forall n d e1 :e omega, hl_num_divides d n = 1 -> (hl_num_divides e1 (hl_DIV n d) = 1 <-> hl_num_divides (hl_mul d e1) n = 1)

items.name: DIVIDES_DIVIDES_DIV_EQ
items.source: !n:num. !d:num. !e:num. num_divides d n /\ num_divides e (n DIV d) <=> num_divides (d * e) n
items.statement: forall n d e0 :e omega, divides_nat d n /\ divides_nat e0 (div_nat n d) <-> divides_nat (d * e0) n
items.literal: forall n d e1 :e omega, hl_num_divides d n = 1 /\ hl_num_divides e1 (hl_DIV n d) = 1 <-> hl_num_divides (hl_mul d e1) n = 1

items.name: DIVIDES_DIVIDES_DIV_IMP
items.source: !n:num. !d:num. !e:num. num_divides (d * e) n ==> num_divides e (n DIV d)
items.statement: forall n d e0 :e omega, divides_nat (d * e0) n -> divides_nat e0 (div_nat n d)
items.literal: forall n d e1 :e omega, hl_num_divides (hl_mul d e1) n = 1 -> hl_num_divides e1 (hl_DIV n d) = 1

items.name: DIVIDES_DIV_DIVIDES
items.source: !n:num. !d:num. !e:num. num_divides d n /\ (n = 0 ==> e = 0) ==> (num_divides (n DIV d) e <=> num_divides n (d * e))
items.statement: forall n d e0 :e omega, divides_nat d n /\ (n = 0 -> e0 = 0) -> (divides_nat (div_nat n d) e0 <-> divides_nat n (d * e0))
items.literal: forall n d e1 :e omega, hl_num_divides d n = 1 /\ (n = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero -> e1 = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero) -> (hl_num_divides (hl_DIV n d) e1 = 1 <-> hl_num_divides n (hl_mul d e1) = 1)

items.name: DIVIDES_DIV_MULT
items.source: !m:num. !n:num. num_divides m n <=> n DIV m * m = n
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, divides_nat m n <-> div_nat n m * m = n
items.literal: forall m n :e omega, hl_num_divides m n = 1 <-> hl_mul (hl_DIV n m) m = n

items.name: DIVIDES_DIV_SELF
items.source: !n:num. !d:num. num_divides d n ==> num_divides (n DIV d) n
items.statement: forall n d :e omega, divides_nat d n -> divides_nat (div_nat n d) n
items.literal: forall n d :e omega, hl_num_divides d n = 1 -> hl_num_divides (hl_DIV n d) n = 1

items.name: DIVIDES_LE
items.source: !m:num. !n:num. num_divides m n ==> m <= n \/ n = 0
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, divides_nat m n -> m <= n \/ n = 0
items.literal: forall m n :e omega, hl_num_divides m n = 1 -> hl_le m n = 1 \/ n = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero

items.name: DIVIDES_LE_IMP
items.source: !m:num. !n:num. num_divides m n /\ (n = 0 ==> m = 0) ==> m <= n
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, divides_nat m n /\ (n = 0 -> m = 0) -> m <= n
items.literal: forall m n :e omega, hl_num_divides m n = 1 /\ (n = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero -> m = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero) -> hl_le m n = 1

items.name: DIVIDES_LE_STRONG
items.source: !m:num. !n:num. num_divides m n ==> 1 <= m /\ m <= n \/ n = 0
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, divides_nat m n -> 1 <= m /\ m <= n \/ n = 0
items.literal: forall m n :e omega, hl_num_divides m n = 1 -> hl_le (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT1 hl_zero)) m = 1 /\ hl_le m n = 1 \/ n = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero

items.name: DIVIDES_MOD
items.source: !m:num. !n:num. num_divides m n <=> n MOD m = 0
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, divides_nat m n <-> mod_nat n m = 0
items.literal: forall m n :e omega, hl_num_divides m n = 1 <-> hl_MOD n m = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero

items.name: DIVIDES_ONE

items.statement: forall n :e omega, divides_nat n 1 <-> n = 1

items.name: DIVISION
items.source: !m:num. !n:num. ~(n = 0) ==> m = m DIV n * n + m MOD n /\ m MOD n < n
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, ~ n = 0 -> m = div_nat m n * n + mod_nat m n /\ mod_nat m n < n
items.literal: forall m n :e omega, ~ n = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero -> m = hl_add (hl_mul (hl_DIV m n) n) (hl_MOD m n) /\ hl_lt (hl_MOD m n) n = 1

items.name: DIVISION_0
items.source: !m:num. !n:num. if n = 0 then m DIV n = 0 /\ m MOD n = m else m = m DIV n * n + m MOD n /\ m MOD n < n
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, (n = 0 -> div_nat m n = 0 /\ mod_nat m n = m) /\ (~ n = 0 -> m = div_nat m n * n + mod_nat m n /\ mod_nat m n < n)
items.literal: forall m n :e omega, n = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero /\ (hl_DIV m n = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero /\ hl_MOD m n = m) \/ ~ n = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero /\ (m = hl_add (hl_mul (hl_DIV m n) n) (hl_MOD m n) /\ hl_lt (hl_MOD m n) n = 1)

items.name: DIVISION_SIMP
items.source: (!m:num. !n:num. m DIV n * n + m MOD n = m) /\ (!m:num. !n:num. n * m DIV n + m MOD n = m)
items.statement: (forall m n :e omega, div_nat m n * n + mod_nat m n = m) /\ forall m n :e omega, n * div_nat m n + mod_nat m n = m
items.literal: (forall m n :e omega, hl_add (hl_mul (hl_DIV m n) n) (hl_MOD m n) = m) /\ forall m n :e omega, hl_add (hl_mul n (hl_DIV m n)) (hl_MOD m n) = m

items.name: DIVMOD_ELIM_THM
items.source: P (m DIV n) (m MOD n) <=> (!q:num. !r:num. n = 0 /\ q = 0 /\ r = m \/ m = q * n + r /\ r < n ==> P q r)
items.statement: forall P:set -> set -> prop, forall m n :e omega, P (div_nat m n) (mod_nat m n) <-> forall q r :e omega, n = 0 /\ (q = 0 /\ r = m) \/ m = q * n + r /\ r < n -> P q r
items.literal: forall P :e 2 :^: omega :^: omega, forall m n :e omega, P (hl_DIV m n) (hl_MOD m n) = 1 <-> forall q r :e omega, n = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero /\ (q = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero /\ r = m) \/ m = hl_add (hl_mul q n) r /\ hl_lt r n = 1 -> P q r = 1

items.name: DIVMOD_ELIM_THM'
items.source: P (m DIV n) (m MOD n) <=> (?q:num. ?r:num. (n = 0 /\ q = 0 /\ r = m \/ m = q * n + r /\ r < n) /\ P q r)
items.statement: forall P:set -> set -> prop, forall m n :e omega, P (div_nat m n) (mod_nat m n) <-> exists q r :e omega, (n = 0 /\ (q = 0 /\ r = m) \/ m = q * n + r /\ r < n) /\ P q r
items.literal: forall P :e 2 :^: omega :^: omega, forall m n :e omega, P (hl_DIV m n) (hl_MOD m n) = 1 <-> exists q r :e omega, (n = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero /\ (q = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero /\ r = m) \/ m = hl_add (hl_mul q n) r /\ hl_lt r n = 1) /\ P q r = 1

items.name: DIVMOD_EXIST
items.source: !m:num. !n:num. ~(n = 0) ==> (?q:num. ?r:num. m = q * n + r /\ r < n)
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, ~ n = 0 -> exists q r :e omega, m = q * n + r /\ r < n
items.literal: forall m n :e omega, ~ n = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero -> exists q r :e omega, m = hl_add (hl_mul q n) r /\ hl_lt r n = 1

items.name: DIVMOD_EXIST_0
items.source: !m:num. !n:num. ?q:num. ?r:num. if n = 0 then q = 0 /\ r = m else m = q * n + r /\ r < n
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, exists q r :e omega, (n = 0 -> q = 0 /\ r = m) /\ (~ n = 0 -> m = q * n + r /\ r < n)
items.literal: forall m n :e omega, exists q r :e omega, n = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero /\ (q = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero /\ r = m) \/ ~ n = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero /\ (m = hl_add (hl_mul q n) r /\ hl_lt r n = 1)

items.name: DIVMOD_UNIQ
items.source: !m:num. !n:num. !q:num. !r:num. m = q * n + r /\ r < n ==> m DIV n = q /\ m MOD n = r
items.statement: forall m n q r :e omega, m = q * n + r /\ r < n -> div_nat m n = q /\ mod_nat m n = r
items.literal: forall m n q r :e omega, m = hl_add (hl_mul q n) r /\ hl_lt r n = 1 -> hl_DIV m n = q /\ hl_MOD m n = r

items.name: DIVMOD_UNIQ_LEMMA
items.source: !m:num. !n:num. !q1:num. !r1:num. !q2:num. !r2:num. (m = q1 * n + r1 /\ r1 < n) /\ m = q2 * n + r2 /\ r2 < n ==> q1 = q2 /\ r1 = r2
items.statement: forall m n q1 r1 q2 r2 :e omega, m = q1 * n + r1 /\ r1 < n /\ (m = q2 * n + r2 /\ r2 < n) -> q1 = q2 /\ r1 = r2
items.literal: forall m n q1 r1 q2 r2 :e omega, m = hl_add (hl_mul q1 n) r1 /\ hl_lt r1 n = 1 /\ (m = hl_add (hl_mul q2 n) r2 /\ hl_lt r2 n = 1) -> q1 = q2 /\ r1 = r2

items.name: DIV_0
items.source: !n:num. 0 DIV n = 0
items.statement: forall n :e omega, div_nat 0 n = 0
items.literal: forall n :e omega, hl_DIV (hl_NUMERAL hl_zero) n = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero

items.name: DIV_1
items.source: !n:num. n DIV 1 = n
items.statement: forall n :e omega, div_nat n 1 = n
items.literal: forall n :e omega, hl_DIV n (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT1 hl_zero)) = n

items.name: DIV_ADD
items.source: !d:num. !a:num. !b:num. num_divides d a \/ num_divides d b ==> (a + b) DIV d = a DIV d + b DIV d
items.statement: forall d a b :e omega, divides_nat d a \/ divides_nat d b -> div_nat (a + b) d = div_nat a d + div_nat b d
items.literal: forall d a b :e omega, hl_num_divides d a = 1 \/ hl_num_divides d b = 1 -> hl_DIV (hl_add a b) d = hl_add (hl_DIV a d) (hl_DIV b d)

items.name: DIV_ADD_EQ
items.source: !n:num. !x:num. !y:num. x MOD n + y MOD n < n ==> (x + y) DIV n = x DIV n + y DIV n
items.statement: forall n x y :e omega, mod_nat x n + mod_nat y n < n -> div_nat (x + y) n = div_nat x n + div_nat y n
items.literal: forall n x y :e omega, hl_lt (hl_add (hl_MOD x n) (hl_MOD y n)) n = 1 -> hl_DIV (hl_add x y) n = hl_add (hl_DIV x n) (hl_DIV y n)

items.name: DIV_ADD_EQ_EQ
items.source: !n:num. !x:num. !y:num. (x + y) DIV n = x DIV n + y DIV n <=> n = 0 \/ x MOD n + y MOD n < n
items.statement: forall n x y :e omega, div_nat (x + y) n = div_nat x n + div_nat y n <-> n = 0 \/ mod_nat x n + mod_nat y n < n
items.literal: forall n x y :e omega, hl_DIV (hl_add x y) n = hl_add (hl_DIV x n) (hl_DIV y n) <-> n = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero \/ hl_lt (hl_add (hl_MOD x n) (hl_MOD y n)) n = 1

items.name: DIV_ADD_MOD
items.source: !a:num. !b:num. !n:num. ~(n = 0) ==> ((a + b) MOD n = a MOD n + b MOD n <=> (a + b) DIV n = a DIV n + b DIV n)
items.statement: forall a b n :e omega, ~ n = 0 -> (mod_nat (a + b) n = mod_nat a n + mod_nat b n <-> div_nat (a + b) n = div_nat a n + div_nat b n)
items.literal: forall a b n :e omega, ~ n = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero -> (hl_MOD (hl_add a b) n = hl_add (hl_MOD a n) (hl_MOD b n) <-> hl_DIV (hl_add a b) n = hl_add (hl_DIV a n) (hl_DIV b n))

items.name: DIV_BY_DIV
items.source: !m:num. !n:num. ~(n = 0) /\ num_divides m n ==> n DIV (n DIV m) = m
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, ~ n = 0 /\ divides_nat m n -> div_nat n (div_nat n m) = m
items.literal: forall m n :e omega, ~ n = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero /\ hl_num_divides m n = 1 -> hl_DIV n (hl_DIV n m) = m

items.name: DIV_DIV
items.source: !m:num. !n:num. !p:num. m DIV n DIV p = m DIV (n * p)
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, div_nat (div_nat m n) p = div_nat m (n * p)
items.literal: forall m n p :e omega, hl_DIV (hl_DIV m n) p = hl_DIV m (hl_mul n p)

items.name: DIV_EQ_0
items.source: !m:num. !n:num. ~(n = 0) ==> (m DIV n = 0 <=> m < n)
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, ~ n = 0 -> (div_nat m n = 0 <-> m < n)
items.literal: forall m n :e omega, ~ n = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero -> (hl_DIV m n = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero <-> hl_lt m n = 1)

items.name: DIV_EQ_EXCLUSION
items.source: !a:num. !b:num. !c:num. !d:num. b * c < (a + 1) * d /\ a * d < (c + 1) * b ==> a DIV b = c DIV d
items.statement: forall a b c d :e omega, b * c < (a + 1) * d /\ a * d < (c + 1) * b -> div_nat a b = div_nat c d

items.name: DIV_EXP

items.name: EVEN
items.source: (EVEN 0 <=> T) /\ (!n:num. EVEN (SUC n) <=> ~EVEN n)
items.statement: (even_nat 0 <-> True) /\ forall n :e omega, even_nat (ordsucc n) <-> ~ even_nat n
items.literal: (hl_EVEN (hl_NUMERAL hl_zero) = 1 <-> True) /\ forall n :e omega, hl_EVEN (hl_SUC n) = 1 <-> ~ hl_EVEN n = 1

items.name: EVEN_ADD
items.source: !m:num. !n:num. EVEN (m + n) <=> EVEN m <=> EVEN n
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, even_nat (m + n) <-> (even_nat m <-> even_nat n)
items.literal: forall m n :e omega, hl_EVEN (hl_add m n) = 1 <-> (hl_EVEN m = 1 <-> hl_EVEN n = 1)

items.name: EVEN_AND_ODD
items.source: !n:num. ~(EVEN n /\ ODD n)
items.statement: forall n :e omega, ~ (even_nat n /\ odd_nat n)
items.literal: forall n :e omega, ~ (hl_EVEN n = 1 /\ hl_ODD n = 1)

items.name: EVEN_DOUBLE
items.source: !n:num. EVEN (2 * n)
items.statement: forall n :e omega, even_nat (2 * n)
items.literal: forall n :e omega, hl_EVEN (hl_mul (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT0 (hl_BIT1 hl_zero))) n) = 1

items.name: EVEN_EXISTS
items.source: !n:num. EVEN n <=> (?m:num. n = 2 * m)
items.statement: forall n :e omega, even_nat n <-> exists m :e omega, n = 2 * m
items.literal: forall n :e omega, hl_EVEN n = 1 <-> exists m :e omega, n = hl_mul (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT0 (hl_BIT1 hl_zero))) m

items.name: EVEN_EXISTS_LEMMA
items.source: !n:num. (EVEN n ==> (?m:num. n = 2 * m)) /\ (~EVEN n ==> (?m:num. n = SUC (2 * m)))
items.statement: forall n :e omega, (even_nat n -> (exists m :e omega, n = 2 * m)) /\ (~ even_nat n -> exists m :e omega, n = ordsucc (2 * m))
items.literal: forall n :e omega, (hl_EVEN n = 1 -> (exists m :e omega, n = hl_mul (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT0 (hl_BIT1 hl_zero))) m)) /\ (~ hl_EVEN n = 1 -> exists m :e omega, n = hl_SUC (hl_mul (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT0 (hl_BIT1 hl_zero))) m))

items.name: EVEN_EXP
items.source: !m:num. !n:num. EVEN (m EXP n) <=> EVEN m /\ ~(n = 0)
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, even_nat (m ^ n) <-> even_nat m /\ ~ n = 0
items.literal: forall m n :e omega, hl_EVEN (hl_EXP m n) = 1 <-> hl_EVEN m = 1 /\ ~ n = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero

items.name: EVEN_MOD
items.source: !n:num. EVEN n <=> n MOD 2 = 0
items.statement: forall n :e omega, even_nat n <-> mod_nat n 2 = 0
items.literal: forall n :e omega, hl_EVEN n = 1 <-> hl_MOD n (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT0 (hl_BIT1 hl_zero))) = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero

items.name: EVEN_MOD_EVEN
items.source: !m:num. !n:num. EVEN n ==> (EVEN (m MOD n) <=> EVEN m)
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, even_nat n -> (even_nat (mod_nat m n) <-> even_nat m)
items.literal: forall m n :e omega, hl_EVEN n = 1 -> (hl_EVEN (hl_MOD m n) = 1 <-> hl_EVEN m = 1)

items.name: EVEN_MULT
items.source: !m:num. !n:num. EVEN (m * n) <=> EVEN m \/ EVEN n
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, even_nat (m * n) <-> even_nat m \/ even_nat n
items.literal: forall m n :e omega, hl_EVEN (hl_mul m n) = 1 <-> hl_EVEN m = 1 \/ hl_EVEN n = 1

items.name: EVEN_ODD_DECOMPOSITION
items.source: !n:num. (?k:num. ?m:num. ODD m /\ n = 2 EXP k * m) <=> ~(n = 0)
items.statement: forall n :e omega, (exists k m :e omega, odd_nat m /\ n = 2 ^ k * m) <-> ~ n = 0
items.literal: forall n :e omega, (exists k m :e omega, hl_ODD m = 1 /\ n = hl_mul (hl_EXP (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT0 (hl_BIT1 hl_zero))) k) m) <-> ~ n = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero

items.name: EVEN_OR_ODD
items.source: !n:num. EVEN n \/ ODD n
items.statement: forall n :e omega, even_nat n \/ odd_nat n
items.literal: forall n :e omega, hl_EVEN n = 1 \/ hl_ODD n = 1

items.name: EVEN_SUB
items.source: !m:num. !n:num. EVEN (m - n) <=> m <= n \/ (EVEN m <=> EVEN n)
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, even_nat (minus_nat m n) <-> m <= n \/ (even_nat m <-> even_nat n)
items.literal: forall m n :e omega, hl_EVEN (hl_sub m n) = 1 <-> hl_le m n = 1 \/ (hl_EVEN m = 1 <-> hl_EVEN n = 1)

items.name: EX
items.source: (EX P NIL <=> F) /\ (EX P (h CONS t) <=> P h \/ EX P t)
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall h :e A, forall t :e finseq A, (seq_ex P seq_nil <-> False) /\ (seq_ex P (seq_cons h t) <-> P h \/ seq_ex P t)
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P :e 2 :^: A, forall h :e A, forall t :e finseq A, (hl_EX A P (hl_NIL A) = 1 <-> False) /\ (hl_EX A P (hl_CONS A h t) = 1 <-> P h = 1 \/ hl_EX A P t = 1)

items.name: EXCLUDED_MIDDLE
items.source: !t:bool. t \/ ~t
items.statement: forall t:prop, t \/ ~ t
items.literal: forall t :e 2, t = 1 \/ ~ t = 1

items.name: EXISTS_BOOL_THM
items.source: (?b:bool. P b) <=> P T \/ P F
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, (exists b:prop, P (if b then 1 else 0)) <-> P (if True then 1 else 0) \/ P (if False then 1 else 0)
items.literal: forall P :e 2 :^: 2, (exists b :e 2, P b = 1) <-> P (if True then 1 else 0) = 1 \/ P (if False then 1 else 0) = 1

items.name: EXISTS_CARTESIAN_PRODUCT_ELEMENT
items.source: !P:K->A->bool. !k:K->bool. !s:K->A->bool. (?z:K->A. z IN cartesian_product k s /\ (!i:K. i IN k ==> P i (z i))) <=> (!i:K. i IN k ==> (?x:A. x IN s i /\ P i x))
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall P:set -> set -> prop, forall k c= K, forall s :e Power A :^: K, (exists z :e A :^: K, z :e {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => False)} /\ forall i :e K, i :e k -> P i (z i)) <-> forall i :e K, i :e k -> exists x :e A, x :e s i /\ P i x
items.literal: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall P :e 2 :^: A :^: K, forall k :e 2 :^: K, forall s :e 2 :^: A :^: K, (exists z :e A :^: K, hl_IN (A :^: K) z (hl_cartesian_product K A k s) = 1 /\ forall i :e K, hl_IN K i k = 1 -> P i (z i) = 1) <-> forall i :e K, hl_IN K i k = 1 -> exists x :e A, hl_IN A x (s i) = 1 /\ P i x = 1

items.name: EXISTS_CURRY
items.source: !P:(A#B->C)->bool. (?f:A#B->C. P f) <=> (?f:A->B->C. P (GABS (\f1:A#B->C. !a:A. !b:B. GEQ (f1 (a , b)) (f a b))))
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (exists f :e C :^: (A :*: B), P f) <-> exists f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, f x y :e C) /\ P (fun p :e A :*: B => f (p 0) (p 1))
items.literal: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall P :e 2 :^: (C :^: (A :*: B)), (exists f :e C :^: (A :*: B), P f = 1) <-> exists f :e C :^: B :^: A, P (hl_GABS (C :^: (A :*: B)) (fun f1 :e C :^: (A :*: B) => if forall a :e A, forall b :e B, hl_GEQ C (f1 (hl_pair A B a b)) (f a b) = 1 then 1 else 0)) = 1

items.name: EXISTS_DEF
items.source: ? = (\P:A->bool. !q:bool. (!x:A. P x ==> q) ==> q)
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (exists x :e A, P x) <-> forall q:prop, (forall x :e A, P x -> q) -> q
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> hl_exists A = fun P :e 2 :^: A => if forall q :e 2, (forall x :e A, P x = 1 -> q = 1) -> q = 1 then 1 else 0

items.name: EXISTS_EX
items.source: !P:A->B->bool. !l:B list. (?x:A. EX (P x) l) <=> EX (\s:B. ?x:A. P x s) l
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> set -> prop, forall l :e finseq B, (exists x :e A, seq_ex (P x) l) <-> seq_ex (fun s:set => exists x :e A, P x s) l
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P :e 2 :^: B :^: A, forall l :e finseq B, (exists x :e A, hl_EX B (P x) l = 1) <-> hl_EX B (fun s :e B => if exists x :e A, P x s = 1 then 1 else 0) l = 1

items.name: EXISTS_FINITE_SUBSET_IMAGE
items.source: !P:(B->bool)->bool. !f:A->B. !s:A->bool. (?t:B->bool. FINITE t /\ t SUBSET IMAGE f s /\ P t) <=> (?t:A->bool. FINITE t /\ t SUBSET s /\ P (IMAGE f t))
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, (exists t c= B, finite t /\ (t c= {f x | x :e s} /\ P t)) <-> exists t c= A, finite t /\ (t c= s /\ P {f x | x :e t})
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P :e 2 :^: (2 :^: B), forall f :e B :^: A, forall s :e 2 :^: A, (exists t :e 2 :^: B, hl_FINITE B t = 1 /\ (hl_SUBSET B t (hl_IMAGE A B f s) = 1 /\ P t = 1)) <-> exists t :e 2 :^: A, hl_FINITE A t = 1 /\ (hl_SUBSET A t s = 1 /\ P (hl_IMAGE A B f t) = 1)

items.name: EXISTS_FINITE_SUBSET_IMAGE_INJ
items.source: !P:(B->bool)->bool. !f:A->B. !s:A->bool. (?t:B->bool. FINITE t /\ t SUBSET IMAGE f s /\ P t) <=> (?t:A->bool. FINITE t /\ t SUBSET s /\ (!x:A. !y:A. x IN t /\ y IN t ==> (f x = f y <=> x = y)) /\ P (IMAGE f t))
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, (exists t c= B, finite t /\ (t c= {f x | x :e s} /\ P t)) <-> exists t c= A, finite t /\ (t c= s /\ ((forall x y :e A, x :e t /\ y :e t -> (f x = f y <-> x = y)) /\ P {f x | x :e t}))
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P :e 2 :^: (2 :^: B), forall f :e B :^: A, forall s :e 2 :^: A, (exists t :e 2 :^: B, hl_FINITE B t = 1 /\ (hl_SUBSET B t (hl_IMAGE A B f s) = 1 /\ P t = 1)) <-> exists t :e 2 :^: A, hl_FINITE A t = 1 /\ (hl_SUBSET A t s = 1 /\ ((forall x y :e A, hl_IN A x t = 1 /\ hl_IN A y t = 1 -> (f x = f y <-> x = y)) /\ P (hl_IMAGE A B f t) = 1))

items.name: EXISTS_INT_CASES
items.source: !P:int->bool. (?x:int. P x) <=> (?n:num. P (int_of_num n)) \/ (?n:num. P (int_neg (int_of_num n)))
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, (exists x :e int, P x) <-> (exists n :e omega, P n) \/ exists n :e omega, P (- n)
items.literal: forall P :e 2 :^: hl_ty_int, (exists x :e hl_ty_int, P x = 1) <-> (exists n :e omega, P (hl_int_of_num n) = 1) \/ exists n :e omega, P (hl_int_neg (hl_int_of_num n)) = 1

items.name: EXISTS_IN_CLAUSES
items.source: (!P:A->bool. (?x:A. x IN EMPTY /\ P x) <=> F) /\ (!P:A->bool. !a:A. !s:A->bool. (?x:A. x IN a INSERT s /\ P x) <=> P a \/ (?x:A. x IN s /\ P x))
items.statement: forall A:set, (forall P:set -> prop, (exists x :e A, x :e Empty /\ P x) <-> False) /\ forall P:set -> prop, forall a :e A, forall s c= A, (exists x :e A, x :e SetAdjoin s a /\ P x) <-> P a \/ exists x :e A, x :e s /\ P x
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> (forall P :e 2 :^: A, (exists x :e A, hl_IN A x (hl_EMPTY A) = 1 /\ P x = 1) <-> False) /\ forall P :e 2 :^: A, forall a :e A, forall s :e 2 :^: A, (exists x :e A, hl_IN A x (hl_INSERT A a s) = 1 /\ P x = 1) <-> P a = 1 \/ exists x :e A, hl_IN A x s = 1 /\ P x = 1

items.name: EXISTS_IN_CROSS
items.source: !P:A#B->bool. !s:A->bool. !t:B->bool. (?z:A#B. z IN CROSS s t /\ P z) <=> (?x:A. ?y:B. x IN s /\ y IN t /\ P (x , y))
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= A, forall t c= B, (exists z :e A :*: B, z :e s :*: t /\ P z) <-> exists x :e A, exists y :e B, x :e s /\ (y :e t /\ P (x,y))
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P :e 2 :^: (A :*: B), forall s :e 2 :^: A, forall t :e 2 :^: B, (exists z :e A :*: B, hl_IN (A :*: B) z (hl_CROSS A B s t) = 1 /\ P z = 1) <-> exists x :e A, exists y :e B, hl_IN A x s = 1 /\ (hl_IN B y t = 1 /\ P (hl_pair A B x y) = 1)

P x /\ Q (f x))) /\ (!P:A->B->bool. !Q:C->bool. !f:A->B->C. (?z:C. z IN GSPEC (\GEN%PVAR%13:C. ?x:A. ?y:B. SETSPEC GEN%PVAR%13 (P x y) (f x y)) /\ Q z) <=> (?x:A. ?y:B. P x y /\ Q (f x y))) /\ (!P:A->B->C->bool. !Q:D->bool. !f:A->B->C->D. (?z:D. z IN GSPEC (\GEN%PVAR%14:D. ?w:A. ?x:B. ?y:C. SETSPEC GEN%PVAR%14 (P w x y) (f w x y)) /\ Q z) <=> (?w:A. ?x:B. ?y:C. SETSPEC GEN%PVAR%15 (P v w x y) (f v w x y)) /\ Q z) <=> (?v:A. ?w:B. ?x:C. ?y:D. P v w x y /\ Q (f v w x y)))
items.statement: forall A B C D E:set, B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> D <> Empty -> E <> Empty -> (forall P Q:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> ((exists z :e B, z :e {f x | x :e A, P x} /\ Q z) <-> exists x :e A, P x /\ Q (f x))) /\ ((forall P:set -> set -> prop, forall Q:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, f x y :e C) -> ((exists z :e C, z :e (\/_ x :e A, {f x y | y :e B, P x y}) /\ Q z) <-> exists x :e A, exists y :e B, P x y /\ Q (f x y))) /\ ((forall P:set -> set -> set -> prop, forall Q:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, forall z :e C, f x y z :e D) -> ((exists z :e D, z :e (\/_ w :e A, \/_ x :e B, {f w x y | y :e C, P w x y}) /\ Q z) <-> exists w :e A, exists x :e B, exists y :e C, P w x y /\ Q (f w x y))) /\ forall P:set -> set -> set -> set -> prop, forall Q:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set -> set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, forall z :e C, forall w :e D, f x y z w :e E) -> ((exists z :e E, z :e (\/_ v :e A, \/_ w :e B, \/_ x :e C, {f v w x y | y :e D, P v w x y}) /\ Q z) <-> exists v :e A, exists w :e B, exists x :e C, exists y :e D, P v w x y /\ Q (f v w x y))))
items.literal: forall A B C D E:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> D <> Empty -> E <> Empty -> (forall P :e 2 :^: A, forall Q :e 2 :^: B, forall f :e B :^: A, (exists z :e B, hl_IN B z (hl_GSPEC B (fun GEN_PVAR_12 :e B => if exists x :e A, hl_SETSPEC B GEN_PVAR_12 (P x) (f x) = 1 then 1 else 0)) = 1 /\ Q z = 1) <-> exists x :e A, P x = 1 /\ Q (f x) = 1) /\ ((forall P :e 2 :^: B :^: A, forall Q :e 2 :^: C, forall f :e C :^: B :^: A, (exists z :e C, hl_IN C z (hl_GSPEC C (fun GEN_PVAR_13 :e C => if exists x :e A, exists y :e B, hl_SETSPEC C GEN_PVAR_13 (P x y) (f x y) = 1 then 1 else 0)) = 1 /\ Q z = 1) <-> exists x :e A, exists y :e B, P x y = 1 /\ Q (f x y) = 1) /\ ((forall P :e 2 :^: C :^: B :^: A, forall Q :e 2 :^: D, forall f :e D :^: C :^: B :^: A, (exists z :e D, hl_IN D z (hl_GSPEC D (fun GEN_PVAR_14 :e D => if exists w :e A, exists x :e B, exists y :e C, hl_SETSPEC D GEN_PVAR_14 (P w x y) (f w x y) = 1 then 1 else 0)) = 1 /\ Q z = 1) <-> exists w :e A, exists x :e B, exists y :e C, P w x y = 1 /\ Q (f w x y) = 1) /\ forall P :e 2 :^: D :^: C :^: B :^: A, forall Q :e 2 :^: E, forall f :e E :^: D :^: C :^: B :^: A, (exists z :e E, hl_IN E z (hl_GSPEC E (fun GEN_PVAR_15 :e E => if exists v :e A, exists w :e B, exists x :e C, exists y :e D, hl_SETSPEC E GEN_PVAR_15 (P v w x y) (f v w x y) = 1 then 1 else 0)) = 1 /\ Q z = 1) <-> exists v :e A, exists w :e B, exists x :e C, exists y :e D, P v w x y = 1 /\ Q (f v w x y) = 1))

items.name: EXISTS_IN_IMAGE
items.source: !f:A->B. !s:A->bool. (?y:B. y IN IMAGE f s /\ P y) <=> (?x:A. x IN s /\ P (f x))
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, (exists y :e B, y :e {f x | x :e s} /\ P y) <-> exists x :e A, x :e s /\ P (f x)
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P :e 2 :^: B, forall f :e B :^: A, forall s :e 2 :^: A, (exists y :e B, hl_IN B y (hl_IMAGE A B f s) = 1 /\ P y = 1) <-> exists x :e A, hl_IN A x s = 1 /\ P (f x) = 1

items.name: EXISTS_IN_INSERT
items.source: !P:A->bool. !a:A. !s:A->bool. (?x:A. x IN a INSERT s /\ P x) <=> P a \/ (?x:A. x IN s /\ P x)
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall a :e A, forall s c= A, (exists x :e A, x :e SetAdjoin s a /\ P x) <-> P a \/ exists x :e A, x :e s /\ P x
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P :e 2 :^: A, forall a :e A, forall s :e 2 :^: A, (exists x :e A, hl_IN A x (hl_INSERT A a s) = 1 /\ P x = 1) <-> P a = 1 \/ exists x :e A, hl_IN A x s = 1 /\ P x = 1

items.name: EXISTS_IN_PCROSS
items.source: (?z:(A,(M,N)finite_sum)cart. z IN PCROSS s t /\ P z) <=> (?x:(A,M)cart. ?y:(A,N)cart. x IN s /\ y IN t /\ P (pastecart x y))
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= A :^: idx M, forall t c= A :^: idx N, forall P:set -> prop, (exists z :e A :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), z :e (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) /\ P z) <-> exists x :e A :^: idx M, exists y :e A :^: idx N, x :e s /\ (y :e t /\ P (pastecart M N x y))
items.literal: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s :e 2 :^: hl_ty_cart A M, forall t :e 2 :^: hl_ty_cart A N, forall P :e 2 :^: hl_ty_cart A (hl_ty_finite_sum M N), (exists z :e hl_ty_cart A (hl_ty_finite_sum M N), hl_IN (hl_ty_cart A (hl_ty_finite_sum M N)) z (hl_PCROSS A M N s t) = 1 /\ P z = 1) <-> exists x :e hl_ty_cart A M, exists y :e hl_ty_cart A N, hl_IN (hl_ty_cart A M) x s = 1 /\ (hl_IN (hl_ty_cart A N) y t = 1 /\ P (hl_pastecart A M N x y) = 1)

items.name: EXISTS_IN_UNION
items.source: !P:A->bool. !s:A->bool. !t:A->bool. (?x:A. x IN s UNION t /\ P x) <=> (?x:A. x IN s /\ P x) \/ (?x:A. x IN t /\ P x)
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall s t c= A, (exists x :e A, x :e s :\/: t /\ P x) <-> (exists x :e A, x :e s /\ P x) \/ exists x :e A, x :e t /\ P x
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P s t :e 2 :^: A, (exists x :e A, hl_IN A x (hl_UNION A s t) = 1 /\ P x = 1) <-> (exists x :e A, hl_IN A x s = 1 /\ P x = 1) \/ exists x :e A, hl_IN A x t = 1 /\ P x = 1

items.name: EXISTS_IN_UNIONS
items.source: !P:A->bool. !s:(A->bool)->bool. (?x:A. x IN UNIONS s /\ P x) <=> (?t:A->bool. ?x:A. t IN s /\ x IN t /\ P x)
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= Power A, (exists x :e A, x :e Union s /\ P x) <-> exists t c= A, exists x :e A, t :e s /\ (x :e t /\ P x)
