items.name: EXP_ADD
items.source: !m:num. !n:num. !p:num. m EXP (n + p) = m EXP n * m EXP p
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, m ^ (n + p) = m ^ n * m ^ p
items.literal: forall m n p :e omega, hl_EXP m (hl_add n p) = hl_mul (hl_EXP m n) (hl_EXP m p)

items.name: EXP_EQ_0
items.source: !m:num. !n:num. m EXP n = 0 <=> m = 0 /\ ~(n = 0)
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, m ^ n = 0 <-> m = 0 /\ ~ n = 0
items.literal: forall m n :e omega, hl_EXP m n = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero <-> m = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero /\ ~ n = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero

items.name: EXP_EQ_1
items.source: !x:num. !n:num. x EXP n = 1 <=> x = 1 \/ n = 0
items.statement: forall x n :e omega, x ^ n = 1 <-> x = 1 \/ n = 0
items.literal: forall x n :e omega, hl_EXP x n = hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT1 hl_zero) <-> x = hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT1 hl_zero) \/ n = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero

items.name: EXP_EXP
items.source: !x:num. !m:num. !n:num. x EXP m EXP n = x EXP (m * n)
items.statement: forall x m n :e omega, (x ^ m) ^ n = x ^ (m * n)
items.literal: forall x m n :e omega, hl_EXP (hl_EXP x m) n = hl_EXP x (hl_mul m n)

items.name: EXP_LT_0
items.source: !n:num. !x:num. 0 < x EXP n <=> ~(x = 0) \/ n = 0
items.statement: forall n x :e omega, 0 < x ^ n <-> ~ x = 0 \/ n = 0
items.literal: forall n x :e omega, hl_lt (hl_NUMERAL hl_zero) (hl_EXP x n) = 1 <-> ~ x = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero \/ n = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero

items.name: EXP_MONO_EQ
items.source: !x:num. !y:num. !n:num. x EXP n = y EXP n <=> x = y \/ n = 0
items.statement: forall x y n :e omega, x ^ n = y ^ n <-> x = y \/ n = 0
items.literal: forall x y n :e omega, hl_EXP x n = hl_EXP y n <-> x = y \/ n = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero

items.name: EXP_MONO_LE
items.source: !x:num. !y:num. !n:num. x EXP n <= y EXP n <=> x <= y \/ n = 0
items.statement: forall x y n :e omega, x ^ n <= y ^ n <-> x <= y \/ n = 0
items.literal: forall x y n :e omega, hl_le (hl_EXP x n) (hl_EXP y n) = 1 <-> hl_le x y = 1 \/ n = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero

items.name: EXP_MONO_LE_IMP
items.source: !x:num. !y:num. !n:num. x <= y ==> x EXP n <= y EXP n
items.statement: forall x y n :e omega, x <= y -> x ^ n <= y ^ n
items.literal: forall x y n :e omega, hl_le x y = 1 -> hl_le (hl_EXP x n) (hl_EXP y n) = 1

items.name: EXP_MONO_LT
items.source: !x:num. !y:num. !n:num. x EXP n < y EXP n <=> x < y /\ ~(n = 0)
items.statement: forall x y n :e omega, x ^ n < y ^ n <-> x < y /\ ~ n = 0
items.literal: forall x y n :e omega, hl_lt (hl_EXP x n) (hl_EXP y n) = 1 <-> hl_lt x y = 1 /\ ~ n = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero

items.name: EXP_MONO_LT_IMP
items.source: !x:num. !y:num. !n:num. x < y /\ ~(n = 0) ==> x EXP n < y EXP n
items.statement: forall x y n :e omega, x < y /\ ~ n = 0 -> x ^ n < y ^ n
items.literal: forall x y n :e omega, hl_lt x y = 1 /\ ~ n = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero -> hl_lt (hl_EXP x n) (hl_EXP y n) = 1

items.name: EXP_MULT
items.source: !m:num. !n:num. !p:num. m EXP (n * p) = m EXP n EXP p
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, m ^ (n * p) = (m ^ n) ^ p
items.literal: forall m n p :e omega, hl_EXP m (hl_mul n p) = hl_EXP (hl_EXP m n) p

items.name: EXP_ONE
items.source: !n:num. 1 EXP n = 1
items.statement: forall n :e omega, 1 ^ n = 1
items.literal: forall n :e omega, hl_EXP (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT1 hl_zero)) n = hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT1 hl_zero)

items.name: EXP_ZERO
items.source: !n:num. 0 EXP n = (if n = 0 then 1 else 0)
items.statement: forall n :e omega, 0 ^ n = if n = 0 then 1 else 0
items.literal: forall n :e omega, hl_EXP (hl_NUMERAL hl_zero) n = hl_COND omega (if n = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero then 1 else 0) (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT1 hl_zero)) (hl_NUMERAL hl_zero)

items.name: EXTENSION
items.source: !s:A->bool. !t:A->bool. s = t <=> (!x:A. x IN s <=> x IN t)
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, s = t <-> forall x :e A, x :e s <-> x :e t
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t :e 2 :^: A, s = t <-> forall x :e A, hl_IN A x s = 1 <-> hl_IN A x t = 1

items.name: EXTENSIONAL
items.source: !s:A->bool. EXTENSIONAL s = GSPEC (\GEN%PVAR%141:A->B. ?f:A->B. SETSPEC GEN%PVAR%141 (!x:A. ~(x IN s) ==> f x = ARB) f)
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall x :e B :^: A, (forall x0 :e A, ~ x0 :e s -> x x0 = choose_in B (fun y:set => False)) <-> x :e {f :e B :^: A | forall x0 :e A, ~ x0 :e s -> f x0 = choose_in B (fun x:set => False)}
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s :e 2 :^: A, hl_EXTENSIONAL A B s = hl_GSPEC (B :^: A) (fun GEN_PVAR_141 :e B :^: A => if exists f :e B :^: A, hl_SETSPEC (B :^: A) GEN_PVAR_141 (if forall x :e A, ~ hl_IN A x s = 1 -> f x = hl_ARB B then 1 else 0) f = 1 then 1 else 0)
items.cert_error: bridge_unsupported: rel: unmapped constant GSPEC (view prop, 2 args)

items.name: EXTENSIONAL_EMPTY
items.source: EXTENSIONAL EMPTY = (\x:A. ARB) INSERT EMPTY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall x :e B :^: A, (forall x0 :e A, ~ x0 :e Empty -> x x0 = choose_in B (fun y:set => False)) <-> x :e SetAdjoin Empty (fun x0 :e A => choose_in B (fun x:set => False))
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> hl_EXTENSIONAL A B (hl_EMPTY A) = hl_INSERT (B :^: A) (fun x :e A => hl_ARB B) (hl_EMPTY (B :^: A))
items.cert_error: bridge_unsupported: rel: membership derived x :e {fun x0 :e A => choose_in B (fun x:set => False)} differs from x :e SetAdjoin Empty (fun x0 :e A => choose_in B (fun x:set => False))

items.name: EXTENSIONAL_EQ
items.source: !s:A->bool. !f:A->B. !g:A->B. f IN EXTENSIONAL s /\ g IN EXTENSIONAL s /\ (!x:A. x IN s ==> f x = g x) ==> f = g
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f g :e B :^: A, f :e {x :e B :^: A | forall x0 :e A, ~ x0 :e s -> x x0 = choose_in B (fun y:set => False)} /\ (g :e {x :e B :^: A | forall x0 :e A, ~ x0 :e s -> x x0 = choose_in B (fun y:set => False)} /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x = g x)) -> f = g
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s :e 2 :^: A, forall f g :e B :^: A, hl_IN (B :^: A) f (hl_EXTENSIONAL A B s) = 1 /\ (hl_IN (B :^: A) g (hl_EXTENSIONAL A B s) = 1 /\ (forall x :e A, hl_IN A x s = 1 -> f x = g x)) -> f = g

items.name: EXTENSIONAL_UNIV
items.source: !f:A->B. EXTENSIONAL UNIV f
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall x :e A, ~ x :e A -> f x = choose_in B (fun y:set => False)
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f :e B :^: A, hl_EXTENSIONAL A B (hl_UNIV A) f = 1

items.name: EX_IMP
items.source: !P:A->bool. !Q:A->bool. !l:A list. (!x:A. MEM x l /\ P x ==> Q x) /\ EX P l ==> EX Q l
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P Q:set -> prop, forall l :e finseq A, (forall x :e A, seq_mem x l /\ P x -> Q x) /\ seq_ex P l -> seq_ex Q l
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P Q :e 2 :^: A, forall l :e finseq A, (forall x :e A, hl_MEM A x l = 1 /\ P x = 1 -> Q x = 1) /\ hl_EX A P l = 1 -> hl_EX A Q l = 1

items.name: EX_MAP
items.source: !P:B->bool. !f:A->B. !l:A list. EX P (MAP f l) <=> EX (P o f) l
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall l :e finseq A, seq_ex P (seq_map f l) <-> seq_ex (fun x:set => P (f x)) l
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P :e 2 :^: B, forall f :e B :^: A, forall l :e finseq A, hl_EX B P (hl_MAP A B f l) = 1 <-> hl_EX A (hl_o B 2 A P f) l = 1

items.name: EX_MEM
items.source: !P:A->bool. !l:A list. (?x:A. P x /\ MEM x l) <=> EX P l
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall l :e finseq A, (exists x :e A, P x /\ seq_mem x l) <-> seq_ex P l
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P :e 2 :^: A, forall l :e finseq A, (exists x :e A, P x = 1 /\ hl_MEM A x l = 1) <-> hl_EX A P l = 1

items.name: FACT
items.source: FACT 0 = 1 /\ (!n:num. FACT (SUC n) = SUC n * FACT n)
items.statement: factorial 0 = 1 /\ forall n :e omega, factorial (ordsucc n) = ordsucc n * factorial n
items.literal: hl_FACT (hl_NUMERAL hl_zero) = hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT1 hl_zero) /\ forall n :e omega, hl_FACT (hl_SUC n) = hl_mul (hl_SUC n) (hl_FACT n)

items.name: FACT_LE
items.source: !n:num. 1 <= FACT n
items.statement: forall n :e omega, 1 <= factorial n
items.literal: forall n :e omega, hl_le (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT1 hl_zero)) (hl_FACT n) = 1

items.name: FACT_LT
items.source: !n:num. 0 < FACT n
items.statement: forall n :e omega, 0 < factorial n
items.literal: forall n :e omega, hl_lt (hl_NUMERAL hl_zero) (hl_FACT n) = 1

items.name: FACT_MONO
items.source: !m:num. !n:num. m <= n ==> FACT m <= FACT n
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, m <= n -> factorial m <= factorial n
items.literal: forall m n :e omega, hl_le m n = 1 -> hl_le (hl_FACT m) (hl_FACT n) = 1

items.name: FACT_NZ
items.source: !n:num. ~(FACT n = 0)
items.statement: forall n :e omega, ~ factorial n = 0
items.literal: forall n :e omega, ~ hl_FACT n = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero

items.name: FCONS
items.error: internal constant FCONS (HOL Light internal definition/datatype machinery)
items.source: (!a:A. !f:num->A. FCONS a f 0 = a) /\ (!a:A. !f:num->A. !n:num. FCONS a f (SUC n) = f n)
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> (forall a :e A, forall f :e A :^: omega, hl_FCONS A a f (hl_NUMERAL hl_zero) = a) /\ forall a :e A, forall f :e A :^: omega, forall n :e omega, hl_FCONS A a f (hl_SUC n) = f n

items.name: FCONS_UNDO
items.error: internal constant FCONS (HOL Light internal definition/datatype machinery)
items.source: !f:num->A. f = FCONS (f 0) (f o SUC)
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f :e A :^: omega, f = hl_FCONS A (f (hl_NUMERAL hl_zero)) (hl_o omega A omega f hl_SUC)

items.name: FILTER
items.source: FILTER P NIL = NIL /\ FILTER P (h CONS t) = (if P h then h CONS FILTER P t else FILTER P t)
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall h :e A, forall t :e finseq A, seq_filter P seq_nil = seq_nil /\ seq_filter P (seq_cons h t) = if P h then seq_cons h (seq_filter P t) else seq_filter P t
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P :e 2 :^: A, forall h :e A, forall t :e finseq A, hl_FILTER A P (hl_NIL A) = hl_NIL A /\ hl_FILTER A P (hl_CONS A h t) = hl_COND (finseq A) (P h) (hl_CONS A h (hl_FILTER A P t)) (hl_FILTER A P t)

items.name: FILTER_APPEND
items.source: !P:A->bool. !l1:A list. !l2:A list. FILTER P (l1 APPEND l2) = FILTER P l1 APPEND FILTER P l2
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall l1 l2 :e finseq A, seq_filter P (seq_append l1 l2) = seq_append (seq_filter P l1) (seq_filter P l2)
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P :e 2 :^: A, forall l1 l2 :e finseq A, hl_FILTER A P (hl_APPEND A l1 l2) = hl_APPEND A (hl_FILTER A P l1) (hl_FILTER A P l2)

items.name: FILTER_MAP
items.source: !P:B->bool. !f:A->B. !l:A list. FILTER P (MAP f l) = MAP f (FILTER (P o f) l)
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall l :e finseq A, seq_filter P (seq_map f l) = seq_map f (seq_filter (fun x:set => P (f x)) l)
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P :e 2 :^: B, forall f :e B :^: A, forall l :e finseq A, hl_FILTER B P (hl_MAP A B f l) = hl_MAP A B f (hl_FILTER A (hl_o B 2 A P f) l)

items.name: FINITE_1
items.source: FINITE UNIV
items.statement: finite 1
items.literal: hl_FINITE 1 (hl_UNIV 1) = 1

items.name: FINITE_BOOL
items.source: FINITE UNIV
items.statement: finite 2
items.literal: hl_FINITE 2 (hl_UNIV 2) = 1

items.name: FINITE_CARD_LE_IMAGE
items.source: !f:A->B. !s:A->bool. !n:num. FINITE s /\ CARD s <= n ==> FINITE (IMAGE f s) /\ CARD (IMAGE f s) <= n
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, forall n :e omega, finite s /\ finite_cardinality s <= n -> finite {f x | x :e s} /\ finite_cardinality {f x | x :e s} <= n
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f :e B :^: A, forall s :e 2 :^: A, forall n :e omega, hl_FINITE A s = 1 /\ hl_le (hl_CARD A s) n = 1 -> hl_FINITE B (hl_IMAGE A B f s) = 1 /\ hl_le (hl_CARD B (hl_IMAGE A B f s)) n = 1

items.name: FINITE_CARD_LE_SUBSET
items.source: !s:A->bool. !t:A->bool. !n:num. s SUBSET t /\ FINITE t /\ CARD t <= n ==> FINITE s /\ CARD s <= n
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, forall n :e omega, s c= t /\ (finite t /\ finite_cardinality t <= n) -> finite s /\ finite_cardinality s <= n
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t :e 2 :^: A, forall n :e omega, hl_SUBSET A s t = 1 /\ (hl_FINITE A t = 1 /\ hl_le (hl_CARD A t) n = 1) -> hl_FINITE A s = 1 /\ hl_le (hl_CARD A s) n = 1

items.name: FINITE_CARD_LE_UNION
items.source: !s:A->bool. !t:A->bool. !m:num. !n:num. (FINITE s /\ CARD s <= m) /\ FINITE t /\ CARD t <= n ==> FINITE (s UNION t) /\ CARD (s UNION t) <= m + n
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, forall m n :e omega, finite s /\ finite_cardinality s <= m /\ (finite t /\ finite_cardinality t <= n) -> finite (s :\/: t) /\ finite_cardinality (s :\/: t) <= m + n
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t :e 2 :^: A, forall m n :e omega, hl_FINITE A s = 1 /\ hl_le (hl_CARD A s) m = 1 /\ (hl_FINITE A t = 1 /\ hl_le (hl_CARD A t) n = 1) -> hl_FINITE A (hl_UNION A s t) = 1 /\ hl_le (hl_CARD A (hl_UNION A s t)) (hl_add m n) = 1

items.name: FINITE_CARD_LE_UNIONS
items.source: !s:A->bool. !t:A->B->bool. !m:num. !n:num. (!x:A. x IN s ==> FINITE (t x) /\ CARD (t x) <= n) /\ FINITE s /\ CARD s <= m ==> FINITE (UNIONS (GSPEC (\GEN%PVAR%161:B->bool. ?x:A. SETSPEC GEN%PVAR%161 (x IN s) (t x)))) /\ CARD (UNIONS (GSPEC (\GEN%PVAR%162:B->bool. ?x:A. SETSPEC GEN%PVAR%162 (x IN s) (t x)))) <= m * n
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t :e Power B :^: A, forall m n :e omega, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> finite (t x) /\ finite_cardinality (t x) <= n) /\ (finite s /\ finite_cardinality s <= m) -> finite (Union {t x | x :e A, x :e s}) /\ finite_cardinality (Union {t x | x :e A, x :e s}) <= m * n
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s :e 2 :^: A, forall t :e 2 :^: B :^: A, forall m n :e omega, (forall x :e A, hl_IN A x s = 1 -> hl_FINITE B (t x) = 1 /\ hl_le (hl_CARD B (t x)) n = 1) /\ (hl_FINITE A s = 1 /\ hl_le (hl_CARD A s) m = 1) -> hl_FINITE B (hl_UNIONS B (hl_GSPEC (2 :^: B) (fun GEN_PVAR_161 :e 2 :^: B => if exists x :e A, hl_SETSPEC (2 :^: B) GEN_PVAR_161 (hl_IN A x s) (t x) = 1 then 1 else 0))) = 1 /\ hl_le (hl_CARD B (hl_UNIONS B (hl_GSPEC (2 :^: B) (fun GEN_PVAR_162 :e 2 :^: B => if exists x :e A, hl_SETSPEC (2 :^: B) GEN_PVAR_162 (hl_IN A x s) (t x) = 1 then 1 else 0)))) (hl_mul m n) = 1

items.name: FINITE_CART
items.source: !P:num->A->bool. (!i:num. 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex UNIV ==> FINITE (GSPEC (\GEN%PVAR%360:A. ?x:A. SETSPEC GEN%PVAR%360 (P i x) x))) ==> FINITE (GSPEC (\GEN%PVAR%361:(A,N)cart. ?v:(A,N)cart. SETSPEC GEN%PVAR%361 (!i:num. 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex UNIV ==> P i (v $ i)) v))
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall P:set -> set -> prop, (forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> finite {x :e A | P i x}) -> finite {v :e A :^: idx N | forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> P i (v i)}
items.literal: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall P :e 2 :^: A :^: omega, (forall i :e omega, hl_le (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT1 hl_zero)) i = 1 /\ hl_le i (hl_dimindex N (hl_UNIV N)) = 1 -> hl_FINITE A (hl_GSPEC A (fun GEN_PVAR_360 :e A => if exists x :e A, hl_SETSPEC A GEN_PVAR_360 (P i x) x = 1 then 1 else 0)) = 1) -> hl_FINITE (hl_ty_cart A N) (hl_GSPEC (hl_ty_cart A N) (fun GEN_PVAR_361 :e hl_ty_cart A N => if exists v :e hl_ty_cart A N, hl_SETSPEC (hl_ty_cart A N) GEN_PVAR_361 (if forall i :e omega, hl_le (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT1 hl_zero)) i = 1 /\ hl_le i (hl_dimindex N (hl_UNIV N)) = 1 -> P i (hl_vindex A N v i) = 1 then 1 else 0) v = 1 then 1 else 0)) = 1

items.name: FINITE_CART_UNIV
items.source: FINITE UNIV ==> FINITE UNIV
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> finite A -> finite (A :^: idx N)
items.literal: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> hl_FINITE A (hl_UNIV A) = 1 -> hl_FINITE (hl_ty_cart A N) (hl_UNIV (hl_ty_cart A N)) = 1

items.name: FINITE_CASES
items.source: !a:A->bool. FINITE a <=> a = EMPTY \/ (?x:A. ?s:A->bool. a = x INSERT s /\ FINITE s)
items.statement: forall A:set, forall a c= A, finite a <-> a = Empty \/ exists x :e A, exists s c= A, a = SetAdjoin s x /\ finite s
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e 2 :^: A, hl_FINITE A a = 1 <-> a = hl_EMPTY A \/ exists x :e A, exists s :e 2 :^: A, a = hl_INSERT A x s /\ hl_FINITE A s = 1

items.name: FINITE_CLAUSES
items.source: FINITE UNIV /\ FINITE UNIV /\ FINITE UNIV
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> finite 1 /\ (finite (idx_n (2 * dimindex A)) /\ finite (idx_n (2 * dimindex A + 1)))
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> hl_FINITE 1 (hl_UNIV 1) = 1 /\ (hl_FINITE (idx_n (2 * dimindex A)) (hl_UNIV (idx_n (2 * dimindex A))) = 1 /\ hl_FINITE (idx_n (2 * dimindex A + 1)) (hl_UNIV (idx_n (2 * dimindex A + 1))) = 1)

items.name: FINITE_CROSS
items.source: !s:A->bool. !t:B->bool. FINITE s /\ FINITE t ==> FINITE (CROSS s t)
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ finite t -> finite (s :*: t)
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s :e 2 :^: A, forall t :e 2 :^: B, hl_FINITE A s = 1 /\ hl_FINITE B t = 1 -> hl_FINITE (A :*: B) (hl_CROSS A B s t) = 1

items.name: FINITE_CROSS_EQ
items.source: !s:A->bool. !t:B->bool. FINITE (CROSS s t) <=> s = EMPTY \/ t = EMPTY \/ FINITE s /\ FINITE t
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite (s :*: t) <-> s = Empty \/ (t = Empty \/ finite s /\ finite t)
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s :e 2 :^: A, forall t :e 2 :^: B, hl_FINITE (A :*: B) (hl_CROSS A B s t) = 1 <-> s = hl_EMPTY A \/ (t = hl_EMPTY B \/ hl_FINITE A s = 1 /\ hl_FINITE B t = 1)

items.literal: (forall x1 x2 :e omega, hl_IND_SUC x1 = hl_IND_SUC x2 <-> x1 = x2) /\ forall x :e omega, ~ hl_IND_SUC x = hl_IND_0

items.name: INF
items.source: !s:real->bool. ~(s = EMPTY) /\ (?b:real. !x:real. x IN s ==> b <= x) ==> (!x:real. x IN s ==> inf s <= x) /\ (!b:real. (!x:real. x IN s ==> b <= x) ==> b <= inf s)
items.statement: forall s c= R, ~ s = Empty /\ (exists b :e R, forall x :e R, x :e s -> b <= x) -> (forall x :e R, x :e s -> inf s <= x) /\ forall b :e R, (forall x :e R, x :e s -> b <= x) -> b <= inf s
items.literal: forall s :e 2 :^: R, ~ s = hl_EMPTY R /\ (exists b :e R, forall x :e R, hl_IN R x s = 1 -> hl_real_le b x = 1) -> (forall x :e R, hl_IN R x s = 1 -> hl_real_le (hl_inf s) x = 1) /\ forall b :e R, (forall x :e R, hl_IN R x s = 1 -> hl_real_le b x = 1) -> hl_real_le b (hl_inf s) = 1

items.name: INFINITE
items.source: !s:A->bool. INFINITE s <=> ~FINITE s
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, infinite s <-> ~ finite s
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s :e 2 :^: A, hl_INFINITE A s = 1 <-> ~ hl_FINITE A s = 1

items.name: INFINITE_CROSS_EQ
items.source: !s:A->bool. !t:B->bool. INFINITE (CROSS s t) <=> ~(s = EMPTY) /\ INFINITE t \/ INFINITE s /\ ~(t = EMPTY)
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, infinite (s :*: t) <-> ~ s = Empty /\ infinite t \/ infinite s /\ ~ t = Empty
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s :e 2 :^: A, forall t :e 2 :^: B, hl_INFINITE (A :*: B) (hl_CROSS A B s t) = 1 <-> ~ s = hl_EMPTY A /\ hl_INFINITE B t = 1 \/ hl_INFINITE A s = 1 /\ ~ t = hl_EMPTY B

items.name: INFINITE_CROSS_UNIV
items.source: INFINITE UNIV <=> INFINITE UNIV \/ INFINITE UNIV
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> (infinite (A :*: B) <-> infinite A \/ infinite B)
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> (hl_INFINITE (A :*: B) (hl_UNIV (A :*: B)) = 1 <-> hl_INFINITE A (hl_UNIV A) = 1 \/ hl_INFINITE B (hl_UNIV B) = 1)

items.name: INFINITE_DIFF_FINITE
items.source: !s:A->bool. !t:A->bool. INFINITE s /\ FINITE t ==> INFINITE (s DIFF t)
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, infinite s /\ finite t -> infinite (s :\: t)
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t :e 2 :^: A, hl_INFINITE A s = 1 /\ hl_FINITE A t = 1 -> hl_INFINITE A (hl_DIFF A s t) = 1

items.name: INFINITE_ENUMERATE
items.source: !s:num->bool. INFINITE s ==> (?r:num->num. (!m:num. !n:num. m < n ==> r m < r n) /\ IMAGE r UNIV = s)
items.statement: forall s c= omega, infinite s -> exists r:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, r x :e omega) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, m < n -> r m < r n) /\ {r x | x :e omega} = s)
items.literal: forall s :e 2 :^: omega, hl_INFINITE omega s = 1 -> exists r :e omega :^: omega, (forall m n :e omega, hl_lt m n = 1 -> hl_lt (r m) (r n) = 1) /\ hl_IMAGE omega omega r (hl_UNIV omega) = s

items.name: INFINITE_ENUMERATE_EQ
items.source: !s:num->bool. INFINITE s <=> (?r:num->num. (!m:num. !n:num. m < n ==> r m < r n) /\ IMAGE r UNIV = s)
items.statement: forall s c= omega, infinite s <-> exists r:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, r x :e omega) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, m < n -> r m < r n) /\ {r x | x :e omega} = s)
items.literal: forall s :e 2 :^: omega, hl_INFINITE omega s = 1 <-> exists r :e omega :^: omega, (forall m n :e omega, hl_lt m n = 1 -> hl_lt (r m) (r n) = 1) /\ hl_IMAGE omega omega r (hl_UNIV omega) = s

items.name: INFINITE_ENUMERATE_SUBSET
items.source: !s:A->bool. INFINITE s <=> (?f:num->A. (!x:num. f x IN s) /\ (!x:num. !y:num. f x = f y ==> x = y))
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, infinite s <-> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e A) /\ ((forall x :e omega, f x :e s) /\ forall x y :e omega, f x = f y -> x = y)
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s :e 2 :^: A, hl_INFINITE A s = 1 <-> exists f :e A :^: omega, (forall x :e omega, hl_IN A (f x) s = 1) /\ forall x y :e omega, f x = f y -> x = y

items.name: INFINITE_IMAGE
items.source: !f:A->B. !s:A->bool. INFINITE s /\ (!x:A. !y:A. x IN s /\ y IN s /\ f x = f y ==> x = y) ==> INFINITE (IMAGE f s)
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, infinite s /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) -> infinite {f x | x :e s}
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f :e B :^: A, forall s :e 2 :^: A, hl_INFINITE A s = 1 /\ (forall x y :e A, hl_IN A x s = 1 /\ (hl_IN A y s = 1 /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) -> hl_INFINITE B (hl_IMAGE A B f s) = 1

items.name: INFINITE_IMAGE_INJ
items.source: !f:A->B. (!x:A. !y:A. f x = f y ==> x = y) ==> (!s:A->bool. INFINITE s ==> INFINITE (IMAGE f s))
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (forall x y :e A, f x = f y -> x = y) -> forall s c= A, infinite s -> infinite {f x | x :e s}
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f :e B :^: A, (forall x y :e A, f x = f y -> x = y) -> forall s :e 2 :^: A, hl_INFINITE A s = 1 -> hl_INFINITE B (hl_IMAGE A B f s) = 1

items.name: INFINITE_NONEMPTY
items.source: !s:A->bool. INFINITE s ==> ~(s = EMPTY)
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, infinite s -> ~ s = Empty
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s :e 2 :^: A, hl_INFINITE A s = 1 -> ~ s = hl_EMPTY A

items.name: INFINITE_SUPERSET
items.source: !s:A->bool. !t:A->bool. INFINITE s /\ s SUBSET t ==> INFINITE t
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, infinite s /\ s c= t -> infinite t
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t :e 2 :^: A, hl_INFINITE A s = 1 /\ hl_SUBSET A s t = 1 -> hl_INFINITE A t = 1

items.name: INFINITE_UNIV_PAIR
items.source: INFINITE UNIV <=> INFINITE UNIV
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> (infinite (A :*: A) <-> infinite A)
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> (hl_INFINITE (A :*: A) (hl_UNIV (A :*: A)) = 1 <-> hl_INFINITE A (hl_UNIV A) = 1)

items.name: INFINITY_AX
items.source: ?f:ind->ind. ONE_ONE f /\ ~ONTO f
items.literal: exists f :e omega :^: omega, hl_ONE_ONE omega omega f = 1 /\ ~ hl_ONTO omega omega f = 1

items.name: INF_APPROACH
items.source: !s:real->bool. !c:real. ~(s = EMPTY) /\ (?b:real. !x:real. x IN s ==> b <= x) /\ inf s < c ==> (?x:real. x IN s /\ x < c)
items.statement: forall s c= R, forall c :e R, ~ s = Empty /\ ((exists b :e R, forall x :e R, x :e s -> b <= x) /\ inf s < c) -> exists x :e R, x :e s /\ x < c
items.literal: forall s :e 2 :^: R, forall c :e R, ~ s = hl_EMPTY R /\ ((exists b :e R, forall x :e R, hl_IN R x s = 1 -> hl_real_le b x = 1) /\ hl_real_lt (hl_inf s) c = 1) -> exists x :e R, hl_IN R x s = 1 /\ hl_real_lt x c = 1

items.name: INF_EQ
items.source: !s:real->bool. !t:real->bool. (!a:real. (!x:real. x IN s ==> a <= x) <=> (!x:real. x IN t ==> a <= x)) ==> inf s = inf t
items.statement: forall s t c= R, (forall a :e R, (forall x :e R, x :e s -> a <= x) <-> forall x :e R, x :e t -> a <= x) -> inf s = inf t
items.literal: forall s t :e 2 :^: R, (forall a :e R, (forall x :e R, hl_IN R x s = 1 -> hl_real_le a x = 1) <-> forall x :e R, hl_IN R x t = 1 -> hl_real_le a x = 1) -> hl_inf s = hl_inf t

items.name: INF_EXISTS
items.source: !s:real->bool. (?l:real. has_inf s l) <=> ~(s = EMPTY) /\ (?b:real. !x:real. x IN s ==> b <= x)
items.statement: forall s c= R, (exists l :e R, is_glb s l) <-> ~ s = Empty /\ exists b :e R, forall x :e R, x :e s -> b <= x
items.literal: forall s :e 2 :^: R, (exists l :e R, hl_has_inf s l = 1) <-> ~ s = hl_EMPTY R /\ exists b :e R, forall x :e R, hl_IN R x s = 1 -> hl_real_le b x = 1

items.name: INF_FINITE
items.source: !s:real->bool. FINITE s /\ ~(s = EMPTY) ==> inf s IN s /\ (!x:real. x IN s ==> inf s <= x)
items.statement: forall s c= R, finite s /\ ~ s = Empty -> inf s :e s /\ forall x :e R, x :e s -> inf s <= x
items.literal: forall s :e 2 :^: R, hl_FINITE R s = 1 /\ ~ s = hl_EMPTY R -> hl_IN R (hl_inf s) s = 1 /\ forall x :e R, hl_IN R x s = 1 -> hl_real_le (hl_inf s) x = 1

items.name: INF_FINITE_LEMMA
items.source: !s:real->bool. FINITE s /\ ~(s = EMPTY) ==> (?b:real. b IN s /\ (!x:real. x IN s ==> b <= x))
items.statement: forall s c= R, finite s /\ ~ s = Empty -> exists b :e R, b :e s /\ forall x :e R, x :e s -> b <= x
items.literal: forall s :e 2 :^: R, hl_FINITE R s = 1 /\ ~ s = hl_EMPTY R -> exists b :e R, hl_IN R b s = 1 /\ forall x :e R, hl_IN R x s = 1 -> hl_real_le b x = 1

items.name: INF_INSERT_FINITE
items.source: !x:real. !s:real->bool. FINITE s ==> inf (x INSERT s) = (if s = EMPTY then x else real_min x (inf s))
items.statement: forall x :e R, forall s c= R, finite s -> inf (SetAdjoin s x) = if s = Empty then x else if x <= inf s then x else inf s
items.literal: forall x :e R, forall s :e 2 :^: R, hl_FINITE R s = 1 -> hl_inf (hl_INSERT R x s) = hl_COND R (if s = hl_EMPTY R then 1 else 0) x (hl_real_min x (hl_inf s))

items.name: INF_INSERT_INSERT
items.source: !a:real. !b:real. !s:real->bool. inf (b INSERT a INSERT s) = inf (real_min a b INSERT s)
items.statement: forall a b :e R, forall s c= R, inf (SetAdjoin (SetAdjoin s a) b) = inf (SetAdjoin s (if a <= b then a else b))
items.literal: forall a b :e R, forall s :e 2 :^: R, hl_inf (hl_INSERT R b (hl_INSERT R a s)) = hl_inf (hl_INSERT R (hl_real_min a b) s)

items.name: INF_LE_ELEMENT
items.source: !s:real->bool. !a:real. (?b:real. !x:real. x IN s ==> b <= x) /\ a IN s ==> inf s <= a
items.statement: forall s c= R, forall a :e R, (exists b :e R, forall x :e R, x :e s -> b <= x) /\ a :e s -> inf s <= a
items.literal: forall s :e 2 :^: R, forall a :e R, (exists b :e R, forall x :e R, hl_IN R x s = 1 -> hl_real_le b x = 1) /\ hl_IN R a s = 1 -> hl_real_le (hl_inf s) a = 1

items.name: INF_SING
items.source: !a:real. inf (a INSERT EMPTY) = a
items.statement: forall a :e R, inf {a} = a
items.literal: forall a :e R, hl_inf (hl_INSERT R a (hl_EMPTY R)) = a

items.name: INF_UNION
items.source: !s:real->bool. !t:real->bool. ~(s = EMPTY) /\ ~(t = EMPTY) /\ (?b:real. !x:real. x IN s ==> b <= x) /\ (?c:real. !x:real. x IN t ==> c <= x) ==> inf (s UNION t) = real_min (inf s) (inf t)
items.statement: forall s t c= R, ~ s = Empty /\ (~ t = Empty /\ ((exists b :e R, forall x :e R, x :e s -> b <= x) /\ (exists c :e R, forall x :e R, x :e t -> c <= x))) -> inf (s :\/: t) = if inf s <= inf t then inf s else inf t
items.literal: forall s t :e 2 :^: R, ~ s = hl_EMPTY R /\ (~ t = hl_EMPTY R /\ ((exists b :e R, forall x :e R, hl_IN R x s = 1 -> hl_real_le b x = 1) /\ (exists c :e R, forall x :e R, hl_IN R x t = 1 -> hl_real_le c x = 1))) -> hl_inf (hl_UNION R s t) = hl_real_min (hl_inf s) (hl_inf t)

items.name: INF_UNIQUE
items.source: !s:real->bool. !b:real. (!c:real. (!x:real. x IN s ==> c <= x) <=> c <= b) ==> inf s = b
items.statement: forall s c= R, forall b :e R, (forall c :e R, (forall x :e R, x :e s -> c <= x) <-> c <= b) -> inf s = b
items.literal: forall s :e 2 :^: R, forall b :e R, (forall c :e R, (forall x :e R, hl_IN R x s = 1 -> hl_real_le c x = 1) <-> hl_real_le c b = 1) -> hl_inf s = b

items.name: INF_UNIQUE_FINITE
items.source: !s:real->bool. FINITE s /\ ~(s = EMPTY) ==> (inf s = a <=> a IN s /\ (!y:real. y IN s ==> a <= y))
items.statement: forall a :e R, forall s c= R, finite s /\ ~ s = Empty -> (inf s = a <-> a :e s /\ forall y :e R, y :e s -> a <= y)
items.literal: forall a :e R, forall s :e 2 :^: R, hl_FINITE R s = 1 /\ ~ s = hl_EMPTY R -> (hl_inf s = a <-> hl_IN R a s = 1 /\ forall y :e R, hl_IN R y s = 1 -> hl_real_le a y = 1)

items.name: INJ
items.source: !t:B->bool. !s:A->bool. !f:A->B. INJ f s t <=> (!x:A. x IN s ==> f x IN t) /\ (!x:A. !y:A. x IN s /\ y IN s /\ f x = f y ==> x = y)
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall t c= B, forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (inj s t f <-> (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e t) /\ forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y)
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall t :e 2 :^: B, forall s :e 2 :^: A, forall f :e B :^: A, hl_INJ A B f s t = 1 <-> (forall x :e A, hl_IN A x s = 1 -> hl_IN B (f x) t = 1) /\ forall x y :e A, hl_IN A x s = 1 /\ (hl_IN A y s = 1 /\ f x = f y) -> x = y

items.name: INJECTIVE_ALT
items.source: !f:A->B. (!x:A. !y:A. f x = f y ==> x = y) <=> (!x:A. !y:A. f x = f y <=> x = y)
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> ((forall x y :e A, f x = f y -> x = y) <-> forall x y :e A, f x = f y <-> x = y)
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f :e B :^: A, (forall x y :e A, f x = f y -> x = y) <-> forall x y :e A, f x = f y <-> x = y

items.name: INJECTIVE_IMAGE
items.source: !f:A->B. (!s:A->bool. !t:A->bool. IMAGE f s = IMAGE f t ==> s = t) <=> (!x:A. !y:A. f x = f y ==> x = y)
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> ((forall s t c= A, {f x | x :e s} = {f x | x :e t} -> s = t) <-> forall x y :e A, f x = f y -> x = y)
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f :e B :^: A, (forall s t :e 2 :^: A, hl_IMAGE A B f s = hl_IMAGE A B f t -> s = t) <-> forall x y :e A, f x = f y -> x = y

items.name: INJECTIVE_LEFT_INVERSE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> ((forall x y :e A, f x = f y -> x = y) <-> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e A) /\ forall x :e A, g (f x) = x)
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f :e B :^: A, (forall x y :e A, f x = f y -> x = y) <-> exists g :e A :^: B, forall x :e A, g (f x) = x

items.name: INJECTIVE_MAP
items.source: !f:A->B. (!l:A list. !m:A list. MAP f l = MAP f m ==> l = m) <=> (!x:A. !y:A. f x = f y ==> x = y)
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> ((forall l m :e finseq A, seq_map f l = seq_map f m -> l = m) <-> forall x y :e A, f x = f y -> x = y)
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f :e B :^: A, (forall l m :e finseq A, hl_MAP A B f l = hl_MAP A B f m -> l = m) <-> forall x y :e A, f x = f y -> x = y

items.name: INJECTIVE_ON_ALT
items.source: !P:A->bool. !f:A->B. (!x:A. !y:A. P x /\ P y /\ f x = f y ==> x = y) <=> (!x:A. !y:A. P x /\ P y ==> (f x = f y <=> x = y))
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> ((forall x y :e A, P x /\ (P y /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) <-> forall x y :e A, P x /\ P y -> (f x = f y <-> x = y))
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P :e 2 :^: A, forall f :e B :^: A, (forall x y :e A, P x = 1 /\ (P y = 1 /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) <-> forall x y :e A, P x = 1 /\ P y = 1 -> (f x = f y <-> x = y)

items.name: INJECTIVE_ON_IMAGE
items.source: !f:A->B. !u:A->bool. (!s:A->bool. !t:A->bool. s SUBSET u /\ t SUBSET u /\ IMAGE f s = IMAGE f t ==> s = t) <=> (!x:A. !y:A. x IN u /\ y IN u /\ f x = f y ==> x = y)
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall u c= A, (forall s t c= A, s c= u /\ (t c= u /\ {f x | x :e s} = {f x | x :e t}) -> s = t) <-> forall x y :e A, x :e u /\ (y :e u /\ f x = f y) -> x = y
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f :e B :^: A, forall u :e 2 :^: A, (forall s t :e 2 :^: A, hl_SUBSET A s u = 1 /\ (hl_SUBSET A t u = 1 /\ hl_IMAGE A B f s = hl_IMAGE A B f t) -> s = t) <-> forall x y :e A, hl_IN A x u = 1 /\ (hl_IN A y u = 1 /\ f x = f y) -> x = y

items.name: INJECTIVE_ON_LEFT_INVERSE
items.source: !f:A->B. !s:A->bool. (!x:A. !y:A. x IN s /\ y IN s /\ f x = f y ==> x = y) <=> (?g:B->A. !x:A. x IN s ==> g (f x) = x)
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) <-> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e A) /\ forall x :e A, x :e s -> g (f x) = x
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f :e B :^: A, forall s :e 2 :^: A, (forall x y :e A, hl_IN A x s = 1 /\ (hl_IN A y s = 1 /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) <-> exists g :e A :^: B, forall x :e A, hl_IN A x s = 1 -> g (f x) = x

items.name: INJECTIVE_ON_PREIMAGE

items.statement: forall x y :e int, x ^ 2 + y ^ 2 = 0 <-> x = 0 /\ y = 0
items.literal: forall x y :e hl_ty_int, hl_int_add (hl_int_pow x (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT0 (hl_BIT1 hl_zero)))) (hl_int_pow y (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT0 (hl_BIT1 hl_zero)))) = hl_int_of_num (hl_NUMERAL hl_zero) <-> x = hl_int_of_num (hl_NUMERAL hl_zero) /\ y = hl_int_of_num (hl_NUMERAL hl_zero)

items.name: INT_SUB
items.source: !x:int. !y:int. x - y = x + int_neg y
items.statement: forall x y :e int, x + - y = x + - y
items.literal: forall x y :e hl_ty_int, hl_int_sub x y = hl_int_add x (hl_int_neg y)

items.name: INT_SUB_0

items.statement: forall x y :e int, x + - y = 0 <-> x = y
items.literal: forall x y :e hl_ty_int, hl_int_sub x y = hl_int_of_num (hl_NUMERAL hl_zero) <-> x = y

items.name: INT_SUB_ABS
items.source: !x:int. !y:int. int_abs x - int_abs y <= int_abs (x - y)
items.statement: forall x y :e int, abs_SNo x + - abs_SNo y <= abs_SNo (x + - y)
items.literal: forall x y :e hl_ty_int, hl_int_le (hl_int_sub (hl_int_abs x) (hl_int_abs y)) (hl_int_abs (hl_int_sub x y)) = 1

items.name: INT_SUB_ADD
items.source: !x:int. !y:int. x - y + y = x
items.statement: forall x y :e int, (x + - y) + y = x
items.literal: forall x y :e hl_ty_int, hl_int_add (hl_int_sub x y) y = x

items.name: INT_SUB_ADD2
items.source: !x:int. !y:int. y + x - y = x

items.literal: forall x y :e hl_ty_int, hl_int_add y (hl_int_sub x y) = x

items.name: INT_SUB_LDISTRIB
items.source: !x:int. !y:int. !z:int. x * (y - z) = x * y - x * z
items.statement: forall x y z :e int, x * (y + - z) = x * y + - x * z
items.literal: forall x y z :e hl_ty_int, hl_int_mul x (hl_int_sub y z) = hl_int_sub (hl_int_mul x y) (hl_int_mul x z)

items.name: INT_SUB_LE
items.source: !x:int. !y:int. int_of_num 0 <= x - y <=> y <= x
items.statement: forall x y :e int, 0 <= x + - y <-> y <= x

items.name: INT_SUB_LNEG
items.source: !x:int. !y:int. int_neg x - y = int_neg (x + y)
items.statement: forall x y :e int, - x + - y = - (x + y)
items.literal: forall x y :e hl_ty_int, hl_int_sub (hl_int_neg x) y = hl_int_neg (hl_int_add x y)

items.name: INT_SUB_LT
items.source: !x:int. !y:int. int_of_num 0 < x - y <=> y < x
items.statement: forall x y :e int, 0 < x + - y <-> y < x

items.name: INT_SUB_LZERO
items.source: !x:int. int_of_num 0 - x = int_neg x

items.name: INT_SUB_NEG2

items.name: INT_SUB_REM

items.name: INT_SUB_SUB2

items.name: INT_SUB_TRIANGLE

items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e C, op x y :e C) -> (forall x y :e C, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e C, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e C, op (neutral_of C op) x = x) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e C) -> forall s c= A, (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) -> iterate_op C op {f x | x :e s} g = iterate_op C op s (fun x:set => g (f x))
items.literal: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall op :e C :^: C :^: C, hl_monoidal C op = 1 -> forall f :e B :^: A, forall g :e C :^: B, forall s :e 2 :^: A, (forall x y :e A, hl_IN A x s = 1 /\ (hl_IN A y s = 1 /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) -> hl_iterate C B op (hl_IMAGE A B f s) g = hl_iterate C A op s (hl_o B C A g f)

items.name: ITERATE_IMAGE_GEN
items.source: !op:C->C->C. monoidal op ==> (!f:A->B. !g:A->C. !s:A->bool. FINITE s ==> iterate op s g = iterate op (IMAGE f s) (\y:B. iterate op (GSPEC (\GEN%PVAR%247:A. ?x:A. SETSPEC GEN%PVAR%247 (x IN s /\ f x = y) x)) g))
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e C, op x y :e C) -> (forall x y :e C, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e C, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e C, op (neutral_of C op) x = x) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e C) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> iterate_op C op s g = iterate_op C op {f x | x :e s} (fun y:set => iterate_op C op {x :e A | x :e s /\ f x = y} g)
items.literal: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall op :e C :^: C :^: C, hl_monoidal C op = 1 -> forall f :e B :^: A, forall g :e C :^: A, forall s :e 2 :^: A, hl_FINITE A s = 1 -> hl_iterate C A op s g = hl_iterate C B op (hl_IMAGE A B f s) (fun y :e B => hl_iterate C A op (hl_GSPEC A (fun GEN_PVAR_247 :e A => if exists x :e A, hl_SETSPEC A GEN_PVAR_247 (if hl_IN A x s = 1 /\ f x = y then 1 else 0) x = 1 then 1 else 0)) g)

items.name: ITERATE_IMAGE_NONZERO
items.source: !op:C->C->C. monoidal op ==> (!g:B->C. !f:A->B. !s:A->bool. FINITE s /\ (!x:A. !y:A. x IN s /\ y IN s /\ ~(x = y) /\ f x = f y ==> g (f x) = neutral op) ==> iterate op (IMAGE f s) g = iterate op s (g o f))
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e C, op x y :e C) -> (forall x y :e C, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e C, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e C, op (neutral_of C op) x = x) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e C) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ (~ x = y /\ f x = f y)) -> g (f x) = neutral_of C op) -> iterate_op C op {f x | x :e s} g = iterate_op C op s (fun x:set => g (f x))
items.literal: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall op :e C :^: C :^: C, hl_monoidal C op = 1 -> forall g :e C :^: B, forall f :e B :^: A, forall s :e 2 :^: A, hl_FINITE A s = 1 /\ (forall x y :e A, hl_IN A x s = 1 /\ (hl_IN A y s = 1 /\ (~ x = y /\ f x = f y)) -> g (f x) = hl_neutral C op) -> hl_iterate C B op (hl_IMAGE A B f s) g = hl_iterate C A op s (hl_o B C A g f)

items.name: ITERATE_INCL_EXCL
items.source: !op:B->B->B. monoidal op ==> (!s:A->bool. !t:A->bool. !f:A->B. FINITE s /\ FINITE t ==> op (iterate op s f) (iterate op t f) = op (iterate op (s UNION t) f) (iterate op (s INTER t) f))
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> (forall x y :e B, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e B, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e B, op (neutral_of B op) x = x) -> forall s t c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> finite s /\ finite t -> op (iterate_op B op s f) (iterate_op B op t f) = op (iterate_op B op (s :\/: t) f) (iterate_op B op (s :/\: t) f)
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall op :e B :^: B :^: B, hl_monoidal B op = 1 -> forall s t :e 2 :^: A, forall f :e B :^: A, hl_FINITE A s = 1 /\ hl_FINITE A t = 1 -> op (hl_iterate B A op s f) (hl_iterate B A op t f) = op (hl_iterate B A op (hl_UNION A s t) f) (hl_iterate B A op (hl_INTER A s t) f)

items.name: ITERATE_INJECTION
items.source: !op:B->B->B. monoidal op ==> (!f:A->B. !p:A->A. !s:A->bool. FINITE s /\ (!x:A. x IN s ==> p x IN s) /\ (!x:A. !y:A. x IN s /\ y IN s /\ p x = p y ==> x = y) ==> iterate op s (f o p) = iterate op s f)

items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall op :e B :^: B :^: B, hl_monoidal B op = 1 -> forall f :e B :^: A, forall p :e A :^: A, forall s :e 2 :^: A, hl_FINITE A s = 1 /\ ((forall x :e A, hl_IN A x s = 1 -> hl_IN A (p x) s = 1) /\ (forall x y :e A, hl_IN A x s = 1 /\ (hl_IN A y s = 1 /\ p x = p y) -> x = y)) -> hl_iterate B A op s (hl_o A B A f p) = hl_iterate B A op s f

items.source: !op:C->C->C. monoidal op ==> (!s:A->bool. !t:A->B->bool. !x:A->B->C. FINITE s /\ (!i:A. i IN s ==> FINITE (t i)) ==> iterate op s (\i:A. iterate op (t i) (x i)) = iterate op (GSPEC (\GEN%PVAR%243:A#B. ?i:A. ?j:B. items.literal: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall op :e C :^: C :^: C, hl_monoidal C op = 1 -> forall s :e 2 :^: A, forall t :e 2 :^: B :^: A, forall x :e C :^: B :^: A, hl_FINITE A s = 1 /\ (forall i :e A, hl_IN A i s = 1 -> hl_FINITE B (t i) = 1) -> hl_iterate C A op s (fun i :e A => hl_iterate C B op (t i) (x i)) = hl_iterate C (A :*: B) op (hl_GSPEC (A :*: B) (fun GEN_PVAR_243 :e A :*: B => if exists i :e A, exists j :e B, hl_SETSPEC (A :*: B) GEN_PVAR_243 (if hl_IN A i s = 1 /\ hl_IN B j (t i) = 1 then 1 else 0) (hl_pair A B i j) = 1 then 1 else 0)) (hl_GABS (C :^: (A :*: B)) (fun f :e C :^: (A :*: B) => if forall i :e A, forall j :e B, hl_GEQ C (f (hl_pair A B i j)) (x i j) = 1 then 1 else 0))

items.name: ITERATE_OP
items.source: !op:B->B->B. monoidal op ==> (!f:A->B. !g:A->B. !s:A->bool. FINITE s ==> iterate op s (\x:A. op (f x) (g x)) = op (iterate op s f) (iterate op s g))
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> (forall x y :e B, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e B, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e B, op (neutral_of B op) x = x) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> iterate_op B op s (fun x:set => op (f x) (g x)) = op (iterate_op B op s f) (iterate_op B op s g)

items.name: ITERATE_OP_GEN
items.source: !op:B->B->B. monoidal op ==> (!f:A->B. !g:A->B. !s:A->bool. FINITE (support op f s) /\ FINITE (support op g s) ==> iterate op s (\x:A. op (f x) (g x)) = op (iterate op s f) (iterate op s g))
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> (forall x y :e B, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e B, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e B, op (neutral_of B op) x = x) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> forall s c= A, finite {x :e s | f x <> neutral_of B op} /\ finite {x :e s | g x <> neutral_of B op} -> iterate_op B op s (fun x:set => op (f x) (g x)) = op (iterate_op B op s f) (iterate_op B op s g)

items.name: ITERATE_PAIR
items.source: !op:A->A->A. monoidal op ==> (!f:num->A. !m:num. !n:num. iterate op (.. (2 * m) (2 * n + 1)) f = iterate op (.. m n) (\i:num. op (f (2 * i)) (f (2 * i + 1))))
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e A, op x y :e A) -> (forall x y :e A, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e A, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e A, op (neutral_of A op) x = x) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e A) -> forall m n :e omega, iterate_op A op {i :e omega | 2 * m <= i /\ i <= 2 * n + 1} f = iterate_op A op {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => op (f (2 * i)) (f (2 * i + 1)))
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall op :e A :^: A :^: A, hl_monoidal A op = 1 -> forall f :e A :^: omega, forall m n :e omega, hl_iterate A omega op (hl_numseg (hl_mul (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT0 (hl_BIT1 hl_zero))) m) (hl_add (hl_mul (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT0 (hl_BIT1 hl_zero))) n) (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT1 hl_zero)))) f = hl_iterate A omega op (hl_numseg m n) (fun i :e omega => op (f (hl_mul (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT0 (hl_BIT1 hl_zero))) i)) (f (hl_add (hl_mul (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT0 (hl_BIT1 hl_zero))) i) (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT1 hl_zero)))))

items.name: ITERATE_REFLECT
items.source: !op:A->A->A. monoidal op ==> (!x:num->A. !m:num. !n:num. iterate op (.. m n) x = (if n < m then neutral op else iterate op (.. 0 (n - m)) (\i:num. x (n - i))))
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e A, op x y :e A) -> (forall x y :e A, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e A, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e A, op (neutral_of A op) x = x) -> forall x:set -> set, (forall x0 :e omega, x x0 :e A) -> forall m n :e omega, iterate_op A op {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} x = if n < m then neutral_of A op else iterate_op A op {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= minus_nat n m} (fun i:set => x (minus_nat n i))
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall op :e A :^: A :^: A, hl_monoidal A op = 1 -> forall x :e A :^: omega, forall m n :e omega, hl_iterate A omega op (hl_numseg m n) x = hl_COND A (hl_lt n m) (hl_neutral A op) (hl_iterate A omega op (hl_numseg (hl_NUMERAL hl_zero) (hl_sub n m)) (fun i :e omega => x (hl_sub n i)))

items.statement: forall A B:set, forall a :e A, forall b :e B, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, f x y :e B) -> forall l :e finseq A, seq_foldr f (seq_append l (seq_cons a seq_nil)) b = seq_foldr f l (f a b)
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall a :e A, forall b :e B, forall f :e B :^: B :^: A, forall l :e finseq A, hl_ITLIST A B f (hl_APPEND A l (hl_CONS A a (hl_NIL A))) b = hl_ITLIST A B f l (f a b)

items.name: ITSET
items.source: !b:B. !f:A->B->B. !s:A->bool. ITSET f s b = (@g:(A->bool)->B. g EMPTY = b /\ (!x:A. !s1:A->bool. FINITE s1 ==> g (x INSERT s1) = (if x IN s1 then g s1 else f x (g s1)))) s
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall b :e B, forall f :e B :^: B :^: A, forall s :e 2 :^: A, hl_ITSET A B f s b = hl_select (B :^: (2 :^: A)) (fun g :e B :^: (2 :^: A) => if g (hl_EMPTY A) = b /\ forall x :e A, forall s1 :e 2 :^: A, hl_FINITE A s1 = 1 -> g (hl_INSERT A x s1) = hl_COND B (hl_IN A x s1) (g s1) (f x (g s1)) then 1 else 0) s

items.name: ITSET_EQ
items.source: !s:A->bool. !f:A->B->B. !g:A->B->B. !b:B. FINITE s /\ (!x:A. x IN s ==> f x = g x) /\ (!x:A. !y:A. !s1:B. ~(x = y) ==> f x (f y s1) = f y (f x s1)) /\ (!x:A. !y:A. !s1:B. ~(x = y) ==> g x (g y s1) = g y (g x s1)) ==> ITSET f s b = ITSET g s b
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, f x y :e B) -> forall g:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, g x y :e B) -> forall b :e B, finite s /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> forall x0 :e B, f x x0 = g x x0) /\ ((forall x y :e A, forall s0 :e B, ~ x = y -> f x (f y s0) = f y (f x s0)) /\ (forall x y :e A, forall s0 :e B, ~ x = y -> g x (g y s0) = g y (g x s0)))) -> set_foldr f s b = set_foldr g s b
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s :e 2 :^: A, forall f g :e B :^: B :^: A, forall b :e B, hl_FINITE A s = 1 /\ ((forall x :e A, hl_IN A x s = 1 -> f x = g x) /\ ((forall x y :e A, forall s1 :e B, ~ x = y -> f x (f y s1) = f y (f x s1)) /\ (forall x y :e A, forall s1 :e B, ~ x = y -> g x (g y s1) = g y (g x s1)))) -> hl_ITSET A B f s b = hl_ITSET A B g s b
items.cert_error: bridge_unsupported: compat_missing: hl_ITSET_compat (not in compat.mg)

items.name: I_DEF
items.source: I = (\x:A. x)
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, x = x
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> hl_I A = fun x :e A => x

items.name: I_O_ID
items.source: !f:A->B. I o f = f /\ f o I = f
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (forall x :e A, f x = f x) /\ forall x :e A, f x = f x
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f :e B :^: A, hl_o B B A (hl_I B) f = f /\ hl_o A B A f (hl_I A) = f

items.name: I_THM
items.source: !x:A. I x = x
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, x = x
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e A, hl_I A x = x

items.name: LAMBDA_BETA
items.source: !i:num. 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex UNIV ==> lambda g $ i = g i
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e A) -> forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex B -> (fun i :e idx B => g i) i = g i
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall g :e A :^: omega, forall i :e omega, hl_le (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT1 hl_zero)) i = 1 /\ hl_le i (hl_dimindex B (hl_UNIV B)) = 1 -> hl_vindex A B (hl_lambda A B g) i = g i

items.name: LAMBDA_ETA
items.source: !g:(A,B)cart. lambda (\i:num. g $ i) = g
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall g :e A :^: idx B, (fun i :e idx B => g i) = g
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall g :e hl_ty_cart A B, hl_lambda A B (fun i :e omega => hl_vindex A B g i) = g
items.cert_error: bridge_unsupported: side condition i :e idx B not available from hypotheses [hyps: ]

items.name: LAMBDA_PAIR
items.source: !f:A->B->C. GABS (\f1:A#B->C. !x:A. !y:B. GEQ (f1 (x , y)) (f x y)) = (\p:A#B. f (FST p) (SND p))
items.statement: forall A B C:set, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, f x y :e C) -> forall p :e A :*: B, f (p 0) (p 1) = f (p 0) (p 1)
items.literal: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f :e C :^: B :^: A, hl_GABS (C :^: (A :*: B)) (fun f1 :e C :^: (A :*: B) => if forall x :e A, forall y :e B, hl_GEQ C (f1 (hl_pair A B x y)) (f x y) = 1 then 1 else 0) = fun p :e A :*: B => f (hl_FST A B p) (hl_SND A B p)

items.name: LAMBDA_PAIR_THM
items.source: !t:A#B->C. (\p:A#B. t p) = GABS (\f:A#B->C. !x:A. !y:B. GEQ (f (x , y)) (t (x , y)))
items.statement: forall A B C:set, C <> Empty -> forall t:set -> set, (forall x :e A :*: B, t x :e C) -> forall p :e A :*: B, t p = t (p 0,p 1)
items.literal: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall t :e C :^: (A :*: B), (fun p :e A :*: B => t p) = hl_GABS (C :^: (A :*: B)) (fun f :e C :^: (A :*: B) => if forall x :e A, forall y :e B, hl_GEQ C (f (hl_pair A B x y)) (t (hl_pair A B x y)) = 1 then 1 else 0)

items.name: LAMBDA_TRIPLE
items.source: !f:A->B->C->D. GABS (\f1:A#B#C->D. !x:A. !y:B. !z:C. GEQ (f1 (x , y , z)) (f x y z)) = (\t:A#B#C. f (FST t) (FST (SND t)) (SND (SND t)))
items.statement: forall A B C D:set, forall f:set -> set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, forall z :e C, f x y z :e D) -> forall t :e A :*: (B :*: C), f (t 0) (t 1 0) (t 1 1) = f (t 0) (t 1 0) (t 1 1)
items.literal: forall A B C D:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> D <> Empty -> forall f :e D :^: C :^: B :^: A, hl_GABS (D :^: (A :*: (B :*: C))) (fun f1 :e D :^: (A :*: (B :*: C)) => if forall x :e A, forall y :e B, forall z :e C, hl_GEQ D (f1 (hl_pair A (B :*: C) x (hl_pair B C y z))) (f x y z) = 1 then 1 else 0) = fun t :e A :*: (B :*: C) => f (hl_FST A (B :*: C) t) (hl_FST B C (hl_SND A (B :*: C) t)) (hl_SND B C (hl_SND A (B :*: C) t))

items.name: LAMBDA_TRIPLE_THM
items.source: !f:A#B#C->D. (\t:A#B#C. f t) = GABS (\f':A#B#C->D. !x:A. !y:B. !z:C. GEQ (f' (x , y , z)) (f (x , y , z)))
items.statement: forall A B C D:set, D <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A :*: (B :*: C), f x :e D) -> forall t :e A :*: (B :*: C), f t = f (t 0,(t 1 0,t 1 1))
items.literal: forall A B C D:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> D <> Empty -> forall f :e D :^: (A :*: (B :*: C)), (fun t :e A :*: (B :*: C) => f t) = hl_GABS (D :^: (A :*: (B :*: C))) (fun f' :e D :^: (A :*: (B :*: C)) => if forall x :e A, forall y :e B, forall z :e C, hl_GEQ D (f' (hl_pair A (B :*: C) x (hl_pair B C y z))) (f (hl_pair A (B :*: C) x (hl_pair B C y z))) = 1 then 1 else 0)

items.name: LAMBDA_UNIQUE
items.source: !f:(A,B)cart. !g:num->A. (!i:num. 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex UNIV ==> f $ i = g i) <=> lambda g = f
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f :e A :^: idx B, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e A) -> ((forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex B -> f i = g i) <-> (fun i :e idx B => g i) = f)
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f :e hl_ty_cart A B, forall g :e A :^: omega, (forall i :e omega, hl_le (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT1 hl_zero)) i = 1 /\ hl_le i (hl_dimindex B (hl_UNIV B)) = 1 -> hl_vindex A B f i = g i) <-> hl_lambda A B g = f

items.name: LAST
items.source: LAST (h CONS t) = (if t = NIL then h else LAST t)
items.statement: forall A:set, forall h :e A, forall t :e finseq A, seq_last (seq_cons h t) = if t = seq_nil then h else seq_last t
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall h :e A, forall t :e finseq A, hl_LAST A (hl_CONS A h t) = hl_COND A (if t = hl_NIL A then 1 else 0) h (hl_LAST A t)

items.name: LAST_APPEND
items.source: !p:A list. !q:A list. LAST (p APPEND q) = (if q = NIL then LAST p else LAST q)
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p q :e finseq A, seq_last (seq_append p q) = if q = seq_nil then seq_last p else seq_last q
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p q :e finseq A, hl_LAST A (hl_APPEND A p q) = hl_COND A (if q = hl_NIL A then 1 else 0) (hl_LAST A p) (hl_LAST A q)
items.cert_error: bridge_unsupported: side condition ~ seq_append p q = seq_nil not available from hypotheses [hyps: ]

items.name: LAST_CLAUSES
items.source: LAST (h CONS NIL) = h /\ LAST (h CONS k CONS t) = LAST (k CONS t)
items.statement: forall A:set, forall h k :e A, forall t :e finseq A, seq_last (seq_cons h seq_nil) = h /\ seq_last (seq_cons h (seq_cons k t)) = seq_last (seq_cons k t)
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall h k :e A, forall t :e finseq A, hl_LAST A (hl_CONS A h (hl_NIL A)) = h /\ hl_LAST A (hl_CONS A h (hl_CONS A k t)) = hl_LAST A (hl_CONS A k t)

items.name: LAST_EL
items.source: !l:A list. ~(l = NIL) ==> LAST l = EL (LENGTH l - 1) l
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l :e finseq A, ~ l = seq_nil -> seq_last l = seq_nth l (minus_nat (seq_len l) 1)
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l :e finseq A, ~ l = hl_NIL A -> hl_LAST A l = hl_EL A (hl_sub (hl_LENGTH A l) (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT1 hl_zero))) l
items.cert_error: bridge_unsupported: side condition minus_nat (seq_len l) 1 :e seq_len l not available from hypotheses [hyps: ~ l = seq_nil]

items.name: LAST_REVERSE
items.source: !l:A list. ~(l = NIL) ==> LAST (REVERSE l) = HD l
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l :e finseq A, ~ l = seq_nil -> seq_last (seq_rev l) = seq_hd l
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l :e finseq A, ~ l = hl_NIL A -> hl_LAST A (hl_REVERSE A l) = hl_HD A l

items.name: LDIV_LT_EQ
items.source: !a:num. !b:num. !n:num. ~(a = 0) ==> (n < b DIV a <=> a * (n + 1) <= b)
items.statement: forall a b n :e omega, ~ a = 0 -> (n < div_nat b a <-> a * (n + 1) <= b)
items.literal: forall a b n :e omega, ~ a = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero -> (hl_lt n (hl_DIV b a) = 1 <-> hl_le (hl_mul a (hl_add n (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT1 hl_zero)))) b = 1)

items.name: LE
items.source: (!m:num. m <= 0 <=> m = 0) /\ (!m:num. !n:num. m <= SUC n <=> m = SUC n \/ m <= n)
items.statement: (forall m :e omega, m <= 0 <-> m = 0) /\ forall m n :e omega, m <= ordsucc n <-> m = ordsucc n \/ m <= n
items.literal: (forall m :e omega, hl_le m (hl_NUMERAL hl_zero) = 1 <-> m = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero) /\ forall m n :e omega, hl_le m (hl_SUC n) = 1 <-> m = hl_SUC n \/ hl_le m n = 1

items.name: LEFT_ADD_DISTRIB
items.source: !m:num. !n:num. !p:num. m * (n + p) = m * n + m * p
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, m * (n + p) = m * n + m * p
items.literal: forall m n p :e omega, hl_mul m (hl_add n p) = hl_add (hl_mul m n) (hl_mul m p)

items.name: LEFT_AND_EXISTS_THM
items.source: !P:A->bool. !Q:bool. (?x:A. P x) /\ Q <=> (?x:A. P x /\ Q)
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall Q:prop, (exists x :e A, P x) /\ Q <-> exists x :e A, P x /\ Q
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P :e 2 :^: A, forall Q :e 2, (exists x :e A, P x = 1) /\ Q = 1 <-> exists x :e A, P x = 1 /\ Q = 1

items.name: LEFT_AND_FORALL_THM
items.source: !P:A->bool. !Q:bool. (!x:A. P x) /\ Q <=> (!x:A. P x /\ Q)
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall Q:prop, (forall x :e A, P x) /\ Q <-> forall x :e A, P x /\ Q
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P :e 2 :^: A, forall Q :e 2, (forall x :e A, P x = 1) /\ Q = 1 <-> forall x :e A, P x = 1 /\ Q = 1

items.name: LEFT_EXISTS_AND_THM
items.source: !P:A->bool. !Q:bool. (?x:A. P x /\ Q) <=> (?x:A. P x) /\ Q
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall Q:prop, (exists x :e A, P x /\ Q) <-> (exists x :e A, P x) /\ Q
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P :e 2 :^: A, forall Q :e 2, (exists x :e A, P x = 1 /\ Q = 1) <-> (exists x :e A, P x = 1) /\ Q = 1

items.name: LEFT_EXISTS_IMP_THM
items.source: !P:A->bool. !Q:bool. (?x:A. P x ==> Q) <=> (!x:A. P x) ==> Q
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall Q:prop, (exists x :e A, P x -> Q) <-> (forall x :e A, P x) -> Q
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P :e 2 :^: A, forall Q :e 2, (exists x :e A, P x = 1 -> Q = 1) <-> (forall x :e A, P x = 1) -> Q = 1

items.name: LEFT_FORALL_IMP_THM
items.source: !P:A->bool. !Q:bool. (!x:A. P x ==> Q) <=> (?x:A. P x) ==> Q
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall Q:prop, (forall x :e A, P x -> Q) <-> (exists x :e A, P x) -> Q
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P :e 2 :^: A, forall Q :e 2, (forall x :e A, P x = 1 -> Q = 1) <-> (exists x :e A, P x = 1) -> Q = 1

items.name: LEFT_FORALL_OR_THM
items.source: !P:A->bool. !Q:bool. (!x:A. P x \/ Q) <=> (!x:A. P x) \/ Q
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall Q:prop, (forall x :e A, P x \/ Q) <-> (forall x :e A, P x) \/ Q
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P :e 2 :^: A, forall Q :e 2, (forall x :e A, P x = 1 \/ Q = 1) <-> (forall x :e A, P x = 1) \/ Q = 1

items.name: LEFT_IMP_EXISTS_THM
items.source: !P:A->bool. !Q:bool. (?x:A. P x) ==> Q <=> (!x:A. P x ==> Q)
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall Q:prop, (exists x :e A, P x) -> Q <-> forall x :e A, P x -> Q
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P :e 2 :^: A, forall Q :e 2, (exists x :e A, P x = 1) -> Q = 1 <-> forall x :e A, P x = 1 -> Q = 1

items.name: LEFT_IMP_FORALL_THM
items.source: !P:A->bool. !Q:bool. (!x:A. P x) ==> Q <=> (?x:A. P x ==> Q)
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall Q:prop, (forall x :e A, P x) -> Q <-> exists x :e A, P x -> Q
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P :e 2 :^: A, forall Q :e 2, (forall x :e A, P x = 1) -> Q = 1 <-> exists x :e A, P x = 1 -> Q = 1

items.name: LEFT_OR_DISTRIB
items.source: !p:bool. !q:bool. !r:bool. p /\ (q \/ r) <=> p /\ q \/ p /\ r
items.statement: forall p q r:prop, p /\ (q \/ r) <-> p /\ q \/ p /\ r

items.name: LEFT_OR_EXISTS_THM
items.source: !P:A->bool. !Q:bool. (?x:A. P x) \/ Q <=> (?x:A. P x \/ Q)
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall Q:prop, (exists x :e A, P x) \/ Q <-> exists x :e A, P x \/ Q
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P :e 2 :^: A, forall Q :e 2, (exists x :e A, P x = 1) \/ Q = 1 <-> exists x :e A, P x = 1 \/ Q = 1

items.name: LEFT_OR_FORALL_THM
items.source: !P:A->bool. !Q:bool. (!x:A. P x) \/ Q <=> (!x:A. P x \/ Q)
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall Q:prop, (forall x :e A, P x) \/ Q <-> forall x :e A, P x \/ Q
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P :e 2 :^: A, forall Q :e 2, (forall x :e A, P x = 1) \/ Q = 1 <-> forall x :e A, P x = 1 \/ Q = 1

items.name: LEFT_SUB_DISTRIB
items.source: !m:num. !n:num. !p:num. m * (n - p) = m * n - m * p
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, m * minus_nat n p = minus_nat (m * n) (m * p)
items.literal: forall m n p :e omega, hl_mul m (hl_sub n p) = hl_sub (hl_mul m n) (hl_mul m p)

items.name: LENGTH
items.source: LENGTH NIL = 0 /\ (!h:A. !t:A list. LENGTH (h CONS t) = SUC (LENGTH t))
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> seq_len seq_nil = 0 /\ forall h :e A, forall t :e finseq A, seq_len (seq_cons h t) = ordsucc (seq_len t)
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> hl_LENGTH A (hl_NIL A) = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero /\ forall h :e A, forall t :e finseq A, hl_LENGTH A (hl_CONS A h t) = hl_SUC (hl_LENGTH A t)

items.name: LENGTH_APPEND
items.source: !l:A list. !m:A list. LENGTH (l APPEND m) = LENGTH l + LENGTH m
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l m :e finseq A, seq_len (seq_append l m) = seq_len l + seq_len m
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l m :e finseq A, hl_LENGTH A (hl_APPEND A l m) = hl_add (hl_LENGTH A l) (hl_LENGTH A m)

items.name: LENGTH_EQ_CONS
items.source: !l:A list. !n:num. LENGTH l = SUC n <=> (?h:A. ?t:A list. l = h CONS t /\ LENGTH t = n)
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l :e finseq A, forall n :e omega, seq_len l = ordsucc n <-> exists h :e A, exists t :e finseq A, l = seq_cons h t /\ seq_len t = n
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l :e finseq A, forall n :e omega, hl_LENGTH A l = hl_SUC n <-> exists h :e A, exists t :e finseq A, l = hl_CONS A h t /\ hl_LENGTH A t = n

items.name: LENGTH_EQ_LIST_OF_SEQ
items.source: !l:A list. !n:num. LENGTH l = n <=> l = list_of_seq (\i:num. EL i l) n
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l :e finseq A, forall n :e omega, seq_len l = n <-> l = seq_mk n (fun i:set => seq_nth l i)
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l :e finseq A, forall n :e omega, hl_LENGTH A l = n <-> l = hl_list_of_seq A (fun i :e omega => hl_EL A i l) n
items.cert_error: bridge_unsupported: side condition i :e seq_len l not available from hypotheses [hyps: ]

items.name: LENGTH_EQ_NIL
items.source: !l:A list. LENGTH l = 0 <=> l = NIL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l :e finseq A, seq_len l = 0 <-> l = seq_nil
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l :e finseq A, hl_LENGTH A l = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero <-> l = hl_NIL A

items.name: LENGTH_FILTER
items.source: !P:A->bool. !l:A list. LENGTH (FILTER P l) <= LENGTH l
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall l :e finseq A, seq_len (seq_filter P l) <= seq_len l
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P :e 2 :^: A, forall l :e finseq A, hl_le (hl_LENGTH A (hl_FILTER A P l)) (hl_LENGTH A l) = 1

items.name: LENGTH_LIST_OF_SEQ

items.name: MEM_EXISTS_EL
items.source: !l:A list. !x:A. MEM x l <=> (?i:num. i < LENGTH l /\ x = EL i l)
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l :e finseq A, forall x :e A, seq_mem x l <-> exists i :e omega, i < seq_len l /\ x = seq_nth l i
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l :e finseq A, forall x :e A, hl_MEM A x l = 1 <-> exists i :e omega, hl_lt i (hl_LENGTH A l) = 1 /\ x = hl_EL A i l

items.name: MEM_FILTER
items.source: !P:A->bool. !l:A list. !x:A. MEM x (FILTER P l) <=> P x /\ MEM x l
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall l :e finseq A, forall x :e A, seq_mem x (seq_filter P l) <-> P x /\ seq_mem x l
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P :e 2 :^: A, forall l :e finseq A, forall x :e A, hl_MEM A x (hl_FILTER A P l) = 1 <-> P x = 1 /\ hl_MEM A x l = 1

items.name: MEM_LIST_OF_SET
items.source: !s:A->bool. FINITE s ==> (!x:A. MEM x (list_of_set s) <=> x IN s)
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, finite s -> forall x :e A, seq_mem x (choose_in (finseq A) (fun l:set => seq_set l = s /\ seq_len l = finite_cardinality s)) <-> x :e s
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s :e 2 :^: A, hl_FINITE A s = 1 -> forall x :e A, hl_MEM A x (hl_list_of_set A s) = 1 <-> hl_IN A x s = 1

items.name: MEM_MAP
items.source: !f:A->B. !y:B. !l:A list. MEM y (MAP f l) <=> (?x:A. MEM x l /\ y = f x)
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall y :e B, forall l :e finseq A, seq_mem y (seq_map f l) <-> exists x :e A, seq_mem x l /\ y = f x
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f :e B :^: A, forall y :e B, forall l :e finseq A, hl_MEM B y (hl_MAP A B f l) = 1 <-> exists x :e A, hl_MEM A x l = 1 /\ y = f x

items.name: MEM_REPLICATE
items.source: !n:num. !x:A. !y:A. MEM x (REPLICATE n y) <=> x = y /\ ~(n = 0)
items.statement: forall A:set, forall n :e omega, forall x y :e A, seq_mem x (seq_replicate n y) <-> x = y /\ ~ n = 0
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall n :e omega, forall x y :e A, hl_MEM A x (hl_REPLICATE A n y) = 1 <-> x = y /\ ~ n = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero

items.name: MIN
items.source: !m:num. !n:num. MIN m n = (if m <= n then m else n)
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, (if m <= n then m else n) = if m <= n then m else n
items.literal: forall m n :e omega, hl_MIN m n = hl_COND omega (hl_le m n) m n

items.name: MINIMAL
items.source: !P:num->bool. (?n:num. P n) <=> P (minimal P) /\ (!m:num. m < minimal P ==> ~P m)
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, (exists n :e omega, P n) <-> P (choose_in omega (fun n:set => P n /\ forall m :e omega, P m -> n <= m)) /\ forall m :e omega, m < choose_in omega (fun n:set => P n /\ forall m :e omega, P m -> n <= m) -> ~ P m
items.literal: forall P :e 2 :^: omega, (exists n :e omega, P n = 1) <-> P (hl_minimal P) = 1 /\ forall m :e omega, hl_lt m (hl_minimal P) = 1 -> ~ P m = 1

items.name: MINIMAL_BAD_SEQUENCE
items.source: !<<:A->A->bool. !bad:(num->A)->bool. WF << /\ (!x:num->A. ~bad x ==> (?n:num. !y:num->A. (!k:num. k < n ==> y k = x k) ==> ~bad y)) /\ (?x:num->A. bad x) ==> (?y:num->A. bad y /\ (!z:num->A. !n:num. bad z /\ (!k:num. k < n ==> z k = y k) ==> ~<< (z n) (y n)))
items.statement: forall A:set, forall lt:set -> set -> prop, forall bad:set -> prop, (forall P c= A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ lt y x) /\ ((forall x :e A :^: omega, ~ bad x -> exists n :e omega, forall y :e A :^: omega, (forall k :e omega, k < n -> y k = x k) -> ~ bad y) /\ (exists x :e A :^: omega, bad x)) -> exists y :e A :^: omega, bad y /\ forall z :e A :^: omega, forall n :e omega, bad z /\ (forall k :e omega, k < n -> z k = y k) -> ~ lt (z n) (y n)
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall lt :e 2 :^: A :^: A, forall bad :e 2 :^: (A :^: omega), hl_WF A lt = 1 /\ ((forall x :e A :^: omega, ~ bad x = 1 -> exists n :e omega, forall y :e A :^: omega, (forall k :e omega, hl_lt k n = 1 -> y k = x k) -> ~ bad y = 1) /\ (exists x :e A :^: omega, bad x = 1)) -> exists y :e A :^: omega, bad y = 1 /\ forall z :e A :^: omega, forall n :e omega, bad z = 1 /\ (forall k :e omega, hl_lt k n = 1 -> z k = y k) -> ~ lt (z n) (y n) = 1

items.name: MINIMAL_LBOUND
items.source: !P:num->bool. !n:num. (?r:num. P r) /\ (!m:num. m < n ==> ~P m) ==> n <= minimal P
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, forall n :e omega, (exists r :e omega, P r) /\ (forall m :e omega, m < n -> ~ P m) -> n <= choose_in omega (fun n:set => P n /\ forall m :e omega, P m -> n <= m)
items.literal: forall P :e 2 :^: omega, forall n :e omega, (exists r :e omega, P r = 1) /\ (forall m :e omega, hl_lt m n = 1 -> ~ P m = 1) -> hl_le n (hl_minimal P) = 1

items.name: MINIMAL_LE
items.source: !P:num->bool. !n:num. (?r:num. P r) ==> (minimal P <= n <=> (?i:num. i <= n /\ P i))
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, forall n :e omega, (exists r :e omega, P r) -> (choose_in omega (fun n:set => P n /\ forall m :e omega, P m -> n <= m) <= n <-> exists i :e omega, i <= n /\ P i)
items.literal: forall P :e 2 :^: omega, forall n :e omega, (exists r :e omega, P r = 1) -> (hl_le (hl_minimal P) n = 1 <-> exists i :e omega, hl_le i n = 1 /\ P i = 1)

items.name: MINIMAL_MONO
items.source: !P:num->bool. !Q:num->bool. (?n:num. P n) /\ (!n:num. P n ==> Q n) ==> minimal Q <= minimal P
items.statement: forall P Q:set -> prop, (exists n :e omega, P n) /\ (forall n :e omega, P n -> Q n) -> choose_in omega (fun n:set => Q n /\ forall m :e omega, Q m -> n <= m) <= choose_in omega (fun n:set => P n /\ forall m :e omega, P m -> n <= m)
items.literal: forall P Q :e 2 :^: omega, (exists n :e omega, P n = 1) /\ (forall n :e omega, P n = 1 -> Q n = 1) -> hl_le (hl_minimal Q) (hl_minimal P) = 1

items.name: MINIMAL_UBOUND
items.source: !P:num->bool. !n:num. P n ==> minimal P <= n
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, forall n :e omega, P n -> choose_in omega (fun n:set => P n /\ forall m :e omega, P m -> n <= m) <= n
items.literal: forall P :e 2 :^: omega, forall n :e omega, P n = 1 -> hl_le (hl_minimal P) n = 1

items.name: MINIMAL_UNIQUE
items.source: !P:num->bool. !n:num. P n /\ (!m:num. m < n ==> ~P m) ==> minimal P = n
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, forall n :e omega, P n /\ (forall m :e omega, m < n -> ~ P m) -> choose_in omega (fun n:set => P n /\ forall m :e omega, P m -> n <= m) = n
items.literal: forall P :e 2 :^: omega, forall n :e omega, P n = 1 /\ (forall m :e omega, hl_lt m n = 1 -> ~ P m = 1) -> hl_minimal P = n
