items.name: MOD_0
items.source: !n:num. 0 MOD n = 0
items.statement: forall n :e omega, mod_nat 0 n = 0
items.literal: forall n :e omega, hl_MOD (hl_NUMERAL hl_zero) n = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero

items.name: MOD_1
items.source: !n:num. n MOD 1 = 0
items.statement: forall n :e omega, mod_nat n 1 = 0
items.literal: forall n :e omega, hl_MOD n (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT1 hl_zero)) = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero

items.name: MOD_2_CASES
items.source: !n:num. n MOD 2 = (if EVEN n then 0 else 1)
items.statement: forall n :e omega, mod_nat n 2 = if even_nat n then 0 else 1
items.literal: forall n :e omega, hl_MOD n (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT0 (hl_BIT1 hl_zero))) = hl_COND omega (hl_EVEN n) (hl_NUMERAL hl_zero) (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT1 hl_zero))

items.name: MOD_ADD_CASES
items.source: !m:num. !n:num. !p:num. m < p /\ n < p ==> (m + n) MOD p = (if m + n < p then m + n else (m + n) - p)
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, m < p /\ n < p -> mod_nat (m + n) p = if m + n < p then m + n else minus_nat (m + n) p
items.literal: forall m n p :e omega, hl_lt m p = 1 /\ hl_lt n p = 1 -> hl_MOD (hl_add m n) p = hl_COND omega (hl_lt (hl_add m n) p) (hl_add m n) (hl_sub (hl_add m n) p)

items.name: MOD_ADD_EQ
items.source: !n:num. !x:num. !y:num. x MOD n + y MOD n < n ==> (x + y) MOD n = x MOD n + y MOD n
items.statement: forall n x y :e omega, mod_nat x n + mod_nat y n < n -> mod_nat (x + y) n = mod_nat x n + mod_nat y n
items.literal: forall n x y :e omega, hl_lt (hl_add (hl_MOD x n) (hl_MOD y n)) n = 1 -> hl_MOD (hl_add x y) n = hl_add (hl_MOD x n) (hl_MOD y n)

items.name: MOD_ADD_EQ_EQ
items.source: !n:num. !x:num. !y:num. (x + y) MOD n = x MOD n + y MOD n <=> n = 0 \/ x MOD n + y MOD n < n
items.statement: forall n x y :e omega, mod_nat (x + y) n = mod_nat x n + mod_nat y n <-> n = 0 \/ mod_nat x n + mod_nat y n < n
items.literal: forall n x y :e omega, hl_MOD (hl_add x y) n = hl_add (hl_MOD x n) (hl_MOD y n) <-> n = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero \/ hl_lt (hl_add (hl_MOD x n) (hl_MOD y n)) n = 1

items.name: MOD_ADD_MOD
items.source: !a:num. !b:num. !n:num. (a MOD n + b MOD n) MOD n = (a + b) MOD n
items.statement: forall a b n :e omega, mod_nat (mod_nat a n + mod_nat b n) n = mod_nat (a + b) n
items.literal: forall a b n :e omega, hl_MOD (hl_add (hl_MOD a n) (hl_MOD b n)) n = hl_MOD (hl_add a b) n

items.name: MOD_CASES
items.source: !n:num. !p:num. n < 2 * p ==> n MOD p = (if n < p then n else n - p)
items.statement: forall n p :e omega, n < 2 * p -> mod_nat n p = if n < p then n else minus_nat n p
items.literal: forall n p :e omega, hl_lt n (hl_mul (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT0 (hl_BIT1 hl_zero))) p) = 1 -> hl_MOD n p = hl_COND omega (hl_lt n p) n (hl_sub n p)

items.name: MOD_DIV_EQ_0
items.source: !m:num. !n:num. ~(n = 0) ==> m MOD n DIV n = 0
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, ~ n = 0 -> div_nat (mod_nat m n) n = 0
items.literal: forall m n :e omega, ~ n = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero -> hl_DIV (hl_MOD m n) n = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero

items.name: MOD_EQ
items.source: !m:num. !n:num. !p:num. !q:num. m = n + q * p ==> m MOD p = n MOD p
items.statement: forall m n p q :e omega, m = n + q * p -> mod_nat m p = mod_nat n p
items.literal: forall m n p q :e omega, m = hl_add n (hl_mul q p) -> hl_MOD m p = hl_MOD n p

items.name: MOD_EQ_0
items.source: !m:num. !n:num. m MOD n = 0 <=> (?q:num. m = q * n)
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, mod_nat m n = 0 <-> exists q :e omega, m = q * n
items.literal: forall m n :e omega, hl_MOD m n = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero <-> exists q :e omega, m = hl_mul q n

items.name: MOD_EQ_SELF
items.source: !m:num. !n:num. m MOD n = m <=> n = 0 \/ m < n
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, mod_nat m n = m <-> n = 0 \/ m < n
items.literal: forall m n :e omega, hl_MOD m n = m <-> n = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero \/ hl_lt m n = 1

items.name: MOD_EVEN_2
items.source: !m:num. !n:num. EVEN n ==> m MOD n MOD 2 = m MOD 2
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, even_nat n -> mod_nat (mod_nat m n) 2 = mod_nat m 2
items.literal: forall m n :e omega, hl_EVEN n = 1 -> hl_MOD (hl_MOD m n) (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT0 (hl_BIT1 hl_zero))) = hl_MOD m (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT0 (hl_BIT1 hl_zero)))

items.name: MOD_EXISTS
items.source: !m:num. !n:num. (?q:num. m = n * q) <=> (if n = 0 then m = 0 else m MOD n = 0)
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, (exists q :e omega, m = n * q) <-> (n = 0 -> m = 0) /\ (~ n = 0 -> mod_nat m n = 0)
items.literal: forall m n :e omega, (exists q :e omega, m = hl_mul n q) <-> n = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero /\ m = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero \/ ~ n = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero /\ hl_MOD m n = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero

items.name: MOD_EXP
items.source: !m:num. !n:num. !p:num. ~(m = 0) ==> m EXP n MOD m EXP p = (if p <= n \/ m = 1 then 0 else m EXP n)
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, ~ m = 0 -> mod_nat (m ^ n) (m ^ p) = if p <= n \/ m = 1 then 0 else m ^ n
items.literal: forall m n p :e omega, ~ m = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero -> hl_MOD (hl_EXP m n) (hl_EXP m p) = hl_COND omega (if hl_le p n = 1 \/ m = hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT1 hl_zero) then 1 else 0) (hl_NUMERAL hl_zero) (hl_EXP m n)

items.name: MOD_EXP_MOD
items.source: !m:num. !n:num. !p:num. (m MOD n) EXP p MOD n = m EXP p MOD n
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, mod_nat (mod_nat m n ^ p) n = mod_nat (m ^ p) n
items.literal: forall m n p :e omega, hl_MOD (hl_EXP (hl_MOD m n) p) n = hl_MOD (hl_EXP m p) n

items.name: MOD_LE
items.source: !m:num. !n:num. m MOD n <= m
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, mod_nat m n <= m
items.literal: forall m n :e omega, hl_le (hl_MOD m n) m = 1

items.name: MOD_LE_TWICE
items.source: !m:num. !n:num. 0 < m /\ m <= n ==> 2 * n MOD m <= n
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, 0 < m /\ m <= n -> 2 * mod_nat n m <= n
items.literal: forall m n :e omega, hl_lt (hl_NUMERAL hl_zero) m = 1 /\ hl_le m n = 1 -> hl_le (hl_mul (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT0 (hl_BIT1 hl_zero))) (hl_MOD n m)) n = 1

items.name: MOD_LT
items.source: !m:num. !n:num. m < n ==> m MOD n = m
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, m < n -> mod_nat m n = m
items.literal: forall m n :e omega, hl_lt m n = 1 -> hl_MOD m n = m

items.name: MOD_LT_EQ
items.source: !m:num. !n:num. m MOD n < n <=> ~(n = 0)
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, mod_nat m n < n <-> ~ n = 0
items.literal: forall m n :e omega, hl_lt (hl_MOD m n) n = 1 <-> ~ n = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero

items.name: MOD_LT_EQ_LT
items.source: !m:num. !n:num. m MOD n < n <=> 0 < n
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, mod_nat m n < n <-> 0 < n
items.literal: forall m n :e omega, hl_lt (hl_MOD m n) n = 1 <-> hl_lt (hl_NUMERAL hl_zero) n = 1

items.name: MOD_MOD
items.source: !m:num. !n:num. !p:num. m MOD (n * p) MOD n = m MOD n
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, mod_nat (mod_nat m (n * p)) n = mod_nat m n
items.literal: forall m n p :e omega, hl_MOD (hl_MOD m (hl_mul n p)) n = hl_MOD m n

items.name: MOD_MOD_EXP_MIN
items.source: !x:num. !p:num. !m:num. !n:num. x MOD p EXP m MOD p EXP n = x MOD p EXP MIN m n
items.statement: forall x p m n :e omega, mod_nat (mod_nat x (p ^ m)) (p ^ n) = mod_nat x (p ^ if m <= n then m else n)
items.literal: forall x p m n :e omega, hl_MOD (hl_MOD x (hl_EXP p m)) (hl_EXP p n) = hl_MOD x (hl_EXP p (hl_MIN m n))

items.name: MOD_MOD_LE
items.source: !m:num. !n:num. !p:num. ~(n = 0) /\ n <= p ==> m MOD n MOD p = m MOD n
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, ~ n = 0 /\ n <= p -> mod_nat (mod_nat m n) p = mod_nat m n
items.literal: forall m n p :e omega, ~ n = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero /\ hl_le n p = 1 -> hl_MOD (hl_MOD m n) p = hl_MOD m n

items.name: MOD_MOD_REFL
items.source: !m:num. !n:num. m MOD n MOD n = m MOD n
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, mod_nat (mod_nat m n) n = mod_nat m n
items.literal: forall m n :e omega, hl_MOD (hl_MOD m n) n = hl_MOD m n

items.name: MOD_MULT
items.source: !m:num. !n:num. (m * n) MOD m = 0
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, mod_nat (m * n) m = 0
items.literal: forall m n :e omega, hl_MOD (hl_mul m n) m = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero

items.name: MOD_MULT2
items.source: !m:num. !n:num. !p:num. (m * n) MOD (m * p) = m * n MOD p
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, mod_nat (m * n) (m * p) = m * mod_nat n p
items.literal: forall m n p :e omega, hl_MOD (hl_mul m n) (hl_mul m p) = hl_mul m (hl_MOD n p)

items.name: MOD_MULT_ADD
items.source: (!m:num. !n:num. !p:num. (m * n + p) MOD n = p MOD n) /\ (!m:num. !n:num. !p:num. (n * m + p) MOD n = p MOD n) /\ (!m:num. !n:num. !p:num. (p + m * n) MOD n = p MOD n) /\ (!m:num. !n:num. !p:num. (p + n * m) MOD n = p MOD n)
items.statement: (forall m n p :e omega, mod_nat (m * n + p) n = mod_nat p n) /\ ((forall m n p :e omega, mod_nat (n * m + p) n = mod_nat p n) /\ ((forall m n p :e omega, mod_nat (p + m * n) n = mod_nat p n) /\ forall m n p :e omega, mod_nat (p + n * m) n = mod_nat p n))
items.literal: (forall m n p :e omega, hl_MOD (hl_add (hl_mul m n) p) n = hl_MOD p n) /\ ((forall m n p :e omega, hl_MOD (hl_add (hl_mul n m) p) n = hl_MOD p n) /\ ((forall m n p :e omega, hl_MOD (hl_add p (hl_mul m n)) n = hl_MOD p n) /\ forall m n p :e omega, hl_MOD (hl_add p (hl_mul n m)) n = hl_MOD p n))

items.name: MOD_MULT_LMOD
items.source: !m:num. !n:num. !p:num. (m MOD n * p) MOD n = (m * p) MOD n
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, mod_nat (mod_nat m n * p) n = mod_nat (m * p) n
items.literal: forall m n p :e omega, hl_MOD (hl_mul (hl_MOD m n) p) n = hl_MOD (hl_mul m p) n

items.name: MOD_MULT_MOD
items.source: !m:num. !n:num. !p:num. m MOD (n * p) = n * m DIV n MOD p + m MOD n
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, mod_nat m (n * p) = n * mod_nat (div_nat m n) p + mod_nat m n
items.literal: forall m n p :e omega, hl_MOD m (hl_mul n p) = hl_add (hl_mul n (hl_MOD (hl_DIV m n) p)) (hl_MOD m n)

items.name: MOD_MULT_MOD2
items.source: !m:num. !n:num. !p:num. (m MOD n * p MOD n) MOD n = (m * p) MOD n
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, mod_nat (mod_nat m n * mod_nat p n) n = mod_nat (m * p) n
items.literal: forall m n p :e omega, hl_MOD (hl_mul (hl_MOD m n) (hl_MOD p n)) n = hl_MOD (hl_mul m p) n

items.name: MOD_MULT_RMOD
items.source: !m:num. !n:num. !p:num. (m * p MOD n) MOD n = (m * p) MOD n
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, mod_nat (m * mod_nat p n) n = mod_nat (m * p) n
items.literal: forall m n p :e omega, hl_MOD (hl_mul m (hl_MOD p n)) n = hl_MOD (hl_mul m p) n

items.name: MOD_NSUM_MOD
items.source: !f:A->num. !n:num. !s:A->bool. FINITE s ==> nsum s f MOD n = nsum s (\i:A. f i MOD n) MOD n
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall n :e omega, forall s c= A, finite s -> mod_nat (finsum s f) n = mod_nat (finsum s (fun i:set => mod_nat (f i) n)) n
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f :e omega :^: A, forall n :e omega, forall s :e 2 :^: A, hl_FINITE A s = 1 -> hl_MOD (hl_nsum A s f) n = hl_MOD (hl_nsum A s (fun i :e A => hl_MOD (f i) n)) n

items.name: MOD_NSUM_MOD_NUMSEG
items.source: !f:num->num. !a:num. !b:num. !n:num. nsum (.. a b) f MOD n = nsum (.. a b) (\i:num. f i MOD n) MOD n
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e omega) -> forall a b n :e omega, mod_nat (finsum {i :e omega | a <= i /\ i <= b} f) n = mod_nat (finsum {i :e omega | a <= i /\ i <= b} (fun i:set => mod_nat (f i) n)) n
items.literal: forall f :e omega :^: omega, forall a b n :e omega, hl_MOD (hl_nsum omega (hl_numseg a b) f) n = hl_MOD (hl_nsum omega (hl_numseg a b) (fun i :e omega => hl_MOD (f i) n)) n

items.name: MOD_REFL

items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x = 0) -> finsum s f = 0
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f :e omega :^: A, forall s :e 2 :^: A, (forall x :e A, hl_IN A x s = 1 -> f x = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero) -> hl_nsum A s f = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero

items.name: NSUM_EQ_0_IFF
items.source: !s:A->bool. FINITE s ==> (nsum s f = 0 <=> (!x:A. x IN s ==> f x = 0))
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> (finsum s f = 0 <-> forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x = 0)
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f :e omega :^: A, forall s :e 2 :^: A, hl_FINITE A s = 1 -> (hl_nsum A s f = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero <-> forall x :e A, hl_IN A x s = 1 -> f x = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero)

items.name: NSUM_EQ_0_IFF_NUMSEG
items.source: !f:num->num. !m:num. !n:num. nsum (.. m n) f = 0 <=> (!i:num. m <= i /\ i <= n ==> f i = 0)
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e omega) -> forall m n :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = 0 <-> forall i :e omega, m <= i /\ i <= n -> f i = 0
items.literal: forall f :e omega :^: omega, forall m n :e omega, hl_nsum omega (hl_numseg m n) f = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero <-> forall i :e omega, hl_le m i = 1 /\ hl_le i n = 1 -> f i = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero

items.name: NSUM_EQ_0_NUMSEG
items.source: !f:num->num. !m:num. !n:num. (!i:num. m <= i /\ i <= n ==> f i = 0) ==> nsum (.. m n) f = 0
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e omega) -> forall m n :e omega, (forall i :e omega, m <= i /\ i <= n -> f i = 0) -> finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = 0
items.literal: forall f :e omega :^: omega, forall m n :e omega, (forall i :e omega, hl_le m i = 1 /\ hl_le i n = 1 -> f i = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero) -> hl_nsum omega (hl_numseg m n) f = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero

items.name: NSUM_EQ_GENERAL
items.source: !s:A->bool. !t:B->bool. !f:A->num. !g:B->num. !h:A->B. (!y:B. y IN t ==> (?!x:A. x IN s /\ h x = y)) /\ (!x:A. x IN s ==> h x IN t /\ g (h x) = f x) ==> nsum s f = nsum t g
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e omega) -> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e A, h x :e B) -> (forall y :e B, y :e t -> exists x :e A, x :e s /\ h x = y /\ forall y0 :e A, y0 :e s /\ h y0 = y -> y0 = x) /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> h x :e t /\ g (h x) = f x) -> finsum s f = finsum t g
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s :e 2 :^: A, forall t :e 2 :^: B, forall f :e omega :^: A, forall g :e omega :^: B, forall h :e B :^: A, (forall y :e B, hl_IN B y t = 1 -> hl_exists_unique A (fun x :e A => if hl_IN A x s = 1 /\ h x = y then 1 else 0) = 1) /\ (forall x :e A, hl_IN A x s = 1 -> hl_IN B (h x) t = 1 /\ g (h x) = f x) -> hl_nsum A s f = hl_nsum B t g

items.name: NSUM_EQ_GENERAL_INVERSES

items.name: NSUM_EQ_SUPERSET
items.source: !f:A->num. !s:A->bool. !t:A->bool. FINITE t /\ t SUBSET s /\ (!x:A. x IN t ==> f x = g x) /\ (!x:A. x IN s /\ ~(x IN t) ==> f x = 0) ==> nsum s f = nsum t g
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e omega) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall s t c= A, finite t /\ (t c= s /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e t -> f x = g x) /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s /\ ~ x :e t -> f x = 0))) -> finsum s f = finsum t g
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall g f :e omega :^: A, forall s t :e 2 :^: A, hl_FINITE A t = 1 /\ (hl_SUBSET A t s = 1 /\ ((forall x :e A, hl_IN A x t = 1 -> f x = g x) /\ (forall x :e A, hl_IN A x s = 1 /\ ~ hl_IN A x t = 1 -> f x = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero))) -> hl_nsum A s f = hl_nsum A t g

items.name: NSUM_GROUP_RELATION

items.name: NSUM_IMAGE
items.source: !f:A->B. !g:B->num. !s:A->bool. (!x:A. !y:A. x IN s /\ y IN s /\ f x = f y ==> x = y) ==> nsum (IMAGE f s) g = nsum s (g o f)
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) -> finsum {f x | x :e s} g = finsum s (fun x:set => g (f x))
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f :e B :^: A, forall g :e omega :^: B, forall s :e 2 :^: A, (forall x y :e A, hl_IN A x s = 1 /\ (hl_IN A y s = 1 /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) -> hl_nsum B (hl_IMAGE A B f s) g = hl_nsum A s (hl_o B omega A g f)

items.name: NSUM_IMAGE_NONZERO
items.source: !d:B->num. !i:A->B. !s:A->bool. FINITE s /\ (!x:A. !y:A. x IN s /\ y IN s /\ ~(x = y) /\ i x = i y ==> d (i x) = 0) ==> nsum (IMAGE i s) d = nsum s (d o i)

items.name: NSUM_INCL_EXCL

items.name: NSUM_INJECTION

items.name: NUM_OF_INT_POW
items.source: !x:int. !n:num. int_of_num 0 <= x ==> num_of_int (x pow n) = num_of_int x EXP n
items.statement: forall x :e int, forall n :e omega, 0 <= x -> (if x ^ n :e omega then x ^ n else 0) = (if x :e omega then x else 0) ^ n
items.literal: forall x :e hl_ty_int, forall n :e omega, hl_int_le (hl_int_of_num (hl_NUMERAL hl_zero)) x = 1 -> hl_num_of_int (hl_int_pow x n) = hl_EXP (hl_num_of_int x) n

items.name: NUM_REP_CASES
items.source: !a:ind. NUM_REP a <=> a = IND_0 \/ (?i:ind. a = IND_SUC i /\ NUM_REP i)
items.literal: forall a :e omega, hl_NUM_REP a = 1 <-> a = hl_IND_0 \/ exists i :e omega, a = hl_IND_SUC i /\ hl_NUM_REP i = 1

items.name: NUM_REP_INDUCT
items.source: !NUM_REP':ind->bool. NUM_REP' IND_0 /\ (!i:ind. NUM_REP' i ==> NUM_REP' (IND_SUC i)) ==> (!a:ind. NUM_REP a ==> NUM_REP' a)
items.literal: forall NUM_REP' :e 2 :^: omega, NUM_REP' hl_IND_0 = 1 /\ (forall i :e omega, NUM_REP' i = 1 -> NUM_REP' (hl_IND_SUC i) = 1) -> forall a :e omega, hl_NUM_REP a = 1 -> NUM_REP' a = 1

items.name: NUM_REP_RULES
items.source: NUM_REP IND_0 /\ (!i:ind. NUM_REP i ==> NUM_REP (IND_SUC i))
items.literal: hl_NUM_REP hl_IND_0 = 1 /\ forall i :e omega, hl_NUM_REP i = 1 -> hl_NUM_REP (hl_IND_SUC i) = 1

items.name: ODD
items.source: (ODD 0 <=> F) /\ (!n:num. ODD (SUC n) <=> ~ODD n)
items.statement: (odd_nat 0 <-> False) /\ forall n :e omega, odd_nat (ordsucc n) <-> ~ odd_nat n
items.literal: (hl_ODD (hl_NUMERAL hl_zero) = 1 <-> False) /\ forall n :e omega, hl_ODD (hl_SUC n) = 1 <-> ~ hl_ODD n = 1

items.name: ODD_ADD
items.source: !m:num. !n:num. ODD (m + n) <=> ~(ODD m <=> ODD n)
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, odd_nat (m + n) <-> ~ (odd_nat m <-> odd_nat n)
items.literal: forall m n :e omega, hl_ODD (hl_add m n) = 1 <-> ~ (hl_ODD m = 1 <-> hl_ODD n = 1)

items.name: ODD_DOUBLE
items.source: !n:num. ODD (SUC (2 * n))
items.statement: forall n :e omega, odd_nat (ordsucc (2 * n))
items.literal: forall n :e omega, hl_ODD (hl_SUC (hl_mul (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT0 (hl_BIT1 hl_zero))) n)) = 1

items.name: ODD_EXISTS
items.source: !n:num. ODD n <=> (?m:num. n = SUC (2 * m))
items.statement: forall n :e omega, odd_nat n <-> exists m :e omega, n = ordsucc (2 * m)
items.literal: forall n :e omega, hl_ODD n = 1 <-> exists m :e omega, n = hl_SUC (hl_mul (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT0 (hl_BIT1 hl_zero))) m)

items.name: ODD_EXP
items.source: !m:num. !n:num. ODD (m EXP n) <=> ODD m \/ n = 0
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, odd_nat (m ^ n) <-> odd_nat m \/ n = 0
items.literal: forall m n :e omega, hl_ODD (hl_EXP m n) = 1 <-> hl_ODD m = 1 \/ n = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero

items.name: ODD_MOD
items.source: !n:num. ODD n <=> n MOD 2 = 1
items.statement: forall n :e omega, odd_nat n <-> mod_nat n 2 = 1
items.literal: forall n :e omega, hl_ODD n = 1 <-> hl_MOD n (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT0 (hl_BIT1 hl_zero))) = hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT1 hl_zero)

items.name: ODD_MOD_EVEN
items.source: !m:num. !n:num. EVEN n ==> (ODD (m MOD n) <=> ODD m)
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, even_nat n -> (odd_nat (mod_nat m n) <-> odd_nat m)
items.literal: forall m n :e omega, hl_EVEN n = 1 -> (hl_ODD (hl_MOD m n) = 1 <-> hl_ODD m = 1)

items.name: ODD_MULT
items.source: !m:num. !n:num. ODD (m * n) <=> ODD m /\ ODD n
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, odd_nat (m * n) <-> odd_nat m /\ odd_nat n
items.literal: forall m n :e omega, hl_ODD (hl_mul m n) = 1 <-> hl_ODD m = 1 /\ hl_ODD n = 1

items.name: ODD_SUB
items.source: !m:num. !n:num. ODD (m - n) <=> n < m /\ ~(ODD m <=> ODD n)
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, odd_nat (minus_nat m n) <-> n < m /\ ~ (odd_nat m <-> odd_nat n)
items.literal: forall m n :e omega, hl_ODD (hl_sub m n) = 1 <-> hl_lt n m = 1 /\ ~ (hl_ODD m = 1 <-> hl_ODD n = 1)

items.name: ONE
items.source: 1 = SUC 0
items.literal: hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT1 hl_zero) = hl_SUC (hl_NUMERAL hl_zero)

items.name: ONE_ONE
items.source: !f:A->B. ONE_ONE f <=> (!x1:A. !x2:A. f x1 = f x2 ==> x1 = x2)
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> ((forall x y :e A, f x = f y -> x = y) <-> forall x1 x2 :e A, f x1 = f x2 -> x1 = x2)
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f :e B :^: A, hl_ONE_ONE A B f = 1 <-> forall x1 x2 :e A, f x1 = f x2 -> x1 = x2

items.name: ONE_OR_PRIME
items.source: !p:num. p = 1 \/ prime p <=> (!n:num. num_divides n p ==> n = 1 \/ n = p)
items.statement: forall p :e omega, p = 1 \/ prime_nat p <-> forall n :e omega, divides_nat n p -> n = 1 \/ n = p
items.literal: forall p :e omega, p = hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT1 hl_zero) \/ hl_prime p = 1 <-> forall n :e omega, hl_num_divides n p = 1 -> n = hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT1 hl_zero) \/ n = p

items.name: ONE_OR_PRIME_DIVIDES_OR_COPRIME
items.source: !p:num. p = 1 \/ prime p <=> (!n:num. num_divides p n \/ num_coprime (p , n))
items.statement: forall p :e omega, p = 1 \/ prime_nat p <-> forall n :e omega, divides_nat p n \/ gcd_int p n = 1
items.literal: forall p :e omega, p = hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT1 hl_zero) \/ hl_prime p = 1 <-> forall n :e omega, hl_num_divides p n = 1 \/ hl_num_coprime (hl_pair omega omega p n) = 1

items.name: ONTO
items.source: !f:A->B. ONTO f <=> (!y:B. ?x:A. y = f x)
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> ((forall y :e B, exists x :e A, f x = y) <-> forall y :e B, exists x :e A, y = f x)
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f :e B :^: A, hl_ONTO A B f = 1 <-> forall y :e B, exists x :e A, y = f x

items.name: OR_CLAUSES
items.statement: forall t:prop, (True \/ t <-> True) /\ ((t \/ True <-> True) /\ ((False \/ t <-> t) /\ ((t \/ False <-> t) /\ (t \/ t <-> t))))

items.name: OR_DEF
items.source: \/ = (\p:bool. \q:bool. !r:bool. (p ==> r) ==> (q ==> r) ==> r)
items.statement: forall p q:prop, p \/ q <-> forall r:prop, (p -> r) -> (q -> r) -> r
items.literal: hl_or = fun p :e 2 => fun q :e 2 => if forall r :e 2, (p = 1 -> r = 1) -> (q = 1 -> r = 1) -> r = 1 then 1 else 0

items.name: OR_EXISTS_THM
items.source: !P:A->bool. !Q:A->bool. (?x:A. P x) \/ (?x:A. Q x) <=> (?x:A. P x \/ Q x)
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P Q:set -> prop, (exists x :e A, P x) \/ (exists x :e A, Q x) <-> exists x :e A, P x \/ Q x
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P Q :e 2 :^: A, (exists x :e A, P x = 1) \/ (exists x :e A, Q x = 1) <-> exists x :e A, P x = 1 \/ Q x = 1

items.name: OUTL_thm
items.source: OUTL (INL x) = x
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall x :e A, OUTL A B (Inj0 x) = x
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall x :e A, hl_OUTL A B (hl_INL A B x) = x
items.cert_error: bridge_unsupported: rel: partial application of mapped constant OUTL (view set(A), 1 args)

items.name: OUTR_thm
items.source: OUTR (INR y) = y
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall y :e B, OUTR A B (Inj1 y) = y
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall y :e B, hl_OUTR A B (hl_INR B A y) = y
items.cert_error: bridge_unsupported: rel: partial application of mapped constant OUTR (view set(B), 1 args)

items.name: PAIR
items.source: !x:A#B. FST x , SND x = x
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall x :e A :*: B, (x 0,x 1) = x
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall x :e A :*: B, hl_pair A B (hl_FST A B x) (hl_SND A B x) = x

items.name: PAIRED_ETA_THM
items.source: (!f:A#B->C. GABS (\f':A#B->C. !x:A. !y:B. GEQ (f' (x , y)) (f (x , y))) = f) /\ (!f:A#B#C->D. GABS (\f':A#B#C->D. !x:A. !y:B. !z:C. GEQ (f' (x , y , z)) (f (x , y , z))) = f) /\ (!f:A#B#C#D->E. GABS (\f':A#B#C#D->E. !w:A. !x:B. !y:C. !z:D. GEQ (f' (w , x , y , z)) (f (w , x , y , z))) = f)
items.statement: forall A B C D E:set, C <> Empty -> D <> Empty -> E <> Empty -> (forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A :*: B, f x :e C) -> forall x :e A :*: B, f (x 0,x 1) = f x) /\ ((forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A :*: (B :*: C), f x :e D) -> forall x :e A :*: (B :*: C), f (x 0,(x 1 0,x 1 1)) = f x) /\ forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A :*: (B :*: (C :*: D)), f x :e E) -> forall x :e A :*: (B :*: (C :*: D)), f (x 0,(x 1 0,(x 1 1 0,x 1 1 1))) = f x)
items.literal: forall A B C D E:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> D <> Empty -> E <> Empty -> (forall f :e C :^: (A :*: B), hl_GABS (C :^: (A :*: B)) (fun f' :e C :^: (A :*: B) => if forall x :e A, forall y :e B, hl_GEQ C (f' (hl_pair A B x y)) (f (hl_pair A B x y)) = 1 then 1 else 0) = f) /\ ((forall f :e D :^: (A :*: (B :*: C)), hl_GABS (D :^: (A :*: (B :*: C))) (fun f' :e D :^: (A :*: (B :*: C)) => if forall x :e A, forall y :e B, forall z :e C, hl_GEQ D (f' (hl_pair A (B :*: C) x (hl_pair B C y z))) (f (hl_pair A (B :*: C) x (hl_pair B C y z))) = 1 then 1 else 0) = f) /\ forall f :e E :^: (A :*: (B :*: (C :*: D))), hl_GABS (E :^: (A :*: (B :*: (C :*: D)))) (fun f' :e E :^: (A :*: (B :*: (C :*: D))) => if forall w :e A, forall x :e B, forall y :e C, forall z :e D, hl_GEQ E (f' (hl_pair A (B :*: (C :*: D)) w (hl_pair B (C :*: D) x (hl_pair C D y z)))) (f (hl_pair A (B :*: (C :*: D)) w (hl_pair B (C :*: D) x (hl_pair C D y z)))) = 1 then 1 else 0) = f)

items.name: PAIRWISE
items.source: (PAIRWISE r NIL <=> T) /\ (PAIRWISE r (h CONS t) <=> ALL (r h) t /\ PAIRWISE r t)
items.statement: forall A:set, forall r:set -> set -> prop, forall h :e A, forall t :e finseq A, (seq_pairwise r seq_nil <-> True) /\ (seq_pairwise r (seq_cons h t) <-> seq_all (r h) t /\ seq_pairwise r t)
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall r :e 2 :^: A :^: A, forall h :e A, forall t :e finseq A, (hl_PAIRWISE A r (hl_NIL A) = 1 <-> True) /\ (hl_PAIRWISE A r (hl_CONS A h t) = 1 <-> hl_ALL A (r h) t = 1 /\ hl_PAIRWISE A r t = 1)

items.name: PAIRWISE_AND
items.source: !R:A->A->bool. !R':A->A->bool. !s:A->bool. pairwise R s /\ pairwise R' s <=> pairwise (\x:A. \y:A. R x y /\ R' x y) s
items.statement: forall A:set, forall R0 R':set -> set -> prop, forall s c= A, (forall x y :e s, x <> y -> R0 x y) /\ (forall x y :e s, x <> y -> R' x y) <-> forall x y :e s, x <> y -> R0 x y /\ R' x y
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall R1 R' :e 2 :^: A :^: A, forall s :e 2 :^: A, hl_pairwise A R1 s = 1 /\ hl_pairwise A R' s = 1 <-> hl_pairwise A (fun x :e A => fun y :e A => if R1 x y = 1 /\ R' x y = 1 then 1 else 0) s = 1

items.name: PAIRWISE_APPEND
items.source: !R:A->A->bool. !l:A list. !m:A list. PAIRWISE R (l APPEND m) <=> PAIRWISE R l /\ PAIRWISE R m /\ (!x:A. !y:A. MEM x l /\ MEM y m ==> R x y)
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall l m :e finseq A, seq_pairwise R0 (seq_append l m) <-> seq_pairwise R0 l /\ (seq_pairwise R0 m /\ forall x y :e A, seq_mem x l /\ seq_mem y m -> R0 x y)
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall R1 :e 2 :^: A :^: A, forall l m :e finseq A, hl_PAIRWISE A R1 (hl_APPEND A l m) = 1 <-> hl_PAIRWISE A R1 l = 1 /\ (hl_PAIRWISE A R1 m = 1 /\ forall x y :e A, hl_MEM A x l = 1 /\ hl_MEM A y m = 1 -> R1 x y = 1)

items.name: PAIRWISE_CHAIN_UNIONS
items.source: !R:A->A->bool. !c:(A->bool)->bool. (!s:A->bool. s IN c ==> pairwise R s) /\ (!s:A->bool. !t:A->bool. s IN c /\ t IN c ==> s SUBSET t \/ t SUBSET s) ==> pairwise R (UNIONS c)
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall c c= Power A, (forall s c= A, s :e c -> forall x y :e s, x <> y -> R0 x y) /\ (forall s t c= A, s :e c /\ t :e c -> s c= t \/ t c= s) -> forall x y :e Union c, x <> y -> R0 x y
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall R1 :e 2 :^: A :^: A, forall c :e 2 :^: (2 :^: A), (forall s :e 2 :^: A, hl_IN (2 :^: A) s c = 1 -> hl_pairwise A R1 s = 1) /\ (forall s t :e 2 :^: A, hl_IN (2 :^: A) s c = 1 /\ hl_IN (2 :^: A) t c = 1 -> hl_SUBSET A s t = 1 \/ hl_SUBSET A t s = 1) -> hl_pairwise A R1 (hl_UNIONS A c) = 1

items.name: PAIRWISE_EMPTY
items.source: !r:A->A->bool. pairwise r EMPTY <=> T
items.statement: forall A:set, forall r:set -> set -> prop, (forall x y :e Empty, x <> y -> r x y) <-> True
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall r :e 2 :^: A :^: A, hl_pairwise A r (hl_EMPTY A) = 1 <-> True

items.name: PAIRWISE_IMAGE
items.source: !r:B->B->bool. !f:A->B. pairwise r (IMAGE f s) <=> pairwise (\x:A. \y:A. ~(f x = f y) ==> r (f x) (f y)) s
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall r:set -> set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> ((forall x y :e {f x | x :e s}, x <> y -> r x y) <-> forall x y :e s, x <> y -> ~ f x = f y -> r (f x) (f y))
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s :e 2 :^: A, forall r :e 2 :^: B :^: B, forall f :e B :^: A, hl_pairwise B r (hl_IMAGE A B f s) = 1 <-> hl_pairwise A (fun x :e A => fun y :e A => if ~ f x = f y -> r (f x) (f y) = 1 then 1 else 0) s = 1

items.name: PAIRWISE_IMP
items.source: !P:A->A->bool. !Q:A->A->bool. !s:A->bool. pairwise P s /\ (!x:A. !y:A. x IN s /\ y IN s /\ P x y /\ ~(x = y) ==> Q x y) ==> pairwise Q s
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P Q:set -> set -> prop, forall s c= A, (forall x y :e s, x <> y -> P x y) /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ (P x y /\ ~ x = y)) -> Q x y) -> forall x y :e s, x <> y -> Q x y
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P Q :e 2 :^: A :^: A, forall s :e 2 :^: A, hl_pairwise A P s = 1 /\ (forall x y :e A, hl_IN A x s = 1 /\ (hl_IN A y s = 1 /\ (P x y = 1 /\ ~ x = y)) -> Q x y = 1) -> hl_pairwise A Q s = 1

items.name: PAIRWISE_IMPLIES
items.source: !R:A->A->bool. !R':A->A->bool. !l:A list. PAIRWISE R l /\ (!x:A. !y:A. MEM x l /\ MEM y l /\ R x y ==> R' x y) ==> PAIRWISE R' l
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall R0 R':set -> set -> prop, forall l :e finseq A, seq_pairwise R0 l /\ (forall x y :e A, seq_mem x l /\ (seq_mem y l /\ R0 x y) -> R' x y) -> seq_pairwise R' l
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall R1 R' :e 2 :^: A :^: A, forall l :e finseq A, hl_PAIRWISE A R1 l = 1 /\ (forall x y :e A, hl_MEM A x l = 1 /\ (hl_MEM A y l = 1 /\ R1 x y = 1) -> R' x y = 1) -> hl_PAIRWISE A R' l = 1

items.name: PAIRWISE_INSERT
items.source: !r:A->A->bool. !x:A. !s:A->bool. pairwise r (x INSERT s) <=> (!y:A. y IN s /\ ~(y = x) ==> r x y /\ r y x) /\ pairwise r s
items.statement: forall A:set, forall r:set -> set -> prop, forall x :e A, forall s c= A, (forall x0 y :e SetAdjoin s x, x0 <> y -> r x0 y) <-> (forall y :e A, y :e s /\ ~ y = x -> r x y /\ r y x) /\ forall x y :e s, x <> y -> r x y
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall r :e 2 :^: A :^: A, forall x :e A, forall s :e 2 :^: A, hl_pairwise A r (hl_INSERT A x s) = 1 <-> (forall y :e A, hl_IN A y s = 1 /\ ~ y = x -> r x y = 1 /\ r y x = 1) /\ hl_pairwise A r s = 1

items.name: PAIRWISE_INSERT_SYMMETRIC
items.source: !r:A->A->bool. !x:A. !s:A->bool. (!y:A. y IN s ==> (r x y <=> r y x)) ==> (pairwise r (x INSERT s) <=> (!y:A. y IN s /\ ~(y = x) ==> r x y) /\ pairwise r s)
items.statement: forall A:set, forall r:set -> set -> prop, forall x :e A, forall s c= A, (forall y :e A, y :e s -> (r x y <-> r y x)) -> ((forall x0 y :e SetAdjoin s x, x0 <> y -> r x0 y) <-> (forall y :e A, y :e s /\ ~ y = x -> r x y) /\ forall x y :e s, x <> y -> r x y)
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall r :e 2 :^: A :^: A, forall x :e A, forall s :e 2 :^: A, (forall y :e A, hl_IN A y s = 1 -> (r x y = 1 <-> r y x = 1)) -> (hl_pairwise A r (hl_INSERT A x s) = 1 <-> (forall y :e A, hl_IN A y s = 1 /\ ~ y = x -> r x y = 1) /\ hl_pairwise A r s = 1)

items.name: PAIRWISE_MAP
items.source: !R:B->B->bool. !f:A->B. !l:A list. PAIRWISE R (MAP f l) <=> PAIRWISE (\x:A. \y:A. R (f x) (f y)) l
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall l :e finseq A, seq_pairwise R0 (seq_map f l) <-> seq_pairwise (fun x:set => fun y:set => R0 (f x) (f y)) l
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall R1 :e 2 :^: B :^: B, forall f :e B :^: A, forall l :e finseq A, hl_PAIRWISE B R1 (hl_MAP A B f l) = 1 <-> hl_PAIRWISE A (fun x :e A => fun y :e A => R1 (f x) (f y)) l = 1

items.name: PAIRWISE_MONO
items.source: !r:A->A->bool. !s:A->bool. !t:A->bool. pairwise r s /\ t SUBSET s ==> pairwise r t
items.statement: forall A:set, forall r:set -> set -> prop, forall s t c= A, (forall x y :e s, x <> y -> r x y) /\ t c= s -> forall x y :e t, x <> y -> r x y
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall r :e 2 :^: A :^: A, forall s t :e 2 :^: A, hl_pairwise A r s = 1 /\ hl_SUBSET A t s = 1 -> hl_pairwise A r t = 1

items.name: PAIRWISE_SING
items.source: !r:A->A->bool. !x:A. pairwise r (x INSERT EMPTY) <=> T
items.statement: forall A:set, forall r:set -> set -> prop, forall x :e A, (forall x0 y :e {x}, x0 <> y -> r x0 y) <-> True
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall r :e 2 :^: A :^: A, forall x :e A, hl_pairwise A r (hl_INSERT A x (hl_EMPTY A)) = 1 <-> True

items.name: PAIRWISE_TRANSITIVE
items.source: !R:A->A->bool. !x:A. !y:A. !l:A list. (!x1:A. !y1:A. !z:A. R x1 y1 /\ R y1 z ==> R x1 z) ==> (PAIRWISE R (x CONS y CONS l) <=> R x y /\ PAIRWISE R (y CONS l))
items.statement: forall A:set, forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall x y :e A, forall l :e finseq A, (forall x0 y0 z :e A, R0 x0 y0 /\ R0 y0 z -> R0 x0 z) -> (seq_pairwise R0 (seq_cons x (seq_cons y l)) <-> R0 x y /\ seq_pairwise R0 (seq_cons y l))

items.name: PSUBSET

items.name: PSUBSET_UNIONS_PAIRWISE_DISJOINT
items.source: !u:(A->bool)->bool. !v:(A->bool)->bool. pairwise DISJOINT v /\ PSUBSET u (v DELETE EMPTY) ==> PSUBSET (UNIONS u) (UNIONS v)
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u v c= Power A, (forall x y :e v, x <> y -> x :/\: y = Empty) /\ (u c= v :\: {Empty} /\ u <> v :\: {Empty}) -> Union u c= Union v /\ Union u <> Union v

items.statement: forall x :e R, abs_SNo (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) = if 0 < abs_SNo x then 1 else if abs_SNo x < 0 then - 1 else 0
items.literal: forall x :e R, hl_real_abs (hl_real_sgn x) = hl_real_sgn (hl_real_abs x)

items.name: REAL_ABS_SIGN
items.source: !x:real. !y:real. real_abs (x - y) < y ==> real_of_num 0 < x
items.statement: forall x y :e R, abs_SNo (x + - y) < y -> 0 < x
items.literal: forall x y :e R, hl_real_lt (hl_real_abs (hl_real_sub x y)) y = 1 -> hl_real_lt (hl_real_of_num (hl_NUMERAL hl_zero)) x = 1

items.name: REAL_ABS_SIGN2
items.source: !x:real. !y:real. real_abs (x - y) < real_neg y ==> x < real_of_num 0
items.statement: forall x y :e R, abs_SNo (x + - y) < - y -> x < 0
items.literal: forall x y :e R, hl_real_lt (hl_real_abs (hl_real_sub x y)) (hl_real_neg y) = 1 -> hl_real_lt x (hl_real_of_num (hl_NUMERAL hl_zero)) = 1

items.name: REAL_ABS_SQRT
items.source: !x:real. real_abs (sqrt x) = sqrt (real_abs x)
items.statement: forall x :e R, abs_SNo (if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) = if 0 <= abs_SNo x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg (abs_SNo x) else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- abs_SNo x)
items.literal: forall x :e R, hl_real_abs (hl_sqrt x) = hl_sqrt (hl_real_abs x)

items.name: REAL_ABS_STILLNZ
items.source: !x:real. !y:real. real_abs (x - y) < real_abs y ==> ~(x = real_of_num 0)
items.statement: forall x y :e R, abs_SNo (x + - y) < abs_SNo y -> ~ x = 0
items.literal: forall x y :e R, hl_real_lt (hl_real_abs (hl_real_sub x y)) (hl_real_abs y) = 1 -> ~ x = hl_real_of_num (hl_NUMERAL hl_zero)

items.name: REAL_ABS_SUB
items.source: !x:real. !y:real. real_abs (x - y) = real_abs (y - x)
items.statement: forall x y :e R, abs_SNo (x + - y) = abs_SNo (y + - x)
items.literal: forall x y :e R, hl_real_abs (hl_real_sub x y) = hl_real_abs (hl_real_sub y x)

items.name: REAL_ABS_SUB_ABS
items.source: !x:real. !y:real. real_abs (real_abs x - real_abs y) <= real_abs (x - y)
items.statement: forall x y :e R, abs_SNo (abs_SNo x + - abs_SNo y) <= abs_SNo (x + - y)
items.literal: forall x y :e R, hl_real_le (hl_real_abs (hl_real_sub (hl_real_abs x) (hl_real_abs y))) (hl_real_abs (hl_real_sub x y)) = 1

items.name: REAL_ABS_SUP_LE
items.source: !s:real->bool. !a:real. ~(s = EMPTY) /\ (!x:real. x IN s ==> real_abs x <= a) ==> real_abs (sup s) <= a
items.statement: forall s c= R, forall a :e R, ~ s = Empty /\ (forall x :e R, x :e s -> abs_SNo x <= a) -> abs_SNo (sup s) <= a
items.literal: forall s :e 2 :^: R, forall a :e R, ~ s = hl_EMPTY R /\ (forall x :e R, hl_IN R x s = 1 -> hl_real_le (hl_real_abs x) a = 1) -> hl_real_le (hl_real_abs (hl_sup s)) a = 1

items.name: REAL_ABS_TRIANGLE
items.source: !x:real. !y:real. real_abs (x + y) <= real_abs x + real_abs y
items.statement: forall x y :e R, abs_SNo (x + y) <= abs_SNo x + abs_SNo y
items.literal: forall x y :e R, hl_real_le (hl_real_abs (hl_real_add x y)) (hl_real_add (hl_real_abs x) (hl_real_abs y)) = 1

items.name: REAL_ABS_TRIANGLE_LE
items.source: !x:real. !y:real. !z:real. real_abs x + real_abs (y - x) <= z ==> real_abs y <= z
items.statement: forall x y z :e R, abs_SNo x + abs_SNo (y + - x) <= z -> abs_SNo y <= z
items.literal: forall x y z :e R, hl_real_le (hl_real_add (hl_real_abs x) (hl_real_abs (hl_real_sub y x))) z = 1 -> hl_real_le (hl_real_abs y) z = 1

items.name: REAL_ABS_TRIANGLE_LT
items.source: !x:real. !y:real. !z:real. real_abs x + real_abs (y - x) < z ==> real_abs y < z
items.statement: forall x y z :e R, abs_SNo x + abs_SNo (y + - x) < z -> abs_SNo y < z
items.literal: forall x y z :e R, hl_real_lt (hl_real_add (hl_real_abs x) (hl_real_abs (hl_real_sub y x))) z = 1 -> hl_real_lt (hl_real_abs y) z = 1

items.name: REAL_ABS_ZERO
items.source: !x:real. real_abs x = real_of_num 0 <=> x = real_of_num 0
items.statement: forall x :e R, abs_SNo x = 0 <-> x = 0
items.literal: forall x :e R, hl_real_abs x = hl_real_of_num (hl_NUMERAL hl_zero) <-> x = hl_real_of_num (hl_NUMERAL hl_zero)

items.name: REAL_ABS_ZPOW
items.source: !x:real. !n:int. real_abs (real_zpow x n) = real_zpow (real_abs x) n
items.statement: forall x :e R, forall n :e int, abs_SNo (if 0 <= n then x ^ n else recip_SNo (x ^ (- n))) = if 0 <= n then abs_SNo x ^ n else recip_SNo (abs_SNo x ^ (- n))
items.literal: forall x :e R, forall n :e hl_ty_int, hl_real_abs (hl_real_zpow x n) = hl_real_zpow (hl_real_abs x) n

items.name: REAL_ADD2_SUB2
items.source: !a:real. !b:real. !c:real. !d:real. (a + b) - (c + d) = a - c + b - d
items.statement: forall a b c d :e R, (a + b) + - (c + d) = (a + - c) + b + - d
items.literal: forall a b c d :e R, hl_real_sub (hl_real_add a b) (hl_real_add c d) = hl_real_add (hl_real_sub a c) (hl_real_sub b d)

items.name: REAL_ADD_AC
items.source: m + n = n + m /\ (m + n) + p = m + n + p /\ m + n + p = n + m + p
items.statement: forall m n p :e R, m + n = n + m /\ ((m + n) + p = m + n + p /\ m + n + p = n + m + p)
items.literal: forall m n p :e R, hl_real_add m n = hl_real_add n m /\ (hl_real_add (hl_real_add m n) p = hl_real_add m (hl_real_add n p) /\ hl_real_add m (hl_real_add n p) = hl_real_add n (hl_real_add m p))

items.name: REAL_ADD_ASSOC
items.source: !x:real. !y:real. !z:real. x + y + z = (x + y) + z
items.statement: forall x y z :e R, x + y + z = (x + y) + z
items.literal: forall x y z :e R, hl_real_add x (hl_real_add y z) = hl_real_add (hl_real_add x y) z

items.name: REAL_ADD_LDISTRIB
items.source: !x:real. !y:real. !z:real. x * (y + z) = x * y + x * z
items.statement: forall x y z :e R, x * (y + z) = x * y + x * z
items.literal: forall x y z :e R, hl_real_mul x (hl_real_add y z) = hl_real_add (hl_real_mul x y) (hl_real_mul x z)

items.name: REAL_ADD_LID
items.source: !x:real. real_of_num 0 + x = x
items.statement: forall x :e R, 0 + x = x
items.literal: forall x :e R, hl_real_add (hl_real_of_num (hl_NUMERAL hl_zero)) x = x

items.name: REAL_ADD_LINV

items.statement: forall x :e R, - x + x = 0
items.literal: forall x :e R, hl_real_add (hl_real_neg x) x = hl_real_of_num (hl_NUMERAL hl_zero)

items.name: REAL_ADD_RDISTRIB
items.source: !x:real. !y:real. !z:real. (x + y) * z = x * z + y * z
items.statement: forall x y z :e R, (x + y) * z = x * z + y * z
items.literal: forall x y z :e R, hl_real_mul (hl_real_add x y) z = hl_real_add (hl_real_mul x z) (hl_real_mul y z)

items.source: !x:real. x + real_of_num 0 = x
items.statement: forall x :e R, x + 0 = x
items.literal: forall x :e R, hl_real_add x (hl_real_of_num (hl_NUMERAL hl_zero)) = x

items.source: !x:real. x + real_neg x = real_of_num 0
items.statement: forall x :e R, x + - x = 0
items.literal: forall x :e R, hl_real_add x (hl_real_neg x) = hl_real_of_num (hl_NUMERAL hl_zero)

items.name: REAL_ADD_SUB
items.source: !x:real. !y:real. (x + y) - x = y
items.statement: forall x y :e R, (x + y) + - x = y
items.literal: forall x y :e R, hl_real_sub (hl_real_add x y) x = y

items.name: REAL_ADD_SUB2
items.source: !x:real. !y:real. x - (x + y) = real_neg y
items.statement: forall x y :e R, x + - (x + y) = - y
items.literal: forall x y :e R, hl_real_sub x (hl_real_add x y) = hl_real_neg y

items.name: REAL_ADD_SYM
items.source: !x:real. !y:real. x + y = y + x
items.statement: forall x y :e R, x + y = y + x
items.literal: forall x y :e R, hl_real_add x y = hl_real_add y x

items.name: REAL_ARCH
items.source: !x:real. real_of_num 0 < x ==> (!y:real. ?n:num. y < real_of_num n * x)
items.statement: forall x :e R, 0 < x -> forall y :e R, exists n :e omega, y < n * x
items.literal: forall x :e R, hl_real_lt (hl_real_of_num (hl_NUMERAL hl_zero)) x = 1 -> forall y :e R, exists n :e omega, hl_real_lt y (hl_real_mul (hl_real_of_num n) x) = 1

items.name: REAL_ARCH_INV
items.source: !e:real. real_of_num 0 < e <=> (?n:num. ~(n = 0) /\ real_of_num 0 < real_inv (real_of_num n) /\ real_inv (real_of_num n) < e)
items.statement: forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 <-> exists n :e omega, ~ n = 0 /\ (0 < recip_SNo n /\ recip_SNo n < e0)
items.literal: forall e1 :e R, hl_real_lt (hl_real_of_num (hl_NUMERAL hl_zero)) e1 = 1 <-> exists n :e omega, ~ n = hl_NUMERAL hl_zero /\ (hl_real_lt (hl_real_of_num (hl_NUMERAL hl_zero)) (hl_real_inv (hl_real_of_num n)) = 1 /\ hl_real_lt (hl_real_inv (hl_real_of_num n)) e1 = 1)

items.name: REAL_ARCH_LT

items.statement: forall x :e R, exists n :e omega, x < n
items.literal: forall x :e R, exists n :e omega, hl_real_lt x (hl_real_of_num n) = 1

items.source: !x:real. !y:real. real_of_num 1 < x ==> (?n:num. y < x pow n)
items.statement: forall x y :e R, 1 < x -> exists n :e omega, y < x ^ n
items.literal: forall x y :e R, hl_real_lt (hl_real_of_num (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT1 hl_zero))) x = 1 -> exists n :e omega, hl_real_lt y (hl_real_pow x n) = 1

items.statement: forall x :e R, exists n :e omega, x < 2 ^ n

items.statement: forall x y :e R, 0 < y /\ x < 1 -> exists n :e omega, x ^ n < y
items.literal: forall x y :e R, hl_real_lt (hl_real_of_num (hl_NUMERAL hl_zero)) y = 1 /\ hl_real_lt x (hl_real_of_num (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT1 hl_zero))) = 1 -> exists n :e omega, hl_real_lt (hl_real_pow x n) y = 1

items.statement: forall x :e R, exists n :e omega, x <= n

items.literal: forall x k :e R, hl_real_le (hl_real_neg k) x = 1 /\ hl_real_le x k = 1 <-> hl_real_le (hl_real_abs x) k = 1

items.name: REAL_COMPLETE
items.source: !P:real->bool. (?x:real. P x) /\ (?M:real. !x:real. P x ==> x <= M) ==> (?M:real. (!x:real. P x ==> x <= M) /\ (!M':real. (!x:real. P x ==> x <= M') ==> M <= M'))
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, (exists x :e R, P x) /\ (exists M :e R, forall x :e R, P x -> x <= M) -> exists M :e R, (forall x :e R, P x -> x <= M) /\ forall M' :e R, (forall x :e R, P x -> x <= M') -> M <= M'
items.literal: forall P :e 2 :^: R, (exists x :e R, P x = 1) /\ (exists M :e R, forall x :e R, P x = 1 -> hl_real_le x M = 1) -> exists M :e R, (forall x :e R, P x = 1 -> hl_real_le x M = 1) /\ forall M' :e R, (forall x :e R, P x = 1 -> hl_real_le x M' = 1) -> hl_real_le M M' = 1

items.name: REAL_COMPLETE_SOMEPOS
items.source: !P:real->bool. (?x:real. P x /\ real_of_num 0 <= x) /\ (?M:real. !x:real. P x ==> x <= M) ==> (?M:real. (!x:real. P x ==> x <= M) /\ (!M':real. (!x:real. P x ==> x <= M') ==> M <= M'))
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, (exists x :e R, P x /\ 0 <= x) /\ (exists M :e R, forall x :e R, P x -> x <= M) -> exists M :e R, (forall x :e R, P x -> x <= M) /\ forall M' :e R, (forall x :e R, P x -> x <= M') -> M <= M'
items.literal: forall P :e 2 :^: R, (exists x :e R, P x = 1 /\ hl_real_le (hl_real_of_num (hl_NUMERAL hl_zero)) x = 1) /\ (exists M :e R, forall x :e R, P x = 1 -> hl_real_le x M = 1) -> exists M :e R, (forall x :e R, P x = 1 -> hl_real_le x M = 1) /\ forall M' :e R, (forall x :e R, P x = 1 -> hl_real_le x M' = 1) -> hl_real_le M M' = 1

items.statement: forall x :e R, (if 0 < if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x) then 1 else if (if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) < 0 then - 1 else 0) = if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0
items.literal: forall x :e R, hl_real_sgn (hl_sqrt x) = hl_real_sgn x

items.name: REAL_SGN_ZPOW
items.source: !x:real. !n:int. real_sgn (real_zpow x n) = real_zpow (real_sgn x) n
items.statement: forall x :e R, forall n :e int, (if 0 < if 0 <= n then x ^ n else recip_SNo (x ^ (- n)) then 1 else if (if 0 <= n then x ^ n else recip_SNo (x ^ (- n))) < 0 then - 1 else 0) = if 0 <= n then (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) ^ n else recip_SNo ((if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) ^ (- n))

items.name: REAL_SHRINK_EQ

items.literal: forall x y :e R, hl_real_div x (hl_real_add (hl_real_of_num (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT1 hl_zero))) (hl_real_abs x)) = hl_real_div y (hl_real_add (hl_real_of_num (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT1 hl_zero))) (hl_real_abs y)) <-> x = y

items.statement: forall x :e R, abs_SNo x < 1 -> (x :/: (1 + - abs_SNo x)) :/: (1 + abs_SNo (x :/: (1 + - abs_SNo x))) = x
items.literal: forall x :e R, hl_real_lt (hl_real_abs x) (hl_real_of_num (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT1 hl_zero))) = 1 -> hl_real_div (hl_real_div x (hl_real_sub (hl_real_of_num (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT1 hl_zero))) (hl_real_abs x))) (hl_real_add (hl_real_of_num (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT1 hl_zero))) (hl_real_abs (hl_real_div x (hl_real_sub (hl_real_of_num (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT1 hl_zero))) (hl_real_abs x))))) = x

items.statement: forall x :e R, (x :/: (1 + - abs_SNo x)) :/: (1 + abs_SNo (x :/: (1 + - abs_SNo x))) = x <-> abs_SNo x < 1
items.literal: forall x :e R, hl_real_div (hl_real_div x (hl_real_sub (hl_real_of_num (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT1 hl_zero))) (hl_real_abs x))) (hl_real_add (hl_real_of_num (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT1 hl_zero))) (hl_real_abs (hl_real_div x (hl_real_sub (hl_real_of_num (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT1 hl_zero))) (hl_real_abs x))))) = x <-> hl_real_lt (hl_real_abs x) (hl_real_of_num (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT1 hl_zero))) = 1

items.name: REAL_SUB_INV
items.source: !x:real. !y:real. ~(x = real_of_num 0) /\ ~(y = real_of_num 0) ==> real_inv x - real_inv y = (y - x) / (x * y)
items.statement: forall x y :e R, ~ x = 0 /\ ~ y = 0 -> recip_SNo x + - recip_SNo y = (y + - x) :/: (x * y)

items.name: REAL_SUB_POLYFUN

items.literal: forall a :e R :^: omega, forall x y :e R, forall n :e omega, hl_le (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT1 hl_zero)) n = 1 -> hl_real_sub (hl_sum omega (hl_numseg (hl_NUMERAL hl_zero) n) (fun i :e omega => hl_real_mul (a i) (hl_real_pow x i))) (hl_sum omega (hl_numseg (hl_NUMERAL hl_zero) n) (fun i :e omega => hl_real_mul (a i) (hl_real_pow y i))) = hl_real_mul (hl_real_sub x y) (hl_sum omega (hl_numseg (hl_NUMERAL hl_zero) (hl_sub n (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT1 hl_zero)))) (fun j :e omega => hl_real_mul (hl_sum omega (hl_numseg (hl_add j (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT1 hl_zero))) n) (fun i :e omega => hl_real_mul (a i) (hl_real_pow y (hl_sub (hl_sub i j) (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT1 hl_zero)))))) (hl_real_pow x j)))

items.name: REAL_SUP_ASCLOSE

items.statement: forall s c= R, forall l e0 :e R, ~ s = Empty /\ (forall x :e R, x :e s -> abs_SNo (x + - l) <= e0) -> abs_SNo (sup s + - l) <= e0

items.statement: forall s c= R, forall a b :e R, ~ s = Empty /\ (forall x :e R, x :e s -> a <= x /\ x <= b) -> a <= sup s /\ sup s <= b
items.literal: forall s :e 2 :^: R, forall a b :e R, ~ s = hl_EMPTY R /\ (forall x :e R, hl_IN R x s = 1 -> hl_real_le a x = 1 /\ hl_real_le x b = 1) -> hl_real_le a (hl_sup s) = 1 /\ hl_real_le (hl_sup s) b = 1

items.name: REFL_CLAUSE
items.source: !x:A. x = x <=> T
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, x = x <-> True
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e A, x = x <-> True

items.name: REPLICATE
items.source: REPLICATE 0 x = NIL /\ REPLICATE (SUC n) x = x CONS REPLICATE n x
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall n :e omega, seq_replicate 0 x = seq_nil /\ seq_replicate (ordsucc n) x = seq_cons x (seq_replicate n x)
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e A, forall n :e omega, hl_REPLICATE A (hl_NUMERAL hl_zero) x = hl_NIL A /\ hl_REPLICATE A (hl_SUC n) x = hl_CONS A x (hl_REPLICATE A n x)

items.name: REP_ABS_PAIR
items.error: internal constant mk_pair (HOL Light internal construction)
items.source: !x:A. !y:B. REP_prod (ABS_prod (mk_pair x y)) = mk_pair x y
items.cert_error: ABS_prod (representation function of the primitive type prod); REP_prod (representation function of the primitive type prod)

items.name: REST
items.source: !s:A->bool. REST s = s DELETE CHOICE s
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, s :\: {choose_in A (fun x:set => x :e s)} = s :\: {choose_in A (fun x:set => x :e s)}
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s :e 2 :^: A, hl_REST A s = hl_DELETE A s (hl_CHOICE A s)

items.name: RESTRICTION
items.source: !s:A->bool. !f:A->B. !x:A. RESTRICTION s f x = (if x IN s then f x else ARB)
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall x :e A, (if x :e s then f x else choose_in B (fun y:set => False)) = if x :e s then f x else choose_in B (fun x:set => False)
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s :e 2 :^: A, forall f :e B :^: A, forall x :e A, hl_RESTRICTION A B s f x = hl_COND B (hl_IN A x s) (f x) (hl_ARB B)

items.name: RESTRICTION_COMPOSE
items.source: !f:A->B. !g:B->C. !s:A->bool. !t:B->bool. IMAGE f s SUBSET t ==> RESTRICTION s (RESTRICTION t g o RESTRICTION s f) = RESTRICTION s (g o f)
items.statement: forall A B C:set, B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e C) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, {f x | x :e s} c= t -> forall x :e A, (if x :e s then if (if x :e s then f x else choose_in B (fun y:set => False)) :e t then g (if x :e s then f x else choose_in B (fun y:set => False)) else choose_in C (fun y:set => False) else choose_in C (fun y:set => False)) = if x :e s then g (f x) else choose_in C (fun y:set => False)
items.literal: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f :e B :^: A, forall g :e C :^: B, forall s :e 2 :^: A, forall t :e 2 :^: B, hl_SUBSET B (hl_IMAGE A B f s) t = 1 -> hl_RESTRICTION A C s (hl_o B C A (hl_RESTRICTION B C t g) (hl_RESTRICTION A B s f)) = hl_RESTRICTION A C s (hl_o B C A g f)

items.name: RESTRICTION_COMPOSE_LEFT
items.source: !f:A->B. !g:B->C. !s:A->bool. !t:B->bool. IMAGE f s SUBSET t ==> RESTRICTION s (RESTRICTION t g o f) = RESTRICTION s (g o f)
items.statement: forall A B C:set, B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e C) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, {f x | x :e s} c= t -> forall x :e A, (if x :e s then if f x :e t then g (f x) else choose_in C (fun y:set => False) else choose_in C (fun y:set => False)) = if x :e s then g (f x) else choose_in C (fun y:set => False)
items.literal: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f :e B :^: A, forall g :e C :^: B, forall s :e 2 :^: A, forall t :e 2 :^: B, hl_SUBSET B (hl_IMAGE A B f s) t = 1 -> hl_RESTRICTION A C s (hl_o B C A (hl_RESTRICTION B C t g) f) = hl_RESTRICTION A C s (hl_o B C A g f)

items.name: RESTRICTION_COMPOSE_RIGHT
items.source: !f:A->B. !g:B->C. !s:A->bool. RESTRICTION s (g o RESTRICTION s f) = RESTRICTION s (g o f)
items.statement: forall A B C:set, B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e C) -> forall s c= A, forall x :e A, (if x :e s then g (if x :e s then f x else choose_in B (fun y:set => False)) else choose_in C (fun y:set => False)) = if x :e s then g (f x) else choose_in C (fun y:set => False)
items.literal: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f :e B :^: A, forall g :e C :^: B, forall s :e 2 :^: A, hl_RESTRICTION A C s (hl_o B C A g (hl_RESTRICTION A B s f)) = hl_RESTRICTION A C s (hl_o B C A g f)

items.name: RESTRICTION_DEFINED
items.source: !s:A->bool. !f:A->B. !x:A. x IN s ==> RESTRICTION s f x = f x
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall x :e A, x :e s -> (if x :e s then f x else choose_in B (fun y:set => False)) = f x
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s :e 2 :^: A, forall f :e B :^: A, forall x :e A, hl_IN A x s = 1 -> hl_RESTRICTION A B s f x = f x

items.name: RESTRICTION_EQ
items.source: !s:A->bool. !f:A->B. !x:A. !y:B. x IN s /\ f x = y ==> RESTRICTION s f x = y
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall x :e A, forall y :e B, x :e s /\ f x = y -> (if x :e s then f x else choose_in B (fun y:set => False)) = y
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s :e 2 :^: A, forall f :e B :^: A, forall x :e A, forall y :e B, hl_IN A x s = 1 /\ f x = y -> hl_RESTRICTION A B s f x = y

items.name: RESTRICTION_EXTENSION
items.source: !s:A->bool. !f:A->B. !g:A->B. RESTRICTION s f = RESTRICTION s g <=> (!x:A. x IN s ==> f x = g x)
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> ((forall x :e A, (if x :e s then f x else choose_in B (fun y:set => False)) = if x :e s then g x else choose_in B (fun y:set => False)) <-> forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x = g x)
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s :e 2 :^: A, forall f g :e B :^: A, hl_RESTRICTION A B s f = hl_RESTRICTION A B s g <-> forall x :e A, hl_IN A x s = 1 -> f x = g x

items.name: RESTRICTION_FIXPOINT
items.source: !s:A->bool. !f:A->B. RESTRICTION s f = f <=> f IN EXTENSIONAL s
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f :e B :^: A, (forall x :e A, (if x :e s then f x else choose_in B (fun y:set => False)) = f x) <-> f :e {x :e B :^: A | forall x0 :e A, ~ x0 :e s -> x x0 = choose_in B (fun y:set => False)}
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s :e 2 :^: A, forall f :e B :^: A, hl_RESTRICTION A B s f = f <-> hl_IN (B :^: A) f (hl_EXTENSIONAL A B s) = 1

items.name: RESTRICTION_IDEMP
items.source: !s:A->bool. !f:A->B. RESTRICTION s (RESTRICTION s f) = RESTRICTION s f
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall x :e A, (if x :e s then if x :e s then f x else choose_in B (fun y:set => False) else choose_in B (fun y:set => False)) = if x :e s then f x else choose_in B (fun y:set => False)
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s :e 2 :^: A, forall f :e B :^: A, hl_RESTRICTION A B s (hl_RESTRICTION A B s f) = hl_RESTRICTION A B s f

items.name: RESTRICTION_IN_CARTESIAN_PRODUCT
items.source: !k:K->bool. !s:K->A->bool. !f:K->A. RESTRICTION k f IN cartesian_product k s <=> (!i:K. i IN k ==> f i IN s i)
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall s :e Power A :^: K, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e K, f x :e A) -> ((fun x :e K => if x :e k then f x else choose_in A (fun y:set => False)) :e {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => False)} <-> forall i :e K, i :e k -> f i :e s i)
items.literal: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k :e 2 :^: K, forall s :e 2 :^: A :^: K, forall f :e A :^: K, hl_IN (A :^: K) (hl_RESTRICTION K A k f) (hl_cartesian_product K A k s) = 1 <-> forall i :e K, hl_IN K i k = 1 -> hl_IN A (f i) (s i) = 1

items.name: RESTRICTION_IN_EXTENSIONAL
items.source: !s:A->bool. !f:A->B. RESTRICTION s f IN EXTENSIONAL s
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (fun x :e A => if x :e s then f x else choose_in B (fun y:set => False)) :e {x :e B :^: A | forall x0 :e A, ~ x0 :e s -> x x0 = choose_in B (fun y:set => False)}
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s :e 2 :^: A, forall f :e B :^: A, hl_IN (B :^: A) (hl_RESTRICTION A B s f) (hl_EXTENSIONAL A B s) = 1

items.name: RESTRICTION_RESTRICTION
items.source: !s:A->bool. !t:A->bool. !f:A->B. s SUBSET t ==> RESTRICTION s (RESTRICTION t f) = RESTRICTION s f
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> s c= t -> forall x :e A, (if x :e s then if x :e t then f x else choose_in B (fun y:set => False) else choose_in B (fun y:set => False)) = if x :e s then f x else choose_in B (fun y:set => False)
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s t :e 2 :^: A, forall f :e B :^: A, hl_SUBSET A s t = 1 -> hl_RESTRICTION A B s (hl_RESTRICTION A B t f) = hl_RESTRICTION A B s f

items.name: RESTRICTION_THM
items.source: !s:A->bool. !f:A->B. RESTRICTION s f = (\x:A. if x IN s then f x else ARB)
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall x :e A, (if x :e s then f x else choose_in B (fun y:set => False)) = if x :e s then f x else choose_in B (fun x:set => False)
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s :e 2 :^: A, forall f :e B :^: A, hl_RESTRICTION A B s f = fun x :e A => hl_COND B (hl_IN A x s) (f x) (hl_ARB B)

items.name: RESTRICTION_UNDEFINED
items.source: !s:A->bool. !f:A->B. !x:A. ~(x IN s) ==> RESTRICTION s f x = ARB
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall x :e A, ~ x :e s -> (if x :e s then f x else choose_in B (fun y:set => False)) = choose_in B (fun x:set => False)
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s :e 2 :^: A, forall f :e B :^: A, forall x :e A, ~ hl_IN A x s = 1 -> hl_RESTRICTION A B s f x = hl_ARB B

items.name: RESTRICTION_UNIQUE
items.source: !s:A->bool. !f:A->B. !g:A->B. RESTRICTION s f = g <=> EXTENSIONAL s g /\ (!x:A. x IN s ==> f x = g x)
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> ((forall x :e A, (if x :e s then f x else choose_in B (fun y:set => False)) = g x) <-> (forall x :e A, ~ x :e s -> g x = choose_in B (fun y:set => False)) /\ forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x = g x)
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s :e 2 :^: A, forall f g :e B :^: A, hl_RESTRICTION A B s f = g <-> hl_EXTENSIONAL A B s g = 1 /\ forall x :e A, hl_IN A x s = 1 -> f x = g x

items.name: RESTRICTION_UNIQUE_ALT
items.source: !s:A->bool. !f:A->B. !g:A->B. f = RESTRICTION s g <=> EXTENSIONAL s f /\ (!x:A. x IN s ==> f x = g x)
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> ((forall x :e A, f x = if x :e s then g x else choose_in B (fun y:set => False)) <-> (forall x :e A, ~ x :e s -> f x = choose_in B (fun y:set => False)) /\ forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x = g x)
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s :e 2 :^: A, forall f g :e B :^: A, f = hl_RESTRICTION A B s g <-> hl_EXTENSIONAL A B s f = 1 /\ forall x :e A, hl_IN A x s = 1 -> f x = g x

items.name: RESTRICTION_UNIV
items.source: !f:A->B. RESTRICTION UNIV f = f
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall x :e A, (if x :e A then f x else choose_in B (fun y:set => False)) = f x
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f :e B :^: A, hl_RESTRICTION A B (hl_UNIV A) f = f

items.name: REVERSE
items.source: REVERSE NIL = NIL /\ REVERSE (x CONS l) = REVERSE l APPEND x CONS NIL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall l :e finseq A, seq_rev seq_nil = seq_nil /\ seq_rev (seq_cons x l) = seq_append (seq_rev l) (seq_cons x seq_nil)
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e A, forall l :e finseq A, hl_REVERSE A (hl_NIL A) = hl_NIL A /\ hl_REVERSE A (hl_CONS A x l) = hl_APPEND A (hl_REVERSE A l) (hl_CONS A x (hl_NIL A))

items.name: REVERSE_APPEND
items.source: !l:A list. !m:A list. REVERSE (l APPEND m) = REVERSE m APPEND REVERSE l
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l m :e finseq A, seq_rev (seq_append l m) = seq_append (seq_rev m) (seq_rev l)
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l m :e finseq A, hl_REVERSE A (hl_APPEND A l m) = hl_APPEND A (hl_REVERSE A m) (hl_REVERSE A l)

items.name: REVERSE_EQ_EMPTY
items.source: !l:A list. REVERSE l = NIL <=> l = NIL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l :e finseq A, seq_rev l = seq_nil <-> l = seq_nil
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l :e finseq A, hl_REVERSE A l = hl_NIL A <-> l = hl_NIL A

items.name: REVERSE_REVERSE
items.source: !l:A list. REVERSE (REVERSE l) = l
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l :e finseq A, seq_rev (seq_rev l) = l
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l :e finseq A, hl_REVERSE A (hl_REVERSE A l) = l

items.name: RIGHT_ADD_DISTRIB
items.source: !m:num. !n:num. !p:num. (m + n) * p = m * p + n * p
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, (m + n) * p = m * p + n * p
items.literal: forall m n p :e omega, hl_mul (hl_add m n) p = hl_add (hl_mul m p) (hl_mul n p)

items.name: RIGHT_AND_EXISTS_THM
items.source: !P:bool. !Q:A->bool. P /\ (?x:A. Q x) <=> (?x:A. P /\ Q x)
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:prop, forall Q:set -> prop, P /\ (exists x :e A, Q x) <-> exists x :e A, P /\ Q x
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P :e 2, forall Q :e 2 :^: A, P = 1 /\ (exists x :e A, Q x = 1) <-> exists x :e A, P = 1 /\ Q x = 1

items.name: RIGHT_AND_FORALL_THM
items.source: !P:bool. !Q:A->bool. P /\ (!x:A. Q x) <=> (!x:A. P /\ Q x)
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:prop, forall Q:set -> prop, P /\ (forall x :e A, Q x) <-> forall x :e A, P /\ Q x
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P :e 2, forall Q :e 2 :^: A, P = 1 /\ (forall x :e A, Q x = 1) <-> forall x :e A, P = 1 /\ Q x = 1

items.name: RIGHT_EXISTS_AND_THM
items.source: !P:bool. !Q:A->bool. (?x:A. P /\ Q x) <=> P /\ (?x:A. Q x)
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:prop, forall Q:set -> prop, (exists x :e A, P /\ Q x) <-> P /\ exists x :e A, Q x
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P :e 2, forall Q :e 2 :^: A, (exists x :e A, P = 1 /\ Q x = 1) <-> P = 1 /\ exists x :e A, Q x = 1

items.name: RIGHT_EXISTS_IMP_THM
items.source: !P:bool. !Q:A->bool. (?x:A. P ==> Q x) <=> P ==> (?x:A. Q x)
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:prop, forall Q:set -> prop, (exists x :e A, P -> Q x) <-> P -> exists x :e A, Q x
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P :e 2, forall Q :e 2 :^: A, (exists x :e A, P = 1 -> Q x = 1) <-> P = 1 -> exists x :e A, Q x = 1

items.name: RIGHT_FORALL_IMP_THM
items.source: !P:bool. !Q:A->bool. (!x:A. P ==> Q x) <=> P ==> (!x:A. Q x)
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:prop, forall Q:set -> prop, (forall x :e A, P -> Q x) <-> P -> forall x :e A, Q x
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P :e 2, forall Q :e 2 :^: A, (forall x :e A, P = 1 -> Q x = 1) <-> P = 1 -> forall x :e A, Q x = 1

items.name: RIGHT_FORALL_OR_THM
items.source: !P:bool. !Q:A->bool. (!x:A. P \/ Q x) <=> P \/ (!x:A. Q x)
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:prop, forall Q:set -> prop, (forall x :e A, P \/ Q x) <-> P \/ forall x :e A, Q x
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P :e 2, forall Q :e 2 :^: A, (forall x :e A, P = 1 \/ Q x = 1) <-> P = 1 \/ forall x :e A, Q x = 1

items.name: RIGHT_IMP_EXISTS_THM
items.source: !P:bool. !Q:A->bool. P ==> (?x:A. Q x) <=> (?x:A. P ==> Q x)
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:prop, forall Q:set -> prop, P -> (exists x :e A, Q x) <-> exists x :e A, P -> Q x

items.name: SING
