items.source: !x:real. !y:real. sqrt x < sqrt y <=> x < y
items.statement: forall x y :e R, (if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) < (if 0 <= y then sqrt_SNo_nonneg y else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- y)) <-> x < y
items.literal: forall x y :e R, hl_real_lt (hl_sqrt x) (hl_sqrt y) = 1 <-> hl_real_lt x y = 1

items.name: SQRT_MUL
items.source: !x:real. !y:real. sqrt (x * y) = sqrt x * sqrt y
items.statement: forall x y :e R, (if 0 <= x * y then sqrt_SNo_nonneg (x * y) else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x * y)) = (if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) * if 0 <= y then sqrt_SNo_nonneg y else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- y)
items.literal: forall x y :e R, hl_sqrt (hl_real_mul x y) = hl_real_mul (hl_sqrt x) (hl_sqrt y)

items.name: SQRT_NEG
items.source: !x:real. sqrt (real_neg x) = real_neg (sqrt x)
items.statement: forall x :e R, (if 0 <= - x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x) else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- - x)) = - if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)
items.literal: forall x :e R, hl_sqrt (hl_real_neg x) = hl_real_neg (hl_sqrt x)

items.name: SQRT_POS_LE
items.source: !x:real. real_of_num 0 <= x ==> real_of_num 0 <= sqrt x
items.statement: forall x :e R, 0 <= x -> 0 <= if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)
items.literal: forall x :e R, hl_real_le (hl_real_of_num (hl_NUMERAL hl_zero)) x = 1 -> hl_real_le (hl_real_of_num (hl_NUMERAL hl_zero)) (hl_sqrt x) = 1

items.name: SQRT_POS_LT
items.source: !x:real. real_of_num 0 < x ==> real_of_num 0 < sqrt x
items.statement: forall x :e R, 0 < x -> 0 < if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)
items.literal: forall x :e R, hl_real_lt (hl_real_of_num (hl_NUMERAL hl_zero)) x = 1 -> hl_real_lt (hl_real_of_num (hl_NUMERAL hl_zero)) (hl_sqrt x) = 1

items.name: SQRT_POW2
items.source: !x:real. sqrt x pow 2 = x <=> real_of_num 0 <= x
items.statement: forall x :e R, (if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) ^ 2 = x <-> 0 <= x
items.literal: forall x :e R, hl_real_pow (hl_sqrt x) (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT0 (hl_BIT1 hl_zero))) = x <-> hl_real_le (hl_real_of_num (hl_NUMERAL hl_zero)) x = 1

items.name: SQRT_POW_2
items.source: !x:real. real_of_num 0 <= x ==> sqrt x pow 2 = x
items.statement: forall x :e R, 0 <= x -> (if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) ^ 2 = x
items.literal: forall x :e R, hl_real_le (hl_real_of_num (hl_NUMERAL hl_zero)) x = 1 -> hl_real_pow (hl_sqrt x) (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT0 (hl_BIT1 hl_zero))) = x

items.name: SQRT_UNIQUE
items.source: !x:real. !y:real. real_of_num 0 <= y /\ y pow 2 = x ==> sqrt x = y
items.statement: forall x y :e R, 0 <= y /\ y ^ 2 = x -> (if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) = y
items.literal: forall x y :e R, hl_real_le (hl_real_of_num (hl_NUMERAL hl_zero)) y = 1 /\ hl_real_pow y (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT0 (hl_BIT1 hl_zero))) = x -> hl_sqrt x = y

items.name: SQRT_UNIQUE_GEN
items.source: !x:real. !y:real. real_sgn y = real_sgn x /\ y pow 2 = real_abs x ==> sqrt x = y
items.statement: forall x y :e R, (if 0 < y then 1 else if y < 0 then - 1 else 0) = (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) /\ y ^ 2 = abs_SNo x -> (if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) = y
items.literal: forall x y :e R, hl_real_sgn y = hl_real_sgn x /\ hl_real_pow y (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT0 (hl_BIT1 hl_zero))) = hl_real_abs x -> hl_sqrt x = y

items.name: SQRT_WORKS
items.source: !x:real. real_of_num 0 <= x ==> real_of_num 0 <= sqrt x /\ sqrt x pow 2 = x
items.statement: forall x :e R, 0 <= x -> 0 <= (if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) /\ (if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) ^ 2 = x
items.literal: forall x :e R, hl_real_le (hl_real_of_num (hl_NUMERAL hl_zero)) x = 1 -> hl_real_le (hl_real_of_num (hl_NUMERAL hl_zero)) (hl_sqrt x) = 1 /\ hl_real_pow (hl_sqrt x) (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT0 (hl_BIT1 hl_zero))) = x

items.name: SQRT_WORKS_GEN
items.source: !x:real. real_sgn (sqrt x) = real_sgn x /\ sqrt x pow 2 = real_abs x
items.statement: forall x :e R, (if 0 < if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x) then 1 else if (if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) < 0 then - 1 else 0) = (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) /\ (if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) ^ 2 = abs_SNo x
items.literal: forall x :e R, hl_real_sgn (hl_sqrt x) = hl_real_sgn x /\ hl_real_pow (hl_sqrt x) (hl_NUMERAL (hl_BIT0 (hl_BIT1 hl_zero))) = hl_real_abs x

items.name: SUB
items.source: (!m:num. m - 0 = m) /\ (!m:num. !n:num. m - SUC n = PRE (m - n))
items.statement: (forall m :e omega, minus_nat m 0 = m) /\ forall m n :e omega, minus_nat m (ordsucc n) = nat_pred (minus_nat m n)
items.literal: (forall m :e omega, hl_sub m (hl_NUMERAL hl_zero) = m) /\ forall m n :e omega, hl_sub m (hl_SUC n) = hl_PRE (hl_sub m n)

items.name: SUBSET
items.source: !s:A->bool. !t:A->bool. s SUBSET t <=> (!x:A. x IN s ==> x IN t)
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, s c= t <-> forall x :e A, x :e s -> x :e t
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t :e 2 :^: A, hl_SUBSET A s t = 1 <-> forall x :e A, hl_IN A x s = 1 -> hl_IN A x t = 1

items.name: SUBSET_ANTISYM
items.source: !s:A->bool. !t:A->bool. s SUBSET t /\ t SUBSET s ==> s = t
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, s c= t /\ t c= s -> s = t
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t :e 2 :^: A, hl_SUBSET A s t = 1 /\ hl_SUBSET A t s = 1 -> s = t

items.name: SUBSET_ANTISYM_EQ
items.source: !s:A->bool. !t:A->bool. s SUBSET t /\ t SUBSET s <=> s = t
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, s c= t /\ t c= s <-> s = t
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t :e 2 :^: A, hl_SUBSET A s t = 1 /\ hl_SUBSET A t s = 1 <-> s = t

items.name: SUBSET_CARD_EQ
items.source: !s:A->bool. !t:A->bool. FINITE t /\ s SUBSET t ==> (CARD s = CARD t <=> s = t)
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, finite t /\ s c= t -> (finite_cardinality s = finite_cardinality t <-> s = t)
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t :e 2 :^: A, hl_FINITE A t = 1 /\ hl_SUBSET A s t = 1 -> (hl_CARD A s = hl_CARD A t <-> s = t)

items.name: SUBSET_CARTESIAN_PRODUCT
items.source: !k:K->bool. !s:K->A->bool. !t:K->A->bool. cartesian_product k s SUBSET cartesian_product k t <=> cartesian_product k s = EMPTY \/ (!i:K. i IN k ==> s i SUBSET t i)
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall s t :e Power A :^: K, {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => False)} c= {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e t i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => False)} <-> {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => False)} = Empty \/ forall i :e K, i :e k -> s i c= t i
items.literal: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k :e 2 :^: K, forall s t :e 2 :^: A :^: K, hl_SUBSET (A :^: K) (hl_cartesian_product K A k s) (hl_cartesian_product K A k t) = 1 <-> hl_cartesian_product K A k s = hl_EMPTY (A :^: K) \/ forall i :e K, hl_IN K i k = 1 -> hl_SUBSET A (s i) (t i) = 1

items.name: SUBSET_CROSS
items.source: !s:A->bool. !t:B->bool. !s':A->bool. !t':B->bool. CROSS s t SUBSET CROSS s' t' <=> s = EMPTY \/ t = EMPTY \/ s SUBSET s' /\ t SUBSET t'
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall s' c= A, forall t' c= B, s :*: t c= s' :*: t' <-> s = Empty \/ (t = Empty \/ s c= s' /\ t c= t')
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s :e 2 :^: A, forall t :e 2 :^: B, forall s' :e 2 :^: A, forall t' :e 2 :^: B, hl_SUBSET (A :*: B) (hl_CROSS A B s t) (hl_CROSS A B s' t') = 1 <-> s = hl_EMPTY A \/ (t = hl_EMPTY B \/ hl_SUBSET A s s' = 1 /\ hl_SUBSET B t t' = 1)

items.name: SUBSET_DELETE
items.source: !x:A. !s:A->bool. !t:A->bool. s SUBSET t DELETE x <=> ~(x IN s) /\ s SUBSET t
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall s t c= A, s c= t :\: {x} <-> ~ x :e s /\ s c= t
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e A, forall s t :e 2 :^: A, hl_SUBSET A s (hl_DELETE A t x) = 1 <-> ~ hl_IN A x s = 1 /\ hl_SUBSET A s t = 1

items.name: SUBSET_DIFF
items.source: !s:A->bool. !t:A->bool. s DIFF t SUBSET s
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, s :\: t c= s
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t :e 2 :^: A, hl_SUBSET A (hl_DIFF A s t) s = 1

items.name: SUBSET_DISJOINT_UNION
items.source: !k:K->bool. !s:K->A->bool. !t:K->A->bool. disjoint_union k s SUBSET disjoint_union k t <=> (!i:K. i IN k ==> s i SUBSET t i)
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall s t :e Power A :^: K, {p :e K :*: A | p 0 :e k /\ p 1 :e s (p 0)} c= {p :e K :*: A | p 0 :e k /\ p 1 :e t (p 0)} <-> forall i :e K, i :e k -> s i c= t i
items.literal: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k :e 2 :^: K, forall s t :e 2 :^: A :^: K, hl_SUBSET (K :*: A) (hl_disjoint_union K A k s) (hl_disjoint_union K A k t) = 1 <-> forall i :e K, hl_IN K i k = 1 -> hl_SUBSET A (s i) (t i) = 1

items.name: SUBSET_DISJOINT_UNION_EXISTS
items.source: !k:K->bool. !s:K->A->bool. !u:K#A->bool. u SUBSET disjoint_union k s <=> (?t:K->A->bool. u = disjoint_union k t /\ (!i:K. i IN k ==> t i SUBSET s i))
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall s :e Power A :^: K, forall u c= K :*: A, u c= {p :e K :*: A | p 0 :e k /\ p 1 :e s (p 0)} <-> exists t :e Power A :^: K, u = {p :e K :*: A | p 0 :e k /\ p 1 :e t (p 0)} /\ forall i :e K, i :e k -> t i c= s i
items.literal: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k :e 2 :^: K, forall s :e 2 :^: A :^: K, forall u :e 2 :^: (K :*: A), hl_SUBSET (K :*: A) u (hl_disjoint_union K A k s) = 1 <-> exists t :e 2 :^: A :^: K, u = hl_disjoint_union K A k t /\ forall i :e K, hl_IN K i k = 1 -> hl_SUBSET A (t i) (s i) = 1

items.name: SUBSET_EMPTY
items.source: !s:A->bool. s SUBSET EMPTY <=> s = EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, s c= Empty <-> s = Empty
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s :e 2 :^: A, hl_SUBSET A s (hl_EMPTY A) = 1 <-> s = hl_EMPTY A

items.name: SUBSET_IMAGE
items.source: !f:A->B. !s:B->bool. !t:A->bool. s SUBSET IMAGE f t <=> (?u:A->bool. u SUBSET t /\ s = IMAGE f u)
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= B, forall t c= A, s c= {f x | x :e t} <-> exists u c= A, u c= t /\ s = {f x | x :e u}
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f :e B :^: A, forall s :e 2 :^: B, forall t :e 2 :^: A, hl_SUBSET B s (hl_IMAGE A B f t) = 1 <-> exists u :e 2 :^: A, hl_SUBSET A u t = 1 /\ s = hl_IMAGE A B f u

items.name: SUBSET_IMAGE_INJ
items.source: !f:A->B. !s:B->bool. !t:A->bool. s SUBSET IMAGE f t <=> (?u:A->bool. u SUBSET t /\ (!x:A. !y:A. x IN u /\ y IN u ==> (f x = f y <=> x = y)) /\ s = IMAGE f u)
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= B, forall t c= A, s c= {f x | x :e t} <-> exists u c= A, u c= t /\ ((forall x y :e A, x :e u /\ y :e u -> (f x = f y <-> x = y)) /\ s = {f x | x :e u})
items.literal: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f :e B :^: A, forall s :e 2 :^: B, forall t :e 2 :^: A, hl_SUBSET B s (hl_IMAGE A B f t) = 1 <-> exists u :e 2 :^: A, hl_SUBSET A u t = 1 /\ ((forall x y :e A, hl_IN A x u = 1 /\ hl_IN A y u = 1 -> (f x = f y <-> x = y)) /\ s = hl_IMAGE A B f u)

items.name: SUBSET_INSERT
items.source: !x:A. !s:A->bool. ~(x IN s) ==> (!t:A->bool. s SUBSET x INSERT t <=> s SUBSET t)
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall s c= A, ~ x :e s -> forall t c= A, s c= SetAdjoin t x <-> s c= t
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e A, forall s :e 2 :^: A, ~ hl_IN A x s = 1 -> forall t :e 2 :^: A, hl_SUBSET A s (hl_INSERT A x t) = 1 <-> hl_SUBSET A s t = 1

items.name: SUBSET_INSERT_DELETE
items.source: !x:A. !s:A->bool. !t:A->bool. s SUBSET x INSERT t <=> s DELETE x SUBSET t
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall s t c= A, s c= SetAdjoin t x <-> s :\: {x} c= t
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e A, forall s t :e 2 :^: A, hl_SUBSET A s (hl_INSERT A x t) = 1 <-> hl_SUBSET A (hl_DELETE A s x) t = 1

items.name: SUBSET_INTER
items.source: !s:A->bool. !t:A->bool. !u:A->bool. s SUBSET t INTER u <=> s SUBSET t /\ s SUBSET u
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t u c= A, s c= t :/\: u <-> s c= t /\ s c= u
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t u :e 2 :^: A, hl_SUBSET A s (hl_INTER A t u) = 1 <-> hl_SUBSET A s t = 1 /\ hl_SUBSET A s u = 1

items.name: SUBSET_INTERS
items.source: !s:A->bool. !f:(A->bool)->bool. s SUBSET INTERS f <=> (!t:A->bool. t IN f ==> s SUBSET t)
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, forall f c= Power A, s c= {x :e A | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} <-> forall t c= A, t :e f -> s c= t
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s :e 2 :^: A, forall f :e 2 :^: (2 :^: A), hl_SUBSET A s (hl_INTERS A f) = 1 <-> forall t :e 2 :^: A, hl_IN (2 :^: A) t f = 1 -> hl_SUBSET A s t = 1

items.name: SUBSET_INTER_ABSORPTION
items.source: !s:A->bool. !t:A->bool. s SUBSET t <=> s INTER t = s
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, s c= t <-> s :/\: t = s
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t :e 2 :^: A, hl_SUBSET A s t = 1 <-> hl_INTER A s t = s

items.name: SUBSET_NUMSEG
items.source: !m:num. !n:num. !p:num. !q:num. .. m n SUBSET .. p q <=> n < m \/ p <= m /\ n <= q
items.statement: forall m n p q :e omega, {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} c= {i :e omega | p <= i /\ i <= q} <-> n < m \/ p <= m /\ n <= q
items.literal: forall m n p q :e omega, hl_SUBSET omega (hl_numseg m n) (hl_numseg p q) = 1 <-> hl_lt n m = 1 \/ hl_le p m = 1 /\ hl_le n q = 1

items.name: SUBSET_PCROSS
items.source: !s:(A,M)cart->bool. !t:(A,N)cart->bool. !s':(A,M)cart->bool. !t':(A,N)cart->bool. PCROSS s t SUBSET PCROSS s' t' <=> s = EMPTY \/ t = EMPTY \/ s SUBSET s' /\ t SUBSET t'
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= A :^: idx M, forall t c= A :^: idx N, forall s' c= A :^: idx M, forall t' c= A :^: idx N, (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) c= (\/_ x :e s', {pastecart M N x y | y :e t'}) <-> s = Empty \/ (t = Empty \/ s c= s' /\ t c= t')
items.literal: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s :e 2 :^: hl_ty_cart A M, forall t :e 2 :^: hl_ty_cart A N, forall s' :e 2 :^: hl_ty_cart A M, forall t' :e 2 :^: hl_ty_cart A N, hl_SUBSET (hl_ty_cart A (hl_ty_finite_sum M N)) (hl_PCROSS A M N s t) (hl_PCROSS A M N s' t') = 1 <-> s = hl_EMPTY (hl_ty_cart A M) \/ (t = hl_EMPTY (hl_ty_cart A N) \/ hl_SUBSET (hl_ty_cart A M) s s' = 1 /\ hl_SUBSET (hl_ty_cart A N) t t' = 1)

items.name: SUBSET_PSUBSET_TRANS
items.source: !s:A->bool. !t:A->bool. !u:A->bool. s SUBSET t /\ PSUBSET t u ==> PSUBSET s u
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t u c= A, s c= t /\ (t c= u /\ t <> u) -> s c= u /\ s <> u
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t u :e 2 :^: A, hl_SUBSET A s t = 1 /\ hl_PSUBSET A t u = 1 -> hl_PSUBSET A s u = 1

items.name: SUBSET_REFL
items.source: !s:A->bool. s SUBSET s
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, s c= s
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s :e 2 :^: A, hl_SUBSET A s s = 1

items.name: SUBSET_RESTRICT
items.source: !s:A->bool. !P:A->bool. GSPEC (\GEN%PVAR%33:A. ?x:A. SETSPEC GEN%PVAR%33 (x IN s /\ P x) x) SUBSET s
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, forall P:set -> prop, {x :e A | x :e s /\ P x} c= s
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s P :e 2 :^: A, hl_SUBSET A (hl_GSPEC A (fun GEN_PVAR_33 :e A => if exists x :e A, hl_SETSPEC A GEN_PVAR_33 (if hl_IN A x s = 1 /\ P x = 1 then 1 else 0) x = 1 then 1 else 0)) s = 1

items.name: SUBSET_TRANS
items.source: !s:A->bool. !t:A->bool. !u:A->bool. s SUBSET t /\ t SUBSET u ==> s SUBSET u
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t u c= A, s c= t /\ t c= u -> s c= u
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t u :e 2 :^: A, hl_SUBSET A s t = 1 /\ hl_SUBSET A t u = 1 -> hl_SUBSET A s u = 1

items.name: SUBSET_UNION
items.source: (!s:A->bool. !t:A->bool. s SUBSET s UNION t) /\ (!s:A->bool. !t:A->bool. s SUBSET t UNION s)
items.statement: forall A:set, (forall s t c= A, s c= s :\/: t) /\ forall s t c= A, s c= t :\/: s
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> (forall s t :e 2 :^: A, hl_SUBSET A s (hl_UNION A s t) = 1) /\ forall s t :e 2 :^: A, hl_SUBSET A s (hl_UNION A t s) = 1

items.name: SUBSET_UNIONS
items.source: !f:(A->bool)->bool. !g:(A->bool)->bool. f SUBSET g ==> UNIONS f SUBSET UNIONS g
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f g c= Power A, f c= g -> Union f c= Union g
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f g :e 2 :^: (2 :^: A), hl_SUBSET (2 :^: A) f g = 1 -> hl_SUBSET A (hl_UNIONS A f) (hl_UNIONS A g) = 1

items.name: SUBSET_UNION_ABSORPTION
items.source: !s:A->bool. !t:A->bool. s SUBSET t <=> s UNION t = t
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, s c= t <-> s :\/: t = t
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t :e 2 :^: A, hl_SUBSET A s t = 1 <-> hl_UNION A s t = t

items.name: SUBSET_UNIV

items.name: SUP_INSERT_FINITE

items.name: SUP_UNION

items.literal: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k :e 2 :^: K, forall s t :e 2 :^: A :^: K, hl_UNION (K :*: A) (hl_disjoint_union K A k s) (hl_disjoint_union K A k t) = hl_disjoint_union K A k (fun i :e K => hl_UNION A (s i) (t i))

items.name: UNION_EMPTY
items.source: (!s:A->bool. EMPTY UNION s = s) /\ (!s:A->bool. s UNION EMPTY = s)
items.statement: forall A:set, (forall s c= A, Empty :\/: s = s) /\ forall s c= A, s :\/: Empty = s

items.name: UNION_OF
items.source: !P:((A->bool)->bool)->bool. !Q:(A->bool)->bool. UNION_OF P Q = (\s:A->bool. ?u:(A->bool)->bool. P u /\ (!c:A->bool. c IN u ==> Q c) /\ UNIONS u = s)
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P Q:set -> prop, forall s c= A, (exists u c= Power A, P u /\ (forall c :e u, Q c) /\ Union u = s) <-> exists u c= Power A, P u /\ ((forall c c= A, c :e u -> Q c) /\ Union u = s)
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P :e 2 :^: (2 :^: (2 :^: A)), forall Q :e 2 :^: (2 :^: A), hl_UNION_OF A P Q = fun s :e 2 :^: A => if exists u :e 2 :^: (2 :^: A), P u = 1 /\ ((forall c :e 2 :^: A, hl_IN (2 :^: A) c u = 1 -> Q c = 1) /\ hl_UNIONS A u = s) then 1 else 0

items.name: UNION_OF_EMPTY
items.source: !P:((A->bool)->bool)->bool. !Q:(A->bool)->bool. P EMPTY ==> UNION_OF P Q EMPTY

items.name: UNION_OF_INC

items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P Q:set -> prop, forall s c= A, P {s} /\ Q s -> exists u c= Power A, P u /\ (forall c :e u, Q c) /\ Union u = s
items.literal: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P :e 2 :^: (2 :^: (2 :^: A)), forall Q :e 2 :^: (2 :^: A), forall s :e 2 :^: A, P (hl_INSERT (2 :^: A) s (hl_EMPTY (2 :^: A))) = 1 /\ Q s = 1 -> hl_UNION_OF A P Q s = 1

items.name: UNION_OF_MONO
items.source: !P:((A->bool)->bool)->bool. !Q:(A->bool)->bool. !Q':(A->bool)->bool. !s:A->bool. UNION_OF P Q s /\ (!x:A->bool. Q x ==> Q' x) ==> UNION_OF P Q' s
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P Q Q':set -> prop, forall s c= A, (exists u c= Power A, P u /\ (forall c :e u, Q c) /\ Union u = s) /\ (forall x c= A, Q x -> Q' x) -> exists u c= Power A, P u /\ (forall c :e u, Q' c) /\ Union u = s

items.name: UNION_OVER_INTER
